title: From Autonomous Agents to Cognitive Symbionts: Toward AI-Augmented Human Intelligence
title_zh: 从自主智能体到认知共生体：迈向AI增强的人类智能

paragraphs.en: For the past decade, progress in artificial intelligence has been scored on a single axis: how much a machine can accomplish on its own. Measured on that axis, the results are substantial. AI models now can write and review code, draft and summarize documents, search, plan, and carry out multistep tasks on a computer ( OpenAI, 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Anthropic, 2024a ) . Productivity at the desk, the part of work that takes place in front of a screen, has been transformed and in large part solved. An ordinary day, however, still contains the same losses it always did, and one person’s day is enough to show them. In the morning, working alone, a researcher has an idea that slips away before it is written down. In the afternoon, in a meeting, a colleague asks about a result she published three years ago, and she cannot recall the number. In the evening, facing a decision, she cannot remember how she reasoned the last time she faced one like it. Two further losses belong to the same family: a visitor in an unfamiliar country who does not know how to decline an invitation politely, and someone who has just failed at something, who needs one sentence from a person who knows their story and receives a paragraph of generic encouragement instead. The first three are failures of access, in which something the person already possesses fails to reach the moment in which it is needed, and the last two are gaps of knowledge and of support that the person cannot close alone at that moment; none of the five is a failure of intelligence. In each case an AI that holds the relevant knowledge exists, and in each case it is absent from the situation: it does not know who this person is, where they are, what they are trying to do, or what they are feeling, and it has no natural way to interact and communicate with them in the moment. Sections 9.2 , 8.6 , and 6.6 return to the three moments of this day.
paragraphs.zh: 过去十年，人工智能的进步一直以单一维度来衡量：机器能够独立完成多少事情。 以该维度衡量，成果相当可观。 如今的AI模型可以编写和审查代码、起草和总结文档、搜索、规划，并在计算机上执行多步骤任务（OpenAI, 2023；Yang et al., 2024；Anthropic, 2024a）。 案头工作——即发生在屏幕前的那部分工作——已被改变，并在很大程度上得到解决。 然而，一个平常的日子仍然包含着它一直以来都存在的那些损失，而一个人的的一天就足以展现它们。 早晨，一位研究者独自工作时产生了一个想法，却在写下来之前就溜走了。 下午，在一场会议中，一位同事问起她三年前发表的一个结果，她却记不起那个数字。 晚上，面对一个决定，她想不起自己上次面对类似决定时是如何推理的。 还有两种损失属于同一类：一位身处陌生国度的访客不知道如何礼貌地婉拒邀请；一个刚刚在某事上失败的人，需要一句来自了解其经历之人的话，得到的却是一段千篇一律的泛泛鼓励。 前三种是获取上的失败，即一个人已经拥有的东西未能到达需要它的那一刻；后两种则是知识和支持的缺口，是那个人在那一刻无法独自弥补的；这五者没有一个是智能上的失败。 在每一种情形中，掌握相关知识的AI都是存在的，但在每一种情形中它都缺席于该情境：它不知道这个人是谁、在哪里、正在尝试做什么、感受如何，也没有在当下与他们自然互动和交流的途径。 第9.2节、第8.6节和第6.6节将回到这一天中的三个时刻。

paragraphs.en: Most readers already carry a picture of the system that would close these gaps. In the Iron Man films, Jarvis is always present, has known its owner for years, acts while he is speaking and moving, and never asks him to stop and explain. 1 1 1 J.A.R.V.I.S. appears in Iron Man (2008) through Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015). We use it only as a shared reference point, never as evidence. The reference is useful because it allows the subject of this perspective paper to be stated in one sentence: we are concerned with how every person could have such a system, and with how far beyond Jarvis such a system should go. The vignette Beyond Jarvis in Section 4.2 lists six directions, of which three matter most here, and each is developed later in the paper. Jarvis sees through a laboratory and a suit that its owner built, whereas a symbiont for everyone must see through a handful of affordable external devices, and it gains channels Jarvis never had, such as physiological signals, first-person video, and the owner’s own account, in their own words, of what they are thinking. Jarvis mostly executes and alerts, and rarely models its owner’s goals, emotions, or blind spots, whereas the center of gravity of a symbiont is exactly that layer of mind. And Jarvis gives almost no help with other people or other cultures, which is where a symbiont is most distinctive. Section 4.2 makes this comparison precise.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数读者心中早已有一幅能够弥补这些差距的系统图景。 在《钢铁侠》系列电影中，贾维斯始终在场，与主人相识多年，在他说话和活动的同时行动，从不要求他停下来解释。1 1 1 J.A.R.V.I.S. 出现在《钢铁侠》（2008）至《复仇者联盟2：奥创纪元》（2015）中。 我们仅将它作为共同的参照点，绝不作为证据。 这个参照很有用，因为它使本视角论文的主题可以用一句话来陈述：我们关注的是每个人如何能拥有这样一套系统，以及这样一套系统应当超越贾维斯到何种程度。 第 4.2 节的小品文“超越贾维斯”列出了六个方向，其中三个在此最为重要，每一个都将在论文后文展开。 贾维斯通过主人自己建造的实验室和战衣来观察世界，而面向所有人的共生体必须通过少数几件价格可及的外部设备来观察，同时它还获得了贾维斯从未有过的渠道，例如生理信号、第一人称视频，以及主人用自己的话对自己正在想什么的陈述。 贾维斯主要执行任务和发出警报，很少对主人的目标、情绪或盲点进行建模，而共生体的重心恰恰在这一心智层面。 而且贾维斯几乎无法帮助主人应对他人或其他文化，而这正是共生体最具特色之处。 第 4.2 节对这一比较作了精确阐述。

paragraphs.en: AI is leaving the screen for the physical world, and with it comes the question of what kinds of intelligent individuals that world will contain. The answer that has drawn most of the field’s attention is the embodied robot, an AI with a body, senses, and goals of its own ( Gemini Robotics Team, 2025 ; NVIDIA, 2025 ) . We argue that the era of Physical AI will contain a second kind of individual of equal importance: a person whose own senses, memory, and judgment are joined to an AI that lives on their body (Section 2.2 ). This paper is a perspective on that second kind of individual. Foundation models, world models, and methods of self-improvement enter it as enabling technologies (Section 3 ) and as replaceable components (Section 7.4 ), while the proposal itself concerns the form in which an augmented person exists and is helped.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能正从屏幕走向物理世界，随之而来的问题是：那个世界将包含什么样的智能个体。 迄今最受该领域关注的答案是具身机器人，即一种拥有身体、感官和自身目标的人工智能（Gemini Robotics Team, 2025；NVIDIA, 2025）。 我们认为，物理人工智能时代还将包含另一种同等重要的个体：这样的人——其自身的感官、记忆与判断，与一个生活在他们身体上的人工智能相结合（第2.2节）。 本文正是对这第二种个体的一个观点阐述。 基础模型、世界模型和自我改进方法作为使能技术（第3节）和可替换的组件（第7.4节）进入本文，而本提案本身关注的是增强人类以何种形式存在并获得帮助。

paragraphs.en: The second kind of individual also changes what progress in AI is measured against, and in this sense the endgame of AI has two halves. Artificial general intelligence (AGI) asks how intelligent the machine can be . The other half, which we call AI-augmented human intelligence (AHI) , asks how much intelligence a machine can enable in a particular person . The two are built on the same base: the same foundation model can act as an autonomous agent that completes tasks, or as a cognitive symbiont that augments one human being. What differs is the object of evaluation, the mode of existence, and the relationship with the person (Figure 2 ). This paper is entirely about the second half, and it makes two commitments to the first. A symbiont delegates errands to standard agents (Section 9.1 ), and it improves with every gain in the base model (Section 7.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第二类个体也改变了衡量人工智能进步的标尺，从这个意义上说，人工智能的终局有两个部分。 人工通用智能（AGI）问的是机器能有多智能。 另一部分，我们称之为人工智能增强的人类智能（AHI），问的是机器能在特定的人身上激发出多少智能。 两者建立在同一个基础之上：同一个基础模型既可以作为完成任务的自主智能体，也可以作为增强单个人的认知共生体。 不同之处在于评估的对象、存在的模式以及与人的关系（图 2）。 本文完全聚焦于第二部分，同时对第一部分做出两项承诺。 共生体将琐事委托给标准智能体（第 9.1 节），并随着基础模型的每一次进步而提升。

paragraphs.en: A person’s cognitive bandwidth is fixed. Working memory holds a few items, attention goes one place at a time, and a day has twenty-four hours. The capability of AI on isolated tasks keeps rising, but the coupling between an AI and a given person has barely changed: how much the AI knows about the person, how fast it can step in, how much it interrupts when it does, and how far the person trusts it. The result is a widening gap between what a model could contribute and what a person actually receives (Figure 3 a). The next step for personal AI is tighter coupling, and tighter coupling is a different problem from a larger model. The claim requires qualification, since coupling is itself built on strong base models; Section 3 describes which technologies first made coupling possible, and the paper opposes only the assumption that a larger base is sufficient. Three observable symptoms mark insufficient coupling: every conversation starts by re-explaining the background, help arrives too late or too loudly, and people entrust nothing important to the system. They point, respectively, to Sections 6 , 8 , and 12 . Figure 3 b shows the mechanism by which the relationship nonetheless shifts: stronger models absorb more context, which lowers the cost of being understood, which moves interaction off the screen and onto the body, which produces a new kind of context, the record of a life, which makes those models more useful to that person in turn.
paragraphs.zh: 一个人的认知带宽是固定的。 工作记忆只能容纳几个条目，注意力一次只能专注于一个地方，而一天只有二十四小时。 AI 在孤立任务上的能力不断提升，但 AI 与特定的人之间的耦合几乎没有变化：AI 对这个人了解多少，它能多快介入，介入时会打断多少，以及这个人有多信任它。 其结果是模型可能贡献的东西与一个人实际获得的东西之间的差距不断扩大（图 3 a）。 个人 AI 的下一步是更紧密的耦合，而更紧密的耦合与更大的模型是两个不同的问题。 这一论断需要加以限定，因为耦合本身建立在强大的基础模型之上；第 3 节描述了哪些技术最早使耦合成为可能，而本文只反对“更大的基础模型就足够了”这一假设。 三个可观察的症状标志着耦合不足：每次对话都要重新解释背景，帮助来得太晚或过于喧闹，以及人们不把任何重要的事情托付给系统。 它们分别对应第 6、8 和 12 节。 图 3 b 展示了尽管如此这种关系仍会发生转变的机制：更强的模型吸收更多上下文，这降低了被理解的成本，这使交互从屏幕转移到身体上，这产生了一种新型上下文——生活的记录，而这又使那些模型对那个人更加有用。

sents.zh: 一个人的认知带宽是固定的。

sents.en: The next step for personal AI is tighter coupling, and tighter coupling is a different problem from a larger model.
sents.zh: 个人 AI 的下一步是更紧密的耦合，而更紧密的耦合与更大的模型是两个不同的问题。

sents.en: The claim requires qualification, since coupling is itself built on strong base models; Section 3 describes which technologies first made coupling possible, and the paper opposes only the assumption that a larger base is sufficient.
sents.zh: 这一论断需要加以限定，因为耦合本身建立在强大的基础模型之上；第 3 节描述了哪些技术最早使耦合成为可能，而本文只反对“更大的基础模型就足够了”这一假设。

sents.en: Three observable symptoms mark insufficient coupling: every conversation starts by re-explaining the background, help arrives too late or too loudly, and people entrust nothing important to the system.
sents.zh: 三个可观察的症状标志着耦合不足：每次对话都要重新解释背景，帮助来得太晚或过于喧闹，以及人们不把任何重要的事情托付给系统。

sents.en: They point, respectively, to Sections 6 , 8 , and 12 .
sents.zh: 它们分别对应第 6、8 和 12 节。

sents.en: Figure 3 b shows the mechanism by which the relationship nonetheless shifts: stronger models absorb more context, which lowers the cost of being understood, which moves interaction off the screen and onto the body, which produces a new kind of context, the record of a life, which makes those models more useful to that person in turn.
sents.zh: 图 3 b 展示了尽管如此这种关系仍会发生转变的机制：更强的模型吸收更多上下文，这降低了被理解的成本，这使交互从屏幕转移到身体上，这产生了一种新型上下文——生活的记录，而这又使那些模型对那个人更加有用。

paragraphs.en: A system that makes a person more capable in front of other people raises questions that a system which only completes tasks does not. When a student can recall a textbook during an examination, or a negotiator is handed a line that reads the other side’s hesitation, the gain of one person is a cost to another, and the other party usually does not know. The same privacy that keeps the exchange between a person and their symbiont from intruding on others also hides the help from an examiner, an interviewer, or a friend. Products built on this capability have already been sold for cheating, as Cluely was in 2025 ( TechCrunch, 2025 ) , and chatbot providers have switched off features for the duration of China’s college entrance examination ( Bloomberg News, 2025 ) . Public attitudes toward cognitive enhancement are cautious, and the main objection is fairness ( Pew Research Center, 2022 ; Faber et al., 2016 ) . We treat these concerns as part of the proposal. A symbiont differs from earlier cognitive enhancements in a respect that matters for governance: it is external, removable, and inspectable, so it can follow the rules of the settings a person enters and show that it did. Part IV develops the risks and the governance that follows from this property.
paragraphs.zh: 让一个人在其他人在场时能力更强的系统，引发了一些仅完成任务所不会引发的问题。 当学生在考试中能回忆起教科书内容，或谈判者收到一行提示对方犹豫的解读时，一个人的所得就是另一个人的损失，而对方通常并不知情。 保护个人与其共生体之间交流不侵扰他人的同一种隐私，也会向考官、面试官或朋友隐藏这份帮助。 基于这种能力的产品已被作为作弊工具出售，例如2025年的Cluely（TechCrunch, 2025），聊天机器人提供商也曾在中国高考期间关闭相关功能（Bloomberg News, 2025）。 公众对认知增强的态度是谨慎的，主要反对理由是公平性（Pew Research Center, 2022; Faber et al., 2016）。 我们将这些担忧视为本提案的一部分。 共生体不同于以往的认知增强之处在于一点对治理至关重要的特性：它是外置的、可移除的、可检查的，因此它可以遵循个人所处环境的规则，并证明自己确实如此。 第四部分将阐述这一特性所带来的风险及相应的治理。

paragraphs.en: Our thesis is the following. Realizing the second half of the endgame requires an AI that exists in a new way: a cognitive symbiont that senses what the person senses, keeps their life, models their situation and their mind, takes part in their thinking at the right moment, carries out their errands with their context in hand, and keeps learning them while both of them change. The paper develops this thesis in four parts. Figure 1 lays them out. Part I (Sections 2 to 4 ) locates the paradigm historically and technically and gives it a conceptual core. Part II (Sections 5 to 12 ) follows one loop from sensing to trust, in which the output of each section is the input of the next. Part III (Sections 13 and 14 ) asks who gains and what a society of augmented individuals looks like. Part IV (Sections 15 to 18 ) examines what could go wrong, how augmentation can be governed, and how the claims of the paper can be measured.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的论点如下。 实现终局的后半程需要一种以全新方式存在的 AI：一个认知共生体，它感知此人所感知的东西，记录其生活，对其处境与心智建模，在恰当时刻参与其思考，带着其情境为其跑腿办事，并在双方都不断变化的过程中持续学习这个人。 本文分四个部分展开这一论点。图 1 对其进行了展示。 第一部分（第 2 至 4 节）从历史与技术上定位该范式，并给出其概念核心。 第二部分（第 5 至 12 节）沿一条从感知到信任的闭环展开，其中每一节的输出即是下一节的输入。 第三部分（第 13 和 14 节）探讨谁会受益，以及一个由被增强的个体组成的社会是什么样子。 第四部分（第 15 至 18 节）审视可能出什么问题、增强如何被治理，以及本文的论断如何可以被度量。

paragraphs.en: The contribution of the paper is the paradigm itself, taken as a whole. We name a second kind of intelligent individual for the era of Physical AI, the person augmented by AI, and a second half of the endgame of AI, AI-augmented human intelligence, which differs from the first by its object of evaluation, its mode of existence, and its relationship with the person. We propose the cognitive symbiont as the form of system that realizes it, define it through the cognitive gap and six necessary properties, and organize its design space as a symbiosis loop whose stages are each given a mechanism, a set of research questions, and a way of being evaluated. We treat the risks of augmentation, to the person and through the person to others, as part of the paradigm, and propose that a symbiont follow the rules of the settings its owner enters and be able to show that it did. We change the unit of evaluation from the AI to the augmented individual and state the open problems of the direction as a research program. We propose no new algorithm; the claim of the paper is to the framing, to the organization of the design space, and to the standard of evidence it sets. Our hope is that the concept will orient a new paradigm of AI research, one in which the measure of progress is how much more capable each particular person has become.
paragraphs.zh: 本文的贡献在于这一范式本身，即将其作为一个整体来看待。 我们为物理智能体（Physical AI）时代命名了第二类智能个体——被智能体增强的人，并命名了智能体终局的下半场——智能体增强的人类智能，它通过其评估对象、存在方式以及与人的关系而与第一类相区别。 我们提出认知共生体（cognitive symbiont）作为实现它的系统形态，通过认知鸿沟和六项必要属性对其进行定义，并将其设计空间组织为一个共生循环，其中每个阶段都配有一个机制、一组研究问题以及一种评估方式。 我们将增强所带来的风险——对个人的风险以及通过个人对他人的风险——视为范式的一部分，并提出共生体应遵循其所有者所处环境中的规则，并且能够证明自己确实如此。 我们将评估单元从智能体本身转变为被增强的个体，并将这一方向上的开放性问题表述为一个研究纲领。 我们没有提出任何新算法；本文的主张在于其框架构建、设计空间的组织以及它所设定的证据标准。 我们希望这一概念能够引领智能体研究的新范式，在这一范式中，进步的衡量标准是每一个具体的人变得更有能力了多少。

paragraphs.en: This section sets up the coordinate system used throughout the paper. The vertical axis is the relationship: four roles the AI has played with a person, in the order in which each became technically possible. The horizontal axis is existence: two forms an intelligent individual can take. We then place the paper in eighty years of work on the same question and state what has changed.
paragraphs.zh: 本节设定全文使用的坐标系。 纵轴是关系：AI 与一个人之间扮演过的四种角色，按每种角色在技术上成为可能的先后顺序排列。 横轴是存在形式：智能个体可以采取的两种形态。 随后我们把本文置于八十年来针对同一问题的研究脉络中，并说明发生了什么变化。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 divides the relationship between a person and an AI into four roles. Reading down the table, three properties change together. What the AI knows widens from the current message to a whole life. Where the AI sits moves from a chat window to a computer, to the cloud, and finally onto the body. And the value it offers shifts from giving the person information, to doing tasks for them, to doing those tasks their way, to making the person themselves more capable. The first three roles share an evaluation target, the AI, and the fourth changes it to the person.
paragraphs.zh: 表1将人与人工智能之间的关系划分为四种角色。 沿着表格从上往下看，有三个属性在同步变化。 人工智能所知的内容从当前消息扩展到整个人生。 人工智能所处的位置从聊天窗口移动到计算机，再到云端，最后落到身体上。 它提供的价值也从向人提供信息，转变为替人完成任务，再转变为按人的方式完成这些任务，最终转变为使人自身更有能力。 前三种角色共享同一个评估目标，即人工智能，而第四种角色将其转变为人本身。

paragraphs.en: • Scored on: what the AI produced how much stronger the person became. • Role letters are reused in Table 11 .
paragraphs.zh: • 评分依据：AI 产出成果在多大程度上使人变得更强。 • 角色字母在表 11 中被重复使用。

paragraphs.en: The third role deserves an accurate description, since it is the closest existing relative of the fourth. The personal agents released in 2026, such as Meta’s Muse ( Meta, 2026a ) , xAI’s Grok Bot ( GIGAZINE, 2026 ) , and OpenAI’s Dots ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , already track long-term goals, run continuously in the background, and learn preferences. 2 2 2 Capabilities as described at launch; we do not evaluate these products here. It would be inaccurate to describe them as systems that merely complete tasks. The difference from the fourth role is one of position and purpose: a personal agent acts for the person from the cloud, while a symbiont thinks with the person at their side. The fourth role includes the first three. A symbiont has to be a competent autonomous agent and a competent personal agent before it can be anything more (Section 9.1 ), and the four roles can coexist inside one system. We therefore read the table as four solutions to one problem under four technical conditions, and we avoid reading it as an inevitable sequence of eras.
paragraphs.zh: 第三个角色值得准确描述，因为它是第四个角色现存最接近的近亲。 2026 年发布的个人智能体，例如 Meta 的 Muse（Meta, 2026a）、xAI 的 Grok Bot（GIGAZINE, 2026）和 OpenAI 的 Dots（OpenAI, 2026），已经能够跟踪长期目标、在后台持续运行并学习用户偏好。2 2 2 此处描述的是发布时所具备的能力；我们在此不对这些产品进行评估。 把它们描述为仅仅完成任务系统是不准确的。 它与第四个角色的区别在于位置和目的：个人智能体在云端替人行事，而共生体在人身旁与人共同思考。 第四个角色包含了前三个角色。 共生体必须先成为称职的自主智能体和称职的个人智能体，才能更进一步（第 9.1 节），而这四种角色可以在同一个系统内共存。 因此，我们把这张表解读为在四种技术条件下对同一问题的四种解决方案，并避免把它解读为一条不可避免的时代演进序列。

paragraphs.en: On the horizontal axis, we foresee, there are two ways for an intelligent individual to exist in the future world of Physical AI (Figure 4 ). An AI-augmented individual is a real person who gains a symbiont through wearables and other interfaces. The person remains the subject: the goals are theirs, the body is theirs, and the AI borrows their senses and their hands. An AI as individual is an embodied robot with its own body, perception, actions, and goals. The two forms matter equally for the future we describe, and this paper is concerned only with the first. Our central claim about the pair is that they share a cognitive core : long-term memory, a model of the situation and of other minds, timely intervention, and learning from experience. They differ in three places only: whose goals, whose body, and whose responsibility. The cognitive capabilities developed in Sections 6 to 10 therefore transfer to embodied robots, and this is the source of the paradigm’s generality; Section 14.2 returns to it. The third column of Figure 4 , AI-driven devices in the environment, appears in the paper only as the symbiont’s extended reach into the physical world (Section 14.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 如图4所示，我们预见在横轴上，有智能的个体在未来具身智能（Physical AI）世界中有两种存在方式。 AI增强型个体是一个真实的人，通过可穿戴设备及其他接口获得一个共生体。 人依然是主体：目标属于人，身体属于人，而AI借用人的感官与双手。 AI个体型则是拥有自己身体、感知、行动与目标的具身机器人。 这两种形态对于我们所述的未来同等重要，而本文只关注第一种。 我们对这一组合的核心论断是：二者共享一个认知核心，即长期记忆、对情境及他人心智的模型、及时干预，以及从经验中学习。 它们仅在三个方面有所不同：目标属于谁、身体属于谁、责任属于谁。 因此，第6至10节中开发的认知能力可以迁移到具身机器人上，这正是该范式具有通用性的来源；第14.2节将回到这一点。 图4的第三列，即环境中的AI驱动设备，在本文中仅作为共生体向物理世界的延伸而出现（第14.2节）。

paragraphs.en: Using machines to augment the human intellect is an old question, and Table 2 places the paper inside that lineage. Licklider (1960) imagined people and computers thinking together in real time; Engelbart (1962) made the unit of augmentation the person together with their tools and methods; Clark and Chalmers (1998) argued that cognition can extend into external tools; Weiser (1991) and the first wearable computing researchers ( Starner et al., 1997 ; Mann, 1997 ) put computing into daily life and onto the body; and lifelogging, from Bush ’s Memex ( 1945 ) through MyLifeBits ( Gemmell et al., 2006 ) and SenseCam ( Hodges et al., 2006 ) , recorded a life and showed that the record could support memory. More recent neighbors are egocentric AI ( Grauman et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , mixed-initiative interaction ( Horvitz, 1999 ; Amershi et al., 2019 ) , just-in-time adaptive interventions in mobile health ( Nahum-Shani et al., 2018 ) , the thought-partner program of Collins et al. (2024) , and the lifecycle view of context engineering ( Hua et al., 2025 ) . For each line the table records what has been settled and what we ask next, and each of those questions is taken up in a later section. Our claim with respect to these lines is a narrow one: none of them has taken, as its target, the augmentation of a particular person across a life.

paragraphs.en: Five conditions turn an eighty-year-old question into a tractable research problem, and each is developed in the next section. Foundation models understand language, images, and sound and can reason over them, so that a symbiont has, for the first time, a brain (Section 3.1 ). Agent technology lets a model plan, use tools, operate a computer, and run for a long time, so that it has hands (Section 3.2 ). Long-term memory, retrieval, and context management let it keep an understanding of one person across months and years (Section 3.3 ). World models let it begin to predict what the environment and the person will do next (Section 3.4 ). And wearable devices have matured to the point where first-person audio and video can be captured all day and a reply can be delivered to the ear with low latency, so that the symbiont can have senses and be present (Section 3.5 ). What has not changed matters equally: the social infrastructure of privacy and trust, the observability of inner states, the stability of continual learning, and the cost of computing around the clock. These are the sources of Sections 12 and 17 .
paragraphs.zh: 五个条件将一个有八十年历史的问题转变为一个可着手研究的问题，接下来的章节将逐一展开。 基础模型能够理解语言、图像和声音并进行推理，从而使共生体首次拥有了一个大脑（第3.1节）。 智能体技术让模型能够规划、使用工具、操作计算机并长时间运行，从而使它拥有了双手（第3.2节）。 长期记忆、检索与上下文管理让它能够在数月乃至数年间始终保持对一个人的理解（第3.3节）。 世界模型让它开始能够预测环境以及这个人接下来会做什么（第3.4节）。 而可穿戴设备已经成熟到可以全天捕捉第一人称的音频和视频，并能以低延迟将回复传送到耳边，从而使共生体能够拥有感官并保持在场（第3.5节）。 没有改变的部分同样重要：隐私与信任的社会基础设施、内在状态的可观测性、持续学习的稳定性，以及全天候计算的成本。 这些是第12节和第17节的素材来源。

paragraphs.en: A symbiont is built on technologies that already exist and are improving quickly. This section reads five of them for one purpose: to state, for each, what it already provides and what it still lacks. The gaps, collected in Table 3 , are the research space of the rest of the paper. Figure 5 shows how the five lines stack up and where the layer this paper proposes sits. We keep to a few representative works per line, report no benchmark numbers, and end every subsection with what the line means for a symbiont.

paragraphs.en: The brain of a symbiont comes from four steps in the development of foundation models. Scale came first: the Transformer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) , in-context learning at the scale of GPT-3 ( Brown et al., 2020 ) , and the scaling laws that made the next steps predictable ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) . Alignment made the models usable by ordinary people in ordinary language ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) , and GPT-4 ( OpenAI, 2023 ) together with openly released weights ( Touvron et al., 2023 ) spread the capability. Reasoning followed, from chain-of-thought prompting ( Wei et al., 2022 ) to models that think before they answer ( OpenAI, 2024b ; Guo et al., 2025 ) ; this is what makes the slow loop of Section 8.2 possible. The fourth step is the one that matters most here. Multimodal and then omni-modal models took images into the language model ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Alayrac et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) , then speech and video in real time ( OpenAI, 2024a ; Gemini Team, 2024 ) , then any-to-any input and output ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025a ) , and full-duplex speech models learned to listen and speak at the same time ( Défossez et al., 2024 ) . Context windows of a million tokens made the inclusion of an entire day in the context window expensive rather than impossible. For a symbiont, omni-modality is a requirement: its input is a first-person stream of sight and sound and its output is a whisper or a line of text, and a model that only reads and writes text never reaches the scene. What foundation models lack can be stated with equal precision. They have no persistence, since each conversation starts from nothing; no sense of time; no body; and they are trained on the average person and know nothing about the one in front of them. Sections 6 , 8 , 5 , and 7 answer these four gaps in turn.
paragraphs.zh: 共生体的“大脑”来自基础模型发展中的四个步骤。 规模先行：Transformer（Vaswani 等，2017）、GPT-3 规模的上下文学习（Brown 等，2020），以及让后续步骤变得可预测的缩放定律（Kaplan 等，2020；Hoffmann 等，2022）。 对齐使普通人能够用日常语言使用这些模型（Ouyang 等，2022），而 GPT-4（OpenAI，2023）连同开放发布的权重（Touvron 等，2023）传播了这种能力。 推理紧随其后，从思维链提示（Wei 等，2022）发展到先思考再回答的模型（OpenAI，2024b；Guo 等，2025）；正是这一点使第 8.2 节的慢循环成为可能。 第四步是这里最关键的一步。 多模态乃至全模态模型先是把图像带入语言模型（Radford 等，2021；Alayrac 等，2022；Liu 等，2023），然后实时接入语音和视频（OpenAI，2024a；Gemini Team，2024），再实现任意到任意的输入输出（Wu 等，2024；Xu 等，2025a），而全双工语音模型学会了同时听与说（Défossez 等，2024）。 百万 token 级的上下文窗口，使得把一整天纳入上下文窗口从不可能变成仅仅是昂贵。 对共生体而言，全模态是必要条件：它的输入是第一人称的视觉与声音流，输出是一句耳语或一行文字，而只会读写文本的模型永远触及不到场景。 基础模型所缺乏的东西，也可以同样精确地表述。 它们没有持久性，因为每次对话都从零开始；没有时间感；没有身体；它们是针对普通人训练的，对眼前这个具体的人一无所知。 第 6、8、5 和 7 节将依次回应这四个缺口。

sents.en: For a symbiont, omni-modality is a requirement: its input is a first-person stream of sight and sound and its output is a whisper or a line of text, and a model that only reads and writes text never reaches the scene.

sents.en: What foundation models lack can be stated with equal precision.
sents.zh: 基础模型所缺乏的东西，也可以同样精确地表述。

sents.en: They have no persistence, since each conversation starts from nothing; no sense of time; no body; and they are trained on the average person and know nothing about the one in front of them.
sents.zh: 它们没有持久性，因为每次对话都从零开始；没有时间感；没有身体；它们是针对普通人训练的，对眼前这个具体的人一无所知。

sents.en: Sections 6 , 8 , 5 , and 7 answer these four gaps in turn.
sents.zh: 第 6、8、5 和 7 节将依次回应这四个缺口。

paragraphs.en: An agent is a model system that repeatedly observes, thinks, and acts toward a goal. A harness is everything outside the model that turns it into an agent: the loop itself, tool interfaces, memory, context management, planning and decomposition, permissions and sandboxing, verification of results, and reusable procedural knowledge, often called skills. The same model placed in different harnesses performs very differently, a fact that recurs across published results on coding agents, and it makes the harness a research object in its own right. The line of work runs from interleaving reasoning with action ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , learning to call tools ( Schick et al., 2023 ) , and reflecting on failure ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , to agents that build a library of reusable skills ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , which is an early precedent for a harness that improves itself (Section 10.4 ). Generative Agents gave agents a memory stream, reflection, and planning ( Park et al., 2023 ) , which remains the closest academic prototype of an agent with a life, and CoALA organized these components in the language of cognitive architectures ( Sumers et al., 2024 ) . On the engineering side, Anthropic’s guide to building agents argued for simple, composable patterns and for the agent–computer interface as something to be designed ( Schluntz and Zhang, 2024 ) ; SWE-agent showed that an interface built for the agent changes its performance ( Yang et al., 2024 ) ; computer-use agents learned to operate any desktop or web page ( Anthropic, 2024a ; OpenAI, 2025b ) ; the Model Context Protocol standardized tool access ( Anthropic, 2024b ) ; and coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex became the first autonomous agents in large-scale daily use ( Anthropic, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2025a ) . In 2026 Muse and Dots pushed agents into personal life, and the Muse Gadget SDK for embedded platforms is a sign that agent platforms are reaching into devices ( Meta, 2026a ; Meta, 2026b ; OpenAI, 2026 ) . The benchmarks of the field all score task completion ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2025 ; Mialon et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体是一种模型系统，它围绕某个目标反复进行观察、思考和行动。 脚手架是模型之外将其变为智能体的一切：循环本身、工具接口、记忆、上下文管理、规划与任务分解、权限与沙箱、结果验证，以及可复用的过程性知识——后者通常被称为技能。 同一个模型放进不同的脚手架中表现差异极大，这一事实在已发表的编码智能体相关结果中反复出现，也使脚手架本身成为一个研究对象。 这条研究脉络从将推理与行动交错进行（Yao et al., 2023）、学习调用工具（Schick et al., 2023）、对失败进行反思（Shinn et al., 2023），一直到构建可复用技能库的智能体（Wang et al., 2024），后者是能够自我改进的脚手架的早期先例（第 10.4 节）。 《生成式智能体》（Generative Agents）为智能体提供了记忆流、反思与规划（Park et al., 2023），它至今仍是最接近拥有“生活”的智能体的学术原型；CoALA 则以认知架构的语言组织了这些组件（Sumers et al., 2024）。 在工程方面，Anthropic 的智能体构建指南主张采用简单、可组合的模式，并将智能体—计算机接口视为需要专门设计的东西（Schluntz and Zhang, 2024）；SWE-agent 证明为智能体量身打造的接口会改变其性能（Yang et al., 2024）；计算机操作智能体学会了操作任意桌面或网页（Anthropic, 2024a；OpenAI, 2025b）；模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol）将工具访问标准化（Anthropic, 2024b）；而 Claude Code 和 Codex 等编码智能体成为最早进入大规模日常使用的自主智能体（Anthropic, 2025；OpenAI, 2025a）。 2026 年，Muse 和 Dots 将智能体推进到个人生活领域，面向嵌入式平台的 Muse Gadget SDK 表明智能体平台正在延伸至各类设备（Meta, 2026a；Meta, 2026b；OpenAI, 2026）。 该领域的各项基准测试都以任务完成情况作为评分标准（Zhou et al., 2024；Xie et al., 2024；Jimenez et al., 2024；Yao et al., 2025；Mialon et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: For a symbiont this line provides hands. Booking a trip, buying something, handling a desktop, writing code: today’s agents can already do these, and a symbiont delegates such work through its harness (Section 9.1 ). Beyond delegation, a symbiont is a new kind of harness, one organized around a life instead of a task (Section 11.3 ). Today’s harnesses are task-level: they have a beginning and an end, they are driven by requests, their tools are APIs, their memory is scoped to the task, and their score is completion. They have no body, no first-person senses, no model of the person, and no output that means “do nothing.” Sections 8 , 9 , and 11 take up these gaps.
paragraphs.zh: 对共生体而言，这条线提供了双手。 预订行程、购买商品、处理桌面、编写代码：今天的智能体已经能够做到这些，而共生体通过其框架（harness，见 9.1 节）将此类工作委托出去。 除了委托之外，共生体还是一种新型框架，一种围绕生活而非任务组织起来的框架（见 11.3 节）。 今天的框架都是任务层面的：它们有开始和结束，由请求驱动，其工具是 API，其记忆以任务为范围，其评分标准是完成度。 它们没有身体，没有第一人称的感知，没有关于人的模型，也没有意味着“什么都不做”的输出。第 8、9 和 11 章将讨论这些缺口。

paragraphs.en: Three kinds of work let a model remember a person. Memory systems grew from retrieval-augmented generation ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) to MemGPT, which brought the tiered storage of an operating system into the model ( Packer et al., 2023 ) ; to the memory stream and reflection of Generative Agents ( Park et al., 2023 ) and MemoryBank ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) ; to A-MEM, which lets memories link to one another and evolve ( Xu et al., 2025b ) ; to Mem0, a production-oriented long-term memory layer ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) ; and to sleep-time compute, which organizes memory while the system is idle ( Lin et al., 2025 ) . LoCoMo and LongMemEval measure long-conversation memory ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . Context management is the second kind: Context Engineering 2.0 describes a lifecycle of collecting, managing, and using context, and observes that the practice is shifting from prompting a model toward managing everything a long-running system knows ( Hua et al., 2025 ) ; long context, cache compression, hierarchical summaries, and on-demand loading are the engineering means. Personalization is the third: LaMP measures generation tailored to a user ( Salemi et al., 2024 ) ; parameter-efficient adaptation makes a small module per user feasible ( Hu et al., 2022 ) ; test-time training and its descendants change weights during use ( Sun et al., 2020 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Behrouz et al., 2025 ) ; and the continual-learning literature deals with forgetting. These are the direct foundation of Section 6 and the toolbox of Section 10 , and this paper does not require a new memory mechanism. What the line lacks follows from what it remembers, which is dialogue rather than a life. There is no first-person stream of sight and sound, no physiology, no distinction between what the person said and what the system inferred (Section 7.2 ), no views that switch with the question (Section 6.4 ), no distinction between short-lived context and settled knowledge (Section 6.1 ), no consistent treatment of forgetting and deletion (Section 6.5 ), and the personalization it offers optimizes for sounding like the person, which is a different thing from understanding them (Section 10.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 三类工作让模型能够记住一个人。 记忆系统的发展历程是：从检索增强生成（Lewis et al., 2020）到 MemGPT，它把操作系统的分层存储引入模型（Packer et al., 2023）；再到 Generative Agents 的记忆流与反思机制（Park et al., 2023）以及 MemoryBank（Zhong et al., 2024）；再到 A-MEM，它让记忆相互链接并不断演化（Xu et al., 2025b）；再到 Mem0，一个面向生产环境的长期记忆层（Chhikara et al., 2025）；最后是睡眠期计算，它在系统空闲时整理记忆（Lin et al., 2025）。 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval 用于衡量长对话记忆（Maharana et al., 2024；Wu et al., 2025）。 上下文管理是第二类：Context Engineering 2.0 描述了收集、管理和使用上下文的生命周期，并指出这一实践正在从对模型进行提示转向管理一个长期运行系统所知道的一切（Hua et al., 2025）；长上下文、缓存压缩、分层摘要和按需加载是其中的工程手段。 个性化是第三类：LaMP 衡量面向用户的定制化生成（Salemi et al., 2024）；参数高效适配使为每个用户配置一个小模块成为可能（Hu et al., 2022）；测试时训练及其后续方法在使用过程中改变权重（Sun et al., 2020；Sun et al., 2025；Behrouz et al., 2025）；而持续学习文献则处理遗忘问题。 这些是第 6 节的直接基础和第 10 节的工具箱，本文并不需要提出新的记忆机制。 这条路线的缺失之处源于它所记住的东西——那是对话，而不是一段人生。 没有第一人称的视听流，没有生理状态，没有区分这个人说了什么与系统推断出了什么（第 7.2 节），没有随问题而切换的观点（第 6.4 节），没有区分短暂上下文与已沉淀的知识（第 6.1 节），没有对遗忘与删除的一致处理（第 6.5 节），而且它所提供的个性化是为了让系统听起来像这个人，这与理解这个人是两回事（第 10.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: A world model is an internal model that predicts what happens next. One thread comes from reinforcement learning, where World Models and the Dreamer family plan in imagination ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2020 ; Hafner et al., 2025 ) . A second is the predictive-representation route of JEPA and V-JEPA 2 ( LeCun, 2022 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) . A third is generative world simulation at the pixel level: Genie and Genie 3, Sora, and Cosmos ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Parker-Holder and Fruchter, 2025 ; Brooks et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA, 2025 ) . A fourth is first-person data, which makes the world as seen through a person’s eyes a learnable object: Ego4D ( Grauman et al., 2022 ) , Project Aria and its second-generation research glasses ( Engel et al., 2023 ; Meta, 2025a ) , and EgoLife ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . A parallel thread models people. Large foundation models show real but brittle theory-of-mind ability ( Kosinski, 2024 ; Ullman, 2023 ; Strachan et al., 2024 ) . Park et al. (2024) built a generative agent for each of 1,052 real people from a two-hour interview and found that the agents reproduced their participants’ survey answers about as well as the participants reproduced their own answers two weeks later; it is the strongest evidence to date that a predictive model of a particular person can be built from a small amount of first-person narrative. Mental world modeling treats beliefs, intentions, and other mental variables as part of the world state itself ( Fei and Zhao, 2026 ) , which is the position this paper adopts for the mental side of the personal model (Section 7.5 ). For a symbiont, world models provide the ability to think ahead: to predict what is about to happen around the person (an external, physical world model) and how the person will think, feel, and react, including to a reminder (an internal, mental world model). Sections 7.4 and 7.5 show how both enter the personal model and why the system still stands, in a degraded form, without them. Today’s world models are third-person, short-horizon, and built once; the models of people are built from a single interview, never updated, and unable to tell that they have gone stale.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型是一种内部模型，用于预测接下来会发生什么。 第一条脉络来自强化学习，其中 World Models 和 Dreamer 系列在想象中进行规划（Ha 和 Schmidhuber，2018；Hafner 等，2020；Hafner 等，2025）。 第二条是 JEPA 和 V-JEPA 2 的预测表征路线（LeCun，2022；Assran 等，2025）。 第三条是像素级的生成式世界模拟：Genie 和 Genie 3、Sora 以及 Cosmos（Bruce 等，2024；Parker-Holder 和 Fruchter，2025；Brooks 等，2024；NVIDIA，2025）。 第四条是第一人称数据，它使一个人眼中的世界成为可学习的对象：Ego4D（Grauman 等，2022）、Project Aria 及其第二代研究眼镜（Engel 等，2023；Meta，2025a），以及 EgoLife（Yang 等，2025）。 与之并行的一条脉络是对人的建模。 大型基础模型展现出真实但脆弱的心智理论能力（Kosinski，2024；Ullman，2023；Strachan 等，2024）。Park 等。 （2024）基于两小时的访谈为 1,052 位真实的人各构建了一个生成式智能体，发现这些智能体对其参与者调查问卷答案的复现程度，与参与者本人在两周后复现自己答案的程度相当；这是迄今为止最有力的证据，表明可以从少量第一人称叙事中构建针对特定人的预测模型。 心智世界建模将信念、意图和其他心理变量视为世界状态本身的一部分（Fei 和 Zhao，2026），这也是本文在个人模型的心智侧所采取的立场（第 7.5 节）。 对于一个共生体而言，世界模型提供了提前思考的能力：预测这个人周围即将发生什么（外部的、物理的世界模型），以及这个人将如何思考、感受和作出反应，包括对提醒的反应（内部的、心智的世界模型）。 第 7.4 节和第 7.5 节展示了两者如何进入个人模型，以及在没有它们的情况下，系统为何仍能以退化形式继续成立。 如今的世界模型是第三人称的、短时程的、一次性构建的；而对人的模型则由单次访谈构建、从不更新，且无法察觉自己已经过时。

sents.en: A world model is an internal model that predicts what happens next.
sents.zh: 世界模型是一种内部模型，用于预测接下来会发生什么。

sents.en: One thread comes from reinforcement learning, where World Models and the Dreamer family plan in imagination ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2020 ; Hafner et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 第一条脉络来自强化学习，其中 World Models 和 Dreamer 系列在想象中进行规划（Ha 和 Schmidhuber，2018；Hafner 等，2020；Hafner 等，2025）。

sents.en: A second is the predictive-representation route of JEPA and V-JEPA 2 ( LeCun, 2022 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 第二条是 JEPA 和 V-JEPA 2 的预测表征路线（LeCun，2022；Assran 等，2025）。

sents.en: A third is generative world simulation at the pixel level: Genie and Genie 3, Sora, and Cosmos ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Parker-Holder and Fruchter, 2025 ; Brooks et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA, 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 第三条是像素级的生成式世界模拟：Genie 和 Genie 3、Sora 以及 Cosmos（Bruce 等，2024；Parker-Holder 和 Fruchter，2025；Brooks 等，2024；NVIDIA，2025）。

sents.en: A fourth is first-person data, which makes the world as seen through a person’s eyes a learnable object: Ego4D ( Grauman et al., 2022 ) , Project Aria and its second-generation research glasses ( Engel et al., 2023 ; Meta, 2025a ) , and EgoLife ( Yang et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 第四条是第一人称数据，它使一个人眼中的世界成为可学习的对象：Ego4D（Grauman 等，2022）、Project Aria 及其第二代研究眼镜（Engel 等，2023；Meta，2025a），以及 EgoLife（Yang 等，2025）。

sents.en: A parallel thread models people.
sents.zh: 与之并行的一条脉络是对人的建模。

sents.en: Large foundation models show real but brittle theory-of-mind ability ( Kosinski, 2024 ; Ullman, 2023 ; Strachan et al., 2024 ) . Park et al.
sents.zh: 大型基础模型展现出真实但脆弱的心智理论能力（Kosinski，2024；Ullman，2023；Strachan 等，2024）。Park 等。

sents.en: (2024) built a generative agent for each of 1,052 real people from a two-hour interview and found that the agents reproduced their participants’ survey answers about as well as the participants reproduced their own answers two weeks later; it is the strongest evidence to date that a predictive model of a particular person can be built from a small amount of first-person narrative.
sents.zh: （2024）基于两小时的访谈为 1,052 位真实的人各构建了一个生成式智能体，发现这些智能体对其参与者调查问卷答案的复现程度，与参与者本人在两周后复现自己答案的程度相当；这是迄今为止最有力的证据，表明可以从少量第一人称叙事中构建针对特定人的预测模型。

sents.en: Mental world modeling treats beliefs, intentions, and other mental variables as part of the world state itself ( Fei and Zhao, 2026 ) , which is the position this paper adopts for the mental side of the personal model (Section 7.5 ).
sents.zh: 心智世界建模将信念、意图和其他心理变量视为世界状态本身的一部分（Fei 和 Zhao，2026），这也是本文在个人模型的心智侧所采取的立场（第 7.5 节）。

sents.en: For a symbiont, world models provide the ability to think ahead: to predict what is about to happen around the person (an external, physical world model) and how the person will think, feel, and react, including to a reminder (an internal, mental world model).
sents.zh: 对于一个共生体而言，世界模型提供了提前思考的能力：预测这个人周围即将发生什么（外部的、物理的世界模型），以及这个人将如何思考、感受和作出反应，包括对提醒的反应（内部的、心智的世界模型）。

sents.en: Sections 7.4 and 7.5 show how both enter the personal model and why the system still stands, in a degraded form, without them.
sents.zh: 第 7.4 节和第 7.5 节展示了两者如何进入个人模型，以及在没有它们的情况下，系统为何仍能以退化形式继续成立。

sents.en: Today’s world models are third-person, short-horizon, and built once; the models of people are built from a single interview, never updated, and unable to tell that they have gone stale.
sents.zh: 如今的世界模型是第三人称的、短时程的、一次性构建的；而对人的模型则由单次访谈构建、从不更新，且无法察觉自己已经过时。

paragraphs.en: In three years the hardware conditions for senses and presence have changed in four places. On the head, Ray-Ban Meta glasses showed that ordinary people will wear a camera and microphones all day ( Meta, 2023 ) ; the Orion prototype and Meta Ray-Ban Display added a display ( Meta, 2024 ; Meta, 2025b ) , lightweight display glasses such as the Even G1 appeared ( Even Realities, 2024 ) , and Project Aria serves as a research platform ( Engel et al., 2023 ) . On the body, pendants and recorders capture all-day audio ( Mehta, 2024 ; Silberling, 2025 ; Plaud, 2024 ) , rings and bands capture physiology, and Meta’s surface-EMG wristband, published in Nature , trains a generic model on data from thousands of people so that a new wearer can type and gesture with no calibration, and twenty minutes of personal data improve it further ( Kaifosh et al., 2025 ) . This is a ready-made example of a generic model with a small personal adaptation on the input side, and Section 10.3 returns to it. Closer to the body, AlterEgo reads the muscle signals of silent, deliberate speech ( Kapur et al., 2018 ) , and brain–computer interfaces, noninvasive ( Lévy et al., 2025 ) and implanted ( Willett et al., 2023 ; Card et al., 2024 ) , remain in research and early clinical stages. In compute, neural accelerators in phones and glasses, together with quantization and distillation, run billion-parameter models on the device ( Gunter et al., 2024 ) ; low-power always-on event detection is the premise of the duty cycle in Section 5.5 ; and full-duplex speech models make listening while speaking feasible in latency. The counterexamples are instructive as well: the Humane AI Pin, a dedicated assistant device launched in 2024, was discontinued within a year ( Zeff, 2025 ) , which suggests that a new device has to offer something the phone in the person’s pocket does not. The first generation of senses, private output, and local compute therefore exists, and Section 5 can discuss design. What is missing can be listed: battery and heat limit what “all day” means, display glasses are far from a shared canvas, there is no mature model from physiology to mental state, silent speech and neural interfaces are at an early stage, and above all no device has been designed as one sense of one symbiont, since each is a separate product.
paragraphs.zh: 三年间，感知与临场感的硬件条件在四个方面发生了变化。 在头部，Ray-Ban Meta 眼镜表明普通人会全天佩戴摄像头和麦克风（Meta, 2023）；Orion 原型机和 Meta Ray-Ban Display 增加了显示器（Meta, 2024；Meta, 2025b），Even G1 等轻量显示眼镜问世（Even Realities, 2024），而 Project Aria 则作为研究平台（Engel et al., 2023）。 在身体上，吊坠和录音器捕获全天音频（Mehta, 2024；Silberling, 2025；Plaud, 2024），戒指和手环捕获生理信号，Meta 的表面肌电腕带发表于《自然》，它在数千人的数据上训练通用模型，使新佩戴者无需校准即可打字和做手势，而二十分钟的个人数据还能进一步改进（Kaifosh et al., 2025）。 这是输入侧通用模型加上少量个人适配的现成例子，第 10.3 节将回到这一点。 更贴近身体的方面，AlterEgo 读取无声、有意的言语的肌肉信号（Kapur et al., 2018），而脑机接口，无论非侵入式（Lévy et al., 2025）还是植入式（Willett et al., 2023；Card et al., 2024），仍处于研究和早期临床阶段。 在算力方面，手机和眼镜中的神经加速器，加上量化和蒸馏，可以在设备上运行十亿参数的模型（Gunter et al., 2024）；低功耗的常开事件检测是第 5.5 节中占空比的前提；全双工语音模型使边说边听在延迟上可行。 反例同样有启发意义：Humane AI Pin 是 2024 年推出的专用助手设备，不到一年便停产（Zeff, 2025），这表明新设备必须提供人们口袋里的手机所不具备的东西。 因此，第一代感知、私密输出和本地算力已经存在，第 5 节可以讨论设计。 缺失之处可以列出：电池和发热限制了「全天」的含义，显示眼镜远未成为共享画布，从生理状态到心理状态还没有成熟模型，无声语音和神经接口尚处早期，最重要的是，还没有任何设备被设计为一个共生体的一种感官，因为每一个都是独立的产品。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 collects the five lines, what each gives, and what each lacks, and maps every gap to the section that addresses it. The five lines are each growing stronger, and none of them has, as its goal, the augmentation of one particular person. Organizing them toward that goal is the task of the conceptual framework in the next section.
paragraphs.zh: 表3汇总了这五条路线、各自的贡献与不足，并将每一个缺口对应到解决它的章节。 这五条路线各自都在不断发展壮大，而且它们的目标都不是增强某一个特定的人。 将它们组织起来以实现这一目标，是下一节概念框架的任务。

paragraphs.en: • Badges mark the stage of the symbiosis loop (Figure 6 ) that each line mostly serves: sense and interact, keep, understand, live alongside, grow.
paragraphs.zh: • 徽章标记每行主要服务的共生循环（图 6）的阶段：感知与交互、保留、理解、共同生活、成长。

paragraphs.en: This section gives the vision a theoretical shape. We first define the objects, then state the invariant that runs through the paper, then list the properties a symbiont must have and test them against the fictional reference everyone knows, and finally draw the map that organizes the research space. The pattern throughout is definition, formalization, example.
paragraphs.zh: 本节为这一愿景赋予理论形态。 我们首先定义对象，然后阐述贯穿全文的不变式，接着列出共生体必须具备的性质并以人人皆知的虚构参照物加以检验，最后绘出组织研究空间的图谱。 全文的模式是：定义、形式化、举例。

sents.en: This section gives the vision a theoretical shape.
sents.zh: 本节为这一愿景赋予理论形态。

sents.en: We first define the objects, then state the invariant that runs through the paper, then list the properties a symbiont must have and test them against the fictional reference everyone knows, and finally draw the map that organizes the research space.
sents.zh: 我们首先定义对象，然后阐述贯穿全文的不变式，接着列出共生体必须具备的性质并以人人皆知的虚构参照物加以检验，最后绘出组织研究空间的图谱。

sents.en: The pattern throughout is definition, formalization, example.
sents.zh: 全文的模式是：定义、形式化、举例。

paragraphs.en: Five definitions turn the slogan “an AI that knows you better than you know yourself” into a claim that can be examined and disputed.
paragraphs.zh: 五个定义将“一个比你更了解你自己的人工智能”这一口号转化为一个可以被检验和质疑的主张。

paragraphs.en: The cognitive gap is the invariant of the paper. It measures something other than intelligence: the price every person pays, every day, in what they forgot, failed to notice, could not think through, or could not put into words. A researcher who, writing a new paper, cannot recall an argument she made in a blog post three years ago is paying it, and so is a parent who snaps at a child because the sleepless night is not in working memory as an explanation. The job of a symbiont is to shrink G t G_{t} : to return to the person, at the right moment, the part of their own context that is out of reach. Mind reading is not required; what is required is that the right slice of C t h C^{h}_{t} be placed into c t c_{t} , or that the reasoning or the errand the person would have undertaken, given the time, be carried out on their behalf.
paragraphs.zh: 认知鸿沟是本文的不变量。 它度量的并非智力，而是每个人每天都付出的代价——他们忘记了的、没有注意到的、无法想通的、或无法用语言表达的东西。 一位研究者在撰写新论文时，想不起自己三年前在一篇博文中提出的论点，就是在付出这种代价；一位家长因为熬夜失眠（而这一原因并未保留在工作记忆中）而对孩子发脾气，同样是在付出这种代价。 共生体的任务是缩小 G t G_{t}：在恰当的时机，把本人力所不及的那部分自身上下文归还给本人。 这不需要读心术；所需要的是，把 C t h C^{h}_{t} 中恰当的部分置入 c t c_{t}，或者代其完成原本若有时间本会去进行的推理或差事。

sents.zh: 认知鸿沟是本文的不变量。

paragraphs.en: Condition (vi) is also where this paper draws the boundary that the extended mind ( Clark and Chalmers, 1998 ) leaves open for a tool that learns and takes initiative: the symbiont extends what the person can bring to a situation, and judgment and goals stay with the person.
paragraphs.zh: 条件（vi）也是本文划定界限的地方，这一界限正是延展心智（Clark and Chalmers, 1998）为一个能够学习并主动采取行动的工具所留下的开放空间：共生体扩展了个人在特定情境中所能带来的能力，而判断力和目标仍保留在个人手中。

paragraphs.en: The definitions settle the boundary with AGI in one line: AGI raises U ⁡ ( ⋅ , s ) U(\cdot;\,s) , and AHI raises U ⁡ ( ⋅ , h ⊕ s ) U(\cdot;\,h\oplus s) . Two cautions apply to the notation. U U is a situation-specific outcome and is never summed across situations, and ⊕ \oplus marks a coupling condition rather than an arithmetic operation. The formulas serve to remove ambiguity, and no theorem is derived from them.

paragraphs.en: Table 4 lists six properties a symbiont must have. Four of them, private, real-time, low-friction, and embedded, come directly from what makes the system usable in the middle of a life; lifelong and proactive are added because without the first the gap cannot close across time, and without the second the person cannot ask about what they do not know they are missing. The properties pull against one another: being proactive conflicts with being low-friction, and being lifelong conflicts with being private. Those tensions are exactly the research problems of Sections 8 and 12 . “All day” is read throughout as availability, never as continuous computation (Section 5.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表 4 列出了一个共生体必须具备的六项性质。 其中四项——私密的、实时的、低摩擦的、嵌入的——直接来自让系统能在生活中间被使用的那些条件；终身的和主动的则是补充项，因为如果没有前者，鸿沟就无法随时间闭合，而如果没有后者，人就无法询问自己不知道缺失的东西。 这些性质相互牵制：主动与低摩擦相冲突，终身与私密相冲突。 这些张力恰恰就是第 8 节和第 12 节的研究问题。全文中「一整天」都应理解为可用性，而绝非持续计算（第 5.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 is the map of the research space and the table of contents of Part II. The person sits at the center. Around them runs a loop: sense and interact (borrowed senses, borrowed voice, and digital traces), keep (live context, working state, and lifelong knowledge), understand (a model of the person’s situation, mind, relations, and goals, built on a replaceable backbone), live alongside (real-time, private, proactive participation, with silence as one of the formal outputs), act for and think with (the ladder of help from errands to thinking to social life, the help stage for short), and grow (learning from outcomes and updating the record, the model, the policy, and eventually the whole stack). Beneath the loop is the runtime that makes it run across devices and time; around it is trust , which governs authorization, privacy, correction, and exit. One feature of the figure is deliberate: the person’s own words enter the record directly, without passing through inference. Of the technology lines in Section 3 , agents and memory research cover mostly the keep stage and the errand end of the help stage. The weakest stages are the mental layer of understanding, the timing of participation, online learning and whole-stack evolution, and the treatment of trust as architecture. The figure is a conceptual map rather than a system architecture, and it does not require a monolithic implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 图6是研究空间的地图，也是第二部分的目录。 人位于中心。 环绕着人的是一个循环：感知与交互（借用的感官、借用的声音以及数字痕迹）、保存（实时上下文、工作状态和终身知识）、理解（建立在可替换骨干之上的关于人的处境、心智、关系和目标的模型）、陪伴生活（实时的、私密的、主动的参与，沉默是正式输出之一）、代为行动与共同思考（帮助阶梯，从跑腿到思考再到社交生活，简称帮助阶段），以及成长（从结果中学习并更新记录、模型、策略，最终更新整个技术栈）。 循环之下是使其能够跨设备、跨时间运行的运行时；环绕其外的是信任，它支配着授权、隐私、纠错和退出。 图中有一个刻意的特征：人自己的话语直接进入记录，而不经过推断。 在第3节的技术路线中，智能体与记忆研究主要覆盖保存阶段和帮助阶梯中跑腿的那一端。 最薄弱的环节是理解的心理层、参与的时机、在线学习与整个技术栈的演化，以及将信任视为架构一部分的处理方式。 该图是一幅概念地图而非系统架构，它并不要求单体式的实现。

paragraphs.en: The paper does not claim that an AI can read thoughts that were never expressed; that everyone should wear devices all day; that a complete context is a precondition for the system to work (Section 12.2 shows it must be useful under partial context); that a symbiont outperforms the person in every domain; that the four roles of Section 2.1 are inevitable historical stages; that any one foundation model, or any one way of organizing a system around it, is the only correct backbone (Section 7.4 ); that it proposes a form of foundation model or a route to general intelligence (Section 1.1 ); that a symbiont raises a trait such as intelligence or emotional skill (Section 15.3 ); that its use is legitimate in every setting (Section 16.2 ); or that any interface standard or protocol should be adopted. It claims that this is a research direction worth organizing on its own, with its own invariant, properties, design space, and standard of evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 本文并不主张：AI 能够读取从未被表达出来的想法；所有人都应全天佩戴设备；完整的上下文是系统运行的前提条件（12.2 节表明它在部分上下文下必须是有用的）；共生体在所有领域都优于人类本人；2.1 节的四个角色是必然的历史阶段；任何单一基础模型，或任何围绕它组织系统的方式，是唯一正确的主干（7.4 节）；它提出的是一种基础模型或一条通往通用智能的路线（1.1 节）；共生体会提升诸如智力或情感技能之类的特质（15.3 节）；它在所有场景中的使用都是正当的（16.2 节）；或应采纳任何接口标准或协议。 它主张的是，这是一个值得作为独立领域来组织的研究方向，拥有自身的不变量、性质、设计空间和证据标准。

Hardware here is the symbiont’s borrowed body: borrowed senses on the way in, a borrowed voice and a borrowed canvas on the way out. The borrowed hands, devices in the environment, wait until Section 14.2 .

paragraphs.en: An embodied robot comes with eyes, ears, and a mouth. A symbiont has none of its own and must borrow three things: the sensors on a person’s body, so that it sees what they see and hears what they hear; the person’s digital traces on screens, in documents, in code, and in messages; and a channel of output that only the person receives, a voice in the ear, a line in the glasses, a picture laid over the world. Its perception is therefore first-person, incomplete, and moving with the person, and its speech is close to the ear, short, and tied to the setting the person is in. The quality of the senses sets the ceiling on understanding and the quality of the voice sets the floor on help, and neither is the goal in itself. This is also the sense in which hardware and AI are the same project, which Section 5.6 develops.
paragraphs.zh: 具身机器人自带眼睛、耳朵和嘴巴。 共生体则一无所有，必须借用三样东西：人身上的传感器，使它看见人所见、听见人所听；人留下的数字痕迹，包括屏幕上的、文档里的、代码中的和消息中的；以及一条只有本人才能接收的输出通道，比如耳中的声音、眼镜上的一行字、叠加在世界之上的一幅图像。 因此，它的感知是第一人称的、不完整的，并随人而移动；它的言语贴近耳畔、简短，并与人物当下的情境紧密相连。 感官的质量决定了理解的上限，语音的质量决定了帮助的下限，而这两者本身都不是目标。 这也是硬件与人工智能属于同一项工程的意义所在，5.6 节将对此展开论述。

paragraphs.en: No single device can carry all of this, so a symbiont senses and speaks through a constellation (Figure 7 ): glasses with a first-person camera, microphones, eye tracking, and a one-line display; a pendant or pin that records audio and takes snapshots all day and stands in when glasses are not worn; earbuds or bone conduction for private voice output; a microphone close to the mouth so that the person can speak to it at the level of a breath without being overheard; a ring, watch, or band for heart rate, sleep, and activity, and increasingly for EMG gestures; a phone for compute and a screen on the move; and a desktop with authorized access to screen content, the IDE, documents, and meeting software. Each device carries a role on the way in, on the way out, or both, and a runtime (Section 11 ) manages them as one. Table 5 lists the signal sources and what each reveals about the physical and the mental side of a life.
paragraphs.zh: 没有单一设备能承载所有这一切，因此共生体通过一组设备（图 7）来感知和发声：具备第一视角摄像头、麦克风、眼动追踪和单行显示的眼镜；一整天记录音频并抓拍快照、在未佩戴眼镜时代替其工作的吊坠或胸针；用于私密语音输出的耳机或骨传导设备；靠近嘴边的麦克风，让人可以以耳语般的音量对其说话而不被旁人听到；用于心率、睡眠和活动监测、且日益支持肌电（EMG）手势的戒指、手表或手环；用于提供算力并随身显示的屏幕的手机；以及被授权访问屏幕内容、IDE、文档和会议软件的台式电脑。 每台设备在输入端、输出端或两端都承担一个角色，而一个运行时（第 11 节）将它们作为整体统一管理。 表 5 列出了各种信号来源，以及每种信号能揭示一个人身体层面与心理层面的哪些信息。

paragraphs.en: Two further classes of device belong in the constellation even though they are not yet in daily use, and the first of them may become the most valuable wearable of all. Neural interfaces read the body’s own signals of intention and attention. At the surface of the body, EMG wristbands already decode the motor commands behind typing and gesture ( Kaifosh et al., 2025 ) , and electrodes in a headband or around the ear record the electrical activity of the brain, in many studies with results comparable to scalp recording ( Kaongoen et al., 2023 ) ; implanted interfaces, now in early clinical trials, decode attempted speech at far higher fidelity ( Willett et al., 2023 ; Card et al., 2024 ) . For a symbiont these interfaces matter for a specific reason. They are the channel through which a deliberate command could one day reach the symbiont without being spoken, typed, or acted out, at a lower cost to the person than any other channel. What they may read is held to the rule of every input channel (Section 5.4 ): commands the person directs to the symbiont, with states such as attention or fatigue read only under separate authorization. They are also the channel in which the privacy of thought (Section 12.4 ) is at its most literal, so the paper places them at the far end of the constellation, with the highest ceiling and the strictest conditions, and treats their maturation as part of the hardware problem of Section 17.4 . The second class is the environment itself: cameras and microphones in the home, the cabin sensors and head-up display of a car, the instruments of a laboratory, eye-tracking contact lenses, haptic garments, and medical implants such as continuous glucose monitors. These enter the constellation on the same terms as the wearables, each with a role on the way in or out, separate authorization, and management by one runtime, and they are where the symbiont’s senses turn into reach (Section 14.2 ). We therefore treat the full list of modalities in three tiers. Sight, sound, text, and digital traces are the bulk of what is usable today; physiology, motion, and gaze are collectable now and need research into their interpretation; and neural signals run from available, in surface EMG, through research, in non-invasive recording, to distant, in implanted interfaces, with the chemical senses furthest of all. “Omni” means that whatever signal arrives can be used; it does not require that every signal be collected.
paragraphs.zh: 还有两类设备属于这个星座，尽管它们尚未进入日常使用，其中第一类可能成为最有价值的可穿戴设备。 神经接口读取身体自身的意图与注意信号。 在身体表面，肌电（EMG）腕带已经能够解码打字与手势背后的运动指令（ Kaifosh et al., 2025 ），而头带或耳周电极可记录大脑的电活动，许多研究的结果与头皮记录相当（ Kaongoen et al., 2023 ）；植入式接口目前处于早期临床试验阶段，能以高得多的保真度解码想要说出的话语（ Willett et al., 2023 ; Card et al., 2024 ）。 对于共生体而言，这些接口之所以重要，有一个特定原因。 它们是这样的通道：有朝一日，一个刻意的指令可以不经言语、打字或动作就到达共生体，而且对人的成本低于任何其他通道。 它们可能读取的内容同样受每条输入通道的规则约束（第 5.4 节）：即人指向共生体的指令，而注意力或疲劳等状态只有在单独授权下才能读取。 它们也是思维隐私（第 12.4 节）最为字面意义的所在，因此本文将它们置于星座的最远端，拥有最高的上限和最严格的条件，并将其成熟过程视为第 17.4 节硬件问题的一部分。 第二类是环境本身：家中的摄像头与麦克风、汽车内的座舱传感器与抬头显示、实验室的仪器、眼动追踪隐形眼镜、触觉服装，以及连续血糖监测仪等医疗植入物。 这些以与可穿戴设备相同的条款进入星座，各自在输入或输出路径上扮演一个角色、需单独授权、并由同一个运行时管理，它们正是共生体的感官转变为触达能力之处（第 14.2 节）。 因此，我们分三个层级来处理完整的模态清单。 视觉、声音、文本和数字痕迹是当今可用信息的主体；生理、运动和注视现在即可采集，但对其解读仍需研究；神经信号则从可用的表面肌电，到研究阶段的非侵入式记录，再到遥远的植入式接口，而化学感官是最遥远的。「全模态」意味着任何到达的信号都可以被使用；它并不要求采集每一种信号。

sents.en: Two further classes of device belong in the constellation even though they are not yet in daily use, and the first of them may become the most valuable wearable of all.
sents.zh: 还有两类设备属于这个星座，尽管它们尚未进入日常使用，其中第一类可能成为最有价值的可穿戴设备。

sents.en: Neural interfaces read the body’s own signals of intention and attention.
sents.zh: 神经接口读取身体自身的意图与注意信号。

sents.en: At the surface of the body, EMG wristbands already decode the motor commands behind typing and gesture ( Kaifosh et al., 2025 ) , and electrodes in a headband or around the ear record the electrical activity of the brain, in many studies with results comparable to scalp recording ( Kaongoen et al., 2023 ) ; implanted interfaces, now in early clinical trials, decode attempted speech at far higher fidelity ( Willett et al., 2023 ; Card et al., 2024 ) .

sents.zh: 对于共生体而言，这些接口之所以重要，有一个特定原因。

sents.en: They are the channel through which a deliberate command could one day reach the symbiont without being spoken, typed, or acted out, at a lower cost to the person than any other channel.

sents.en: What they may read is held to the rule of every input channel (Section 5.4 ): commands the person directs to the symbiont, with states such as attention or fatigue read only under separate authorization.

sents.en: The second class is the environment itself: cameras and microphones in the home, the cabin sensors and head-up display of a car, the instruments of a laboratory, eye-tracking contact lenses, haptic garments, and medical implants such as continuous glucose monitors.

paragraphs.en: • Burden: low medium high; the note names who carries it. • Horizon: usable now research distant. • Modality letters: vision, audio, whispered speech, gaze, physiology, gesture, neural, digital traces, motion, surroundings.
paragraphs.zh: • 负担：低 中 高；注释中标明由谁承担。• 时间范围：现在可用 研究 遥远。• 模态字母：视觉、听觉、耳语、注视、生理、手势、神经、数字痕迹、动作、周围环境。

paragraphs.en: How the symbiont speaks to the person decides whether it can be used at all in a given setting, so output deserves the same attention as input. Table 6 lists the channels, from a word in the ear to a picture projected into a room. Three design rules follow. The strength of a message must match the setting: a line of text in a meeting, a sentence while walking, an expanded answer when the person is alone; and since the choice of channel is part of how the symbiont helps, it is one of the decision variables of the intervention policy in Section 8.4 . A private channel and a shared canvas are different instruments: the first lets the person receive help among people without disturbing them, the second lets the person and the symbiont, or the person and other people, look at the same picture and think about it together, and this second instrument, Jarvis’s holographic table, earns its place in collaboration and explanation. And every channel must support retraction and update: a cue that expires before delivery should never appear, and one overtaken by new information must be withdrawn (Section 8.2 ). The AR overlay deserves separate mention, because it is where the symbiont can draw its understanding onto the world the person sees: a name and the last topic discussed next to the person in front of them, the paragraph relevant to what they are thinking highlighted on the document on the desk, a route laid over a street in a city they do not know. Current single-eye displays with small fields of view make the first of these feasible today, and wide-field lightweight AR remains a research problem.
paragraphs.zh: 共生体如何向人说话，决定了它在特定场景下能否被使用，因此输出应获得与输入同等的重视。 表 6 列出了各种通道，从耳边的一个词到投射在房间里的图像。 由此得出三条设计规则。 信息的强度必须与场景匹配：开会时是一行文字，走路时是一句话，独处时是一段展开的回答；由于通道的选择本身就是共生体提供帮助的方式的一部分，它也是 8.4 节中干预策略的决策变量之一。 私人通道与共享画布是不同的工具：前者让人在人群中接收帮助而不打扰他人，后者让人与智能体、或人与其他人看着同一幅图并共同思考，而这第二种工具——贾维斯的全息桌面——在协作与解释中赢得了自己的位置。 而且每条通道都必须支持撤回与更新：在送达前就已过时的提示不应出现，而被新信息取代的提示必须撤回（8.2 节）。 AR 叠加层值得单独一提，因为智能体正是在这里把它对世界的理解绘制到人所看到的世界之上：在对面的人旁边显示其姓名和上次谈论的话题，在桌上的文档中高亮与当前思考相关的段落，在他们不熟悉的城市街道上叠加路线。 目前具有小视场的单眼显示设备使第一项在今天已经可行，而宽视场轻量化 AR 仍是一个研究课题。

paragraphs.en: • Carries: a cue or a word a sentence expanded content. • Noticed by others: ✗ no ◐ partly or depends ✓ yes. • Status: available now research prototypes far off.
paragraphs.zh: • 携带内容：一个线索或一个单词、一个句子、扩展内容。 • 是否被他人注意到：✗ 否 ◐ 部分或视情况而定 ✓ 是。 • 状态：现已可用 / 研究原型 / 尚为遥远。

paragraphs.en: Privacy, as a property, has two parts that the design keeps apart: what passes between the person and the symbiont belongs to the person, and its delivery can be discreet, so that the person can speak to the symbiont and hear from it without disturbing anyone nearby. On the way in, this means a breath-level microphone, very short gestures (an EMG band removes the need to raise a hand), and typed text; silent speech from muscle signals and neural interfaces lie further out, and the boundary we keep is the one AlterEgo marks, since it reads what a person deliberately subvocalizes and nothing else ( Kapur et al., 2018 ) , a rule that binds a neural interface as much as a microphone. On the way out, it means in-ear voice, a line in the glasses, and haptic cues, with strength and content matched to the setting. Three requirements that sound alike must be kept apart. That the content of the exchange stays the person’s is what the paper requires. That its delivery is discreet is a capability whose use follows the setting: where a setting presumes unaided performance or the sincerity of what is said, as an examination, a negotiation, or an apology does, whether the person is being assisted becomes a declarable fact, and declared presence is the default there (Sections 16.1 and 15.5 ). That a device record other people without their knowledge is what the paper rejects, and Section 12.5 sets the rules.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一种属性，隐私在设计中分为两个互不混淆的部分：人与共生体之间传递的内容属于个人，其传递方式可以做到不引人注意，使人能够与共生体对话并听取其回应而不打扰附近任何人。 在输入方向上，这意味着气声级的麦克风、极短的手势（一条 EMG 腕带让人无需抬手）以及键入的文字；来自肌肉信号和神经接口的无声语音尚在更远处，而我们守住的边界正是 AlterEgo 所标定的那条，因为它读取的仅是一个人有意的低声默语而无其他（Kapur et al., 2018），这一规则对神经接口与麦克风同样适用。 在输出方向上，这意味着入耳式语音、眼镜中的一行显示以及触觉提示，其强度和内容与所处情境相匹配。 有三个听起来相似的要求必须加以区分。 交流内容归个人所有，这是本文所要求的。 传递方式不引人注意则是一种能力，其使用随情境而定：在那些预设了不借助外力的表现或言语之真诚性的情境中，如考试、谈判或道歉，个人是否正在接受协助就成了可声明的事实，而在这些情境中默认必须声明智能体的在场（第 16.1 节与第 15.5 节）。 设备在他人不知情的情况下记录他人，这是本文所反对的，第 12.5 节规定了相关规则。

paragraphs.en: Companionship around the clock translates into a system requirement of availability: the symbiont can be reached and can pick up at any moment, which is a different thing from computing at full load at every moment. Battery life and latency are the two hard constraints, and the design that reconciles them is a cognitive duty cycle . Most of the time only lightweight event detection runs: someone says the person’s name, a meeting begins, their stress rises, they whisper. An event wakes heavier computation, and the quiet hours of the night are used for offline consolidation (Section 6.3 ). The structure mirrors human attention, which is also not continuous. It yields three research quantities: the recall and false-alarm rate of event detection, the latency budget from an event to a useful cue, and the daily energy and thermal budget. Low latency has to be written as an end-to-end budget: how many milliseconds each stage may take from sensor to model to ear, which stages can run on the device and which must go to the cloud, and which can be prepared in advance so that the fast loop of Section 8.2 finds its material ready. The duty cycle is also the first answer to the concern that round-the-clock AI depends on enormous compute; it turns the concern into an engineering quantity, and Section 11.4 completes the argument.
paragraphs.zh: 全天候的陪伴转化为系统对可用性的要求：共生体必须随时可以被唤起、随时可以接话，这与每一刻都满负荷运算并不是一回事。 电池续航与延迟是两个硬约束，而协调二者的设计就是一种认知占空比。 大多数时候只运行轻量的事件检测：有人喊这个人的名字、一场会议开始了、他的压力上升、他在低声耳语。 事件会唤醒较重的计算，而夜晚安静的时段则用于离线整合（见 6.3 节）。 这种结构映照了人类的注意力，后者同样不是连续的。 它引出三个研究量：事件检测的召回率与误报率、从事件到有用提示的延迟预算，以及每日的能耗与散热预算。 低延迟必须被写成一份端到端的预算：从传感器到模型再到耳朵，每一级允许多少毫秒、哪些环节可以在设备上运行、哪些必须交给云端，以及哪些可以提前准备好，以便 8.2 节的快速回路随取随用。 占空比也是对“全天候 AI 依赖巨量算力”这一担忧的第一个回答；它把这种担忧转化为一个工程量，11.4 节将完成这一论证。

sents.en: Most of the time only lightweight event detection runs: someone says the person’s name, a meeting begins, their stress rises, they whisper.
sents.zh: 大多数时候只运行轻量的事件检测：有人喊这个人的名字、一场会议开始了、他的压力上升、他在低声耳语。

sents.en: An event wakes heavier computation, and the quiet hours of the night are used for offline consolidation (Section 6.3 ).
sents.zh: 事件会唤醒较重的计算，而夜晚安静的时段则用于离线整合（见 6.3 节）。

sents.en: The structure mirrors human attention, which is also not continuous.
sents.zh: 这种结构映照了人类的注意力，后者同样不是连续的。

sents.en: It yields three research quantities: the recall and false-alarm rate of event detection, the latency budget from an event to a useful cue, and the daily energy and thermal budget.
sents.zh: 它引出三个研究量：事件检测的召回率与误报率、从事件到有用提示的延迟预算，以及每日的能耗与散热预算。

sents.en: Low latency has to be written as an end-to-end budget: how many milliseconds each stage may take from sensor to model to ear, which stages can run on the device and which must go to the cloud, and which can be prepared in advance so that the fast loop of Section 8.2 finds its material ready.
sents.zh: 低延迟必须被写成一份端到端的预算：从传感器到模型再到耳朵，每一级允许多少毫秒、哪些环节可以在设备上运行、哪些必须交给云端，以及哪些可以提前准备好，以便 8.2 节的快速回路随取随用。

sents.en: The duty cycle is also the first answer to the concern that round-the-clock AI depends on enormous compute; it turns the concern into an engineering quantity, and Section 11.4 completes the argument.
sents.zh: 占空比也是对“全天候 AI 依赖巨量算力”这一担忧的第一个回答；它把这种担忧转化为一个工程量，11.4 节将完成这一论证。

paragraphs.en: The form of the senses will change with the capability of the models, and the training targets of the models will change with new senses. From today’s recorders and glasses to EMG bands, silent speech, and eventually neural interfaces, each step makes it easier for the AI to understand what a person has in mind, and each step raises the level of privacy at stake. Two judgments follow from the recent record. A dedicated device that adds little to the phone does not last, as the AI pin of 2024 did not ( Zeff, 2025 ) , and a cognitive core without the right hardware never reaches the scene. Hardware and the core are one design problem, and Section 10.4 treats a change of device as one of the ways the whole stack evolves: the person changes their glasses, and their symbiont is still theirs.
paragraphs.zh: 感官的形式将随模型的能力而变化，模型的训练目标也将随新的感官而变化。 从今天的录音设备和眼镜，到肌电腕带、无声语音，最终到神经接口，每一步都让 AI 更容易理解一个人心中所想，每一步也都提高了所涉隐私的级别。 从近期的记录可以得出两个判断。 对手机没有多少增益的专用设备无法长久，2024 年的 AI pin 就是如此（Zeff, 2025），而没有合适硬件的认知核心也永远无法走向实际场景。 硬件与核心是一个设计问题，10.4 节将设备的更换视为整个技术栈演化的方式之一：这个人换掉了自己的眼镜，而他们的共生体仍然是他们的。

paragraphs.en: The senses of Section 5 deliver streams. This section asks how streams become something a symbiont can use: the live context of what the person is doing now, and the knowledge that stays valid across years. The two words are not interchangeable. Knowledge is what has settled; context is what is current, from the project the person is working on this week to the scene the glasses see this second. Both must be kept, and the claim that organizes the section is that one entry point has to receive all of a person’s context, work and life together, for the picture of the person to be rich enough for cognitive-level help.
paragraphs.zh: 第 5 节中描述的感知层提供数据流。 本节探讨数据流如何转化为共生体可以使用的资源：即关于此人当下正在做什么的实时上下文，以及能够跨越多年保持有效的知识。 这两个词不可互换。 知识是已经沉淀下来的内容；上下文则是当下的内容，小到这个人本周正在处理的项目，大到眼镜这一秒所看到的场景。 两者都必须保留，本节的核心论点是：必须有一个统一的入口来接收一个人的全部上下文，将工作与生活整合在一起，这样对个人的画像才足够丰富，从而实现认知层面的帮助。

paragraphs.en: Context is information relevant to what the person is doing now. It is short-lived, high-volume, and mostly discarded once used: where this conversation has got to, which file is open in the editor and which error it stopped on, what the glasses can see and who is present, what is on today’s calendar. Knowledge is what has settled out of many contexts and stays relevant across them. It is long-lived, curated, and comparatively small: facts about the person and their world, relationships, preferences, commitments, their history, the reasons they gave for things. Between the two lies a third layer, working state , which lives for days or weeks: the project being pushed forward, the discussion that has not been closed, the decision due this week. The project tree in which events and projects organize one another belongs here. Two flows connect the three layers (Figure 8 ). Consolidation moves material upward, from context to working state to knowledge, through the filtering and merging of Section 6.3 . Recall moves material downward, placing the right slice of knowledge into the context of the moment, which is exactly the step from C t h C^{h}_{t} to c t c_{t} in Definition 4.1 . When one word is needed for the whole we write the record .
paragraphs.zh: 上下文是与用户当前所做事情相关的信息。 它生命周期短、体量大，且大多在使用后即被丢弃：这场对话进行到了哪里、编辑器里打开的是哪个文件以及停在了哪个报错上、眼镜能看到什么、在场的有谁、今天日历上有什么安排。 知识是从大量上下文中沉淀出来、并在众多上下文中持续保持相关性的内容。 它生命周期长、经过精心整理，且相对较小：关于用户及其世界的事实、人际关系、偏好、承诺、他们的历史，以及他们为各种事情给出的理由。 在两者之间存在第三个层次，即工作状态，其存续期为数天或数周：正在推进的项目、尚未收尾的讨论、本周须做出的决定。 由事件和项目相互组织而成的项目树便属于这一层次。 两条数据流将这三个层次连接起来（图8）。 沉淀将材料向上移动，从上下文到工作状态再到知识，其方式是第6.3节所述的过滤与合并。 回取将材料向下移动，把恰当的知识片段置入当下的上下文，这正是定义4.1中从 C t h C^{h}_{t} 到 c t c_{t} 的那一步。 当需要用一个词来指代整体时，我们称之为记录。

paragraphs.en: The word context is also used for the input window of a language model, and in context engineering it refers to the information given to a model so that the model can complete a task ( Hua et al., 2025 ) . Personal context, as used here, is information about the person that is valid now, and its lifecycle serves a person’s life. The two meet at the recall step: injecting personal knowledge into a model’s context window is an act of context engineering. We borrow the lifecycle view and nothing else.
paragraphs.zh: “上下文”一词也用于指语言模型的输入窗口，而在上下文工程中，它指的是提供给模型的信息，以便模型能够完成任务（Hua et al., 2025）。 这里所说的个人上下文，是指当前有效的关于个人的信息，其生命周期服务于个人的生活。 二者在召回步骤交汇：将个人知识注入模型的上下文窗口是一种上下文工程行为。 我们只借用生命周期的视角，不借用其他任何内容。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 lists the sources of personal context and what each sees on its own. Each sees a partial person. A chat assistant knows someone who asks questions, a coding assistant knows a programmer, a desktop agent knows someone at work, and a band knows a body with a heart rate. Questions that matter for cognitive-level help cross these boundaries: why the person was unproductive in the editor this morning (they slept five hours and the first meeting went badly), how this decision relates to the one they made six months ago, whether the stress the band sees matches the deadline the desktop sees. Only an entry point that receives every source into one record can answer such questions, and only such a record supports a picture of the person rich enough for the help described in Section 9 . The same observation has a consequence for the runtime of Section 11 : it must be a layer across devices and applications, and it cannot be any one application. Receiving every source is a capability of the entry point and never the default for collection. Each source is authorized separately, the symbiont must be useful at low levels of authorization (Section 12.2 ), and the privacy column of the table exists for that reason. This is also what separates the proposal from one more memory layer: memory research records the conversations of a single entry point, whereas the record here spans all of a person’s entry points.
paragraphs.zh: 表 7 列出了个人情境的各个来源，以及每个来源各自能看到的内容。 每个来源都只看到部分的人。 聊天助手认识的是一个提问的人，编程助手认识的是一个程序员，桌面智能体认识的是一个在工作中的人，而手环认识的是一个带有心率的身体。 对于认知层面的帮助而言，重要的问题往往跨越这些边界：为什么这个人今天上午在编辑器中效率低下（因为他们只睡了五个小时，而且第一场会议进行得很糟糕）、这个决定与他们六个月前做出的那个决定有何关联、手环监测到的压力是否与桌面智能体看到的截止日期相符。 只有将所有来源汇入同一份记录的入口点才能回答这类问题，也只有这样的记录才能支撑起一幅足够丰富的人的图景，以实现第 9 节所述的帮助。 同样的观察对第 11 节的运行时也有一个推论：它必须是一个跨越设备和应用的层，而不能是任何单一的应用。 接收所有来源是入口点的一项能力，而绝不是数据收集的默认行为。 每个来源都需要单独授权，共生体必须在较低授权级别下也能发挥作用（见第 12.2 节），表中设有隐私一列正是出于这个原因。 这也是本提案区别于又一个记忆层之处：记忆研究记录的是单一入口点的对话，而这里的记录则涵盖一个人的所有入口点。

paragraphs.zh: • 意图明确：已推断 部分说明 由你说明。• 访问权限：可用 部分或早期 待构建。• 隐私权重：低 中 高。

paragraphs.en: Three stages turn raw streams into knowledge. At the front, on the device and at the edge, filtering drops what is high-frequency, volatile, and not worth keeping and forwards the rest. At the back, storage absorbs frequent writes and updates and grows large. The third stage is periodic offline consolidation, which plays the role that sleep plays for human memory: in idle hours it merges the day’s fragments into events, files events into projects, promotes repeated patterns into stable knowledge, and demotes what has expired. Sleep-time compute and memory systems in which memories link and evolve are technical precedents ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025b ) , and the rhythm resolves the tension between filtering at the front and accumulation at the back. Scale forces a decision about fidelity. A day of first-person audio and video runs to gigabytes and a life to petabytes; keeping everything is impossible and unnecessary. Raw streams are kept briefly; event-level summaries and indices of when and where something of a given kind happened are kept for the long term; knowledge entries carry pointers back to their sources. The underlying difficulty is that what will matter later is unknown now, and the compromise is a low-fidelity index that allows the past to be revisited. Section 17.4 lists modeling a life’s record at this scale as the first open problem.
paragraphs.zh: 三个阶段将原始数据流转化为知识。 在前端，即在设备上和边缘侧，过滤会丢弃高频、易变且不值得保留的内容，并将其余内容转发出去。 在后端，存储层承受频繁的写入和更新，并不断增长变大。 第三个阶段是周期性的离线整合，它扮演着睡眠对人类记忆所扮演的角色：在空闲时段，它把当天的碎片合并为事件，把事件归档进项目，将重复出现的模式提升为稳定的知识，并降级已过期的内容。 睡眠时段计算以及记忆相互链接并演化的记忆系统是技术上的先例（Lin et al., 2025；Xu et al., 2025b），而这种节奏化解了前端过滤与后端累积之间的张力。 规模迫使人们对保真度做出抉择。 一天的第一人称音视频数据量达数吉字节，一生的数据量达数拍字节；全部保留既不可能，也无必要。 原始数据流只作短期保留；事件级摘要以及记录某类事件在何时何地发生的索引则长期保留；知识条目则携带指回其来源的指针。 底层的困难在于，现在无法知道什么在未来会变得重要，而折中方案是一个低保真度的索引，使人得以回访过去。 第 17.4 节将在这种规模下对一生记录进行建模列为第一个开放问题。

sents.zh: 三个阶段将原始数据流转化为知识。

sents.en: At the front, on the device and at the edge, filtering drops what is high-frequency, volatile, and not worth keeping and forwards the rest.
sents.zh: 在前端，即在设备上和边缘侧，过滤会丢弃高频、易变且不值得保留的内容，并将其余内容转发出去。

sents.en: At the back, storage absorbs frequent writes and updates and grows large.
sents.zh: 在后端，存储层承受频繁的写入和更新，并不断增长变大。

sents.en: The third stage is periodic offline consolidation, which plays the role that sleep plays for human memory: in idle hours it merges the day’s fragments into events, files events into projects, promotes repeated patterns into stable knowledge, and demotes what has expired.
sents.zh: 第三个阶段是周期性的离线整合，它扮演着睡眠对人类记忆所扮演的角色：在空闲时段，它把当天的碎片合并为事件，把事件归档进项目，将重复出现的模式提升为稳定的知识，并降级已过期的内容。

sents.en: Sleep-time compute and memory systems in which memories link and evolve are technical precedents ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025b ) , and the rhythm resolves the tension between filtering at the front and accumulation at the back.
sents.zh: 睡眠时段计算以及记忆相互链接并演化的记忆系统是技术上的先例（Lin et al., 2025；Xu et al., 2025b），而这种节奏化解了前端过滤与后端累积之间的张力。

sents.en: Scale forces a decision about fidelity.
sents.zh: 规模迫使人们对保真度做出抉择。

sents.en: A day of first-person audio and video runs to gigabytes and a life to petabytes; keeping everything is impossible and unnecessary.
sents.zh: 一天的第一人称音视频数据量达数吉字节，一生的数据量达数拍字节；全部保留既不可能，也无必要。

sents.en: Raw streams are kept briefly; event-level summaries and indices of when and where something of a given kind happened are kept for the long term; knowledge entries carry pointers back to their sources.
sents.zh: 原始数据流只作短期保留；事件级摘要以及记录某类事件在何时何地发生的索引则长期保留；知识条目则携带指回其来源的指针。

sents.en: The underlying difficulty is that what will matter later is unknown now, and the compromise is a low-fidelity index that allows the past to be revisited.
sents.zh: 底层的困难在于，现在无法知道什么在未来会变得重要，而折中方案是一个低保真度的索引，使人得以回访过去。

sents.en: Section 17.4 lists modeling a life’s record at this scale as the first open problem.
sents.zh: 第 17.4 节将在这种规模下对一生记录进行建模列为第一个开放问题。

paragraphs.en: The organizing claim of the section is that the same record is projected into different views depending on the question, and that any view can be switched to at any time (Figure 9 , Table 8 ). A logic view arranges events and projects as a tree that grows into a graph; a domain view separates work, life, family, and health; a person view separates what concerns the person from what concerns others; a lifetime view separates stable knowledge from passing state, which aligns with the three timescales above; a chronological view orders by when something happened, when it was learned, and whether it still holds; and a physical/mental view separates what happened from how it felt. Views are projections of one store: the record underneath is one, and a view is generated by the question. The logic view is the main thread, and a life is never forced into a single tree. MyLifeBits offered multiple views for retrieval ( Gemmell et al., 2006 ) ; here views also serve understanding (Section 7 ) and the person’s own inspection and correction of what is held about them (Section 12 ). The paper specifies requirements on representation and retrieval and does not prescribe a graph or a vector store.
paragraphs.zh: 本节的核心主张是：同一条记录会根据问题被投射为不同的视图，且任何视图都可以随时切换（图 9，表 8）。 逻辑视图把事件和项目组织成一棵会生长为图的树；领域视图区分工作、生活、家庭和健康；个人视图区分与本人相关的事和与他人相关的事；一生视图区分稳定的知识和一时的状态，这与上文的三种时间尺度相一致；时间顺序视图按事情发生的时间、被知晓的时间以及是否仍然成立来排序；身心视图区分发生了什么以及当时感受如何。 视图是同一个存储的多种投射：底层的记录只有一份，而视图由问题生成。 逻辑视图是主线，但一生永远不会被强行塞进单一的一棵树中。 MyLifeBits 提供了多种视图用于检索（Gemmell et al., 2006）；在这里，视图还服务于理解（第 7 节）以及本人对所存关于自己的内容的查看与更正（第 12 节）。 本文对表示和检索提出了要求，但并不指定使用图存储还是向量存储。
