paragraphs.en: • Used mainly by: the loop stage that most often asks for the view: keep, understand, live alongside, act for and think with, grow.
paragraphs.zh: • 主要使用者：最常请求该视图的循环阶段：保持、理解、共同生活、代为行动以及共同思考、成长。

paragraphs.en: Frequent updating raises four problems: conflict, change, forgetting, and repair. Conflict between old and new is handled by keeping three times apart: when something happened, when the system learned it, and until when it holds. Change is the second, since preferences change, relationships change, and commitments are kept or cancelled, and the record has to follow them without losing the history. Forgetting, the third, comes in two kinds, decay that reduces noise and deletion that respects the person’s wishes, and deleting a raw record does not delete the summaries and judgments derived from it; the paper states the consistency requirement and leaves the mechanism open. Repair is the fourth. When the person says “you misunderstood me”, the system must locate the layer in which the misunderstanding lives, a fact, a reason, a current goal, or a long-term preference, and propagate the correction to the entries inferred from it and to the advice already given; changing its answer in the conversation is only the first step. This gives a measurable quantity: the half-life of an error in the record, and the number of inferences it reached before it was corrected. Section 10.4 returns to the related question of what survives when the base model is replaced.
paragraphs.zh: 频繁更新会带来四个问题：冲突、变化、遗忘和修复。 新旧之间的冲突通过区分三个时间点来处理：某事发生的时间、系统得知它的时间，以及它保持有效直到的时间。 变化是第二个问题，因为偏好会变化，关系会变化，承诺会被保持或取消，而记录必须跟上这些变化且不丢失历史。 遗忘是第三个问题，分为两类：减少噪音的衰减和尊重本人意愿的删除，而删除原始记录并不会删除由其衍生的摘要和判断；论文陈述了这一一致性要求，并将机制留待开放。修复是第四个问题。 当本人说“你误解了我”时，系统必须定位误解所在的层——是一个事实、一个理由、一个当前目标，还是一个长期偏好——并将修正传播到由其推断出的条目以及已经给出的建议；在对话中改变其回答只是第一步。 这就给出了一个可度量的量：记录中一个错误的半衰期，以及它在被纠正之前所到达的推断数量。 第10.4节将回到一个相关问题：当基础模型被替换时，什么会留存下来。

paragraphs.en: A record holds more than the past. It holds commitments, plans, the question to ask someone at the next meeting, decisions still forming, and the longer view of who the person wants to become. Psychology calls this prospective memory; it is the kind of memory people fail at most often, and it is where a symbiont produces value most easily, by returning a future intention to the working context at the right moment. It also gives the proactive help of Section 8 its most natural trigger: the system acts because the person said they would, and does not have to guess that they might want to. The record also holds reasons and not only conclusions: why the person declined that offer, why they abandoned that plan, which two options they still have not chosen between, what new evidence would make them reconsider; the third moment of the day in Section 1 is a record that kept the conclusion and lost the reasons. Keeping reasons is the precondition for the decision support of Section 9.2 ; a record without reasons can only answer questions about history.
paragraphs.zh: 记录所承载的不只是过去。 它还承载着承诺、计划、下次会议要问某人的问题、仍在形成的决定，以及对这个人想成为什么样的人的更长远看法。 心理学称之为前瞻记忆；这是人们最容易失败的一种记忆，也正是共生体最容易产生价值的地方——在恰当的时机把一个未来的意图送回工作情境中。 它也为第 8 节的主动帮助提供了最自然的触发条件：系统之所以行动，是因为这个人说过自己会去做，而不必猜测他们可能想做。 记录还承载着理由而不只是结论：这个人为什么拒绝了那个提议，为什么放弃了那个计划，他们在哪两个选项之间尚未做出选择，什么样的新证据会让他们重新考虑；第 1 节中的第三个时刻就是一个保住了结论却丢失了理由的记录。 保留理由是第 9.2 节决策支持的前提条件；一份没有理由的记录只能回答关于历史的问题。

paragraphs.en: A person’s colleagues, family, and friends are part of their context, and a symbiont has to remember where a conversation with someone left off in order to support the person’s social life. Those people have not authorized being modeled. We distinguish relational facts, what has happened between the person and them, which may be kept, from inferred portraits, what kind of person they are, which must be held to stricter limits than anything about the person themselves. Section 12.5 sets the boundary in detail.
paragraphs.zh: 一个人的同事、家人和朋友是其情境的一部分，智能体必须记住与某人的对话进行到哪里，才能支持这个人的社交生活。 这些人并未授权被建模。 我们区分关系性事实（即此人与他们之间发生过什么，可以保留）与推断出的画像（即他们是什么样的人，后者必须受到比关于此人自身的任何信息都更严格的限制）。 第 12.5 节详细设定了这一边界。

paragraphs.en: The record of Section 6 is evidence. This section asks how evidence becomes understanding of a person, and it is the technical center of the paper. It runs along one line: what must be understood, where the evidence comes from, how the understanding is represented, which backbone it runs on, what a world model adds to it, and where it stops. World models appear only at the fifth step, as the source of one capability, prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 第6节的记录是证据。 本节探讨证据如何成为对一个人的理解，它是全文的技术核心。 它沿一条主线展开：必须理解什么、证据来自哪里、理解如何表示、运行在哪种骨干上、世界模型为之增加了什么，以及它止步于何处。 世界模型仅出现在第五步，作为预测这一能力的来源。

paragraphs.en: Three objects must be understood. The first is the situation , the physical side: where the person is, whom they are with, what they are doing, what the world in front of them is about to do. The second is the mind , the mental side: the person’s intention at this moment, their cognitive load, their emotion, their uncertainty, and the more stable layer of goals, values, and blind spots. The third is change : the situation changes by the minute, the mind by the hour, and the person by the year, so that the difficulty of understanding someone lies less in drawing a likeness than in making the likeness move. The same experience has two faces, the event visible from outside and the person’s experience of it, and the record keeps both, so the model must represent both. Mental world modeling makes the same commitment at the level of world state, treating beliefs and intentions as state variables alongside physical ones ( Fei and Zhao, 2026 ) ; Section 7.5 builds on it. The third object, change, is the root of the staleness detection in that section and of the mutual growth in Section 10 .
paragraphs.zh: 必须理解三个对象。 第一个是情境，即物理层面：这个人在哪里、和谁在一起、在做什么、面前的世界即将发生什么。 第二个是心智，即心理层面：这个人此刻的意图、认知负荷、情绪、不确定性，以及更稳定层面的目标、价值观与盲点。 第三个是变化：情境按分钟变化，心智按小时变化，而人按年变化，因此理解一个人的难点不在于画出画像，而在于让画像动起来。 同一段经历有两副面孔：从外部可见的事件，以及这个人对它的体验，而记录会同时保留两者，因此模型必须同时表征两者。 心智世界建模在世界状态层面做出同样的承诺，将信念与意图作为状态变量与物理状态变量并列处理（Fei and Zhao, 2026）；第 7.5 节将以此为基础展开。 第三个对象——变化，正是该节中陈旧性检测以及第 10 节中共同成长的根源。

paragraphs.en: There are two independent sources of evidence about a mind, and a symbiont needs both (Figure 10 ). The observation road infers from behavior, choices, expression, environment, and physiology; its strength is that it sees patterns the person cannot see themselves (they do not sleep after every meeting with a certain colleague), and its weakness is that one behavior has many possible causes. The self-report road takes what the person says: their account of a situation, a whispered sentence, a correction of a misreading; its strength is that only the person can say what they felt and why, and its weakness is that accounts shift with mood and flatter the teller. The two roads feed one layered model, and every entry carries its source and its uncertainty. Self-report has priority on feelings and reasons; observation has priority on patterns the person cannot see. When they disagree, the right response is to mark the disagreement, lower the weight placed on the inference, and ask when the moment is right, never to let the model overrule the person. The result of Park et al. (2024) , in which agents built from two-hour interviews reproduced their participants’ survey answers about as well as the participants reproduced their own, shows how dense the information on the self-report road is; those agents are never updated, and that is what the symbiont adds. Most existing systems travel only the observation road, inferring preferences from interaction history, and the dedicated low-friction channel of Section 5.4 is what gives a symbiont the second.
paragraphs.zh: 关于心智，存在两条相互独立的证据来源，而共生体需要两者兼备（图 10）。 观察之路从行为、选择、表达、环境和生理状态进行推断；其优点在于能看到本人看不到的模式（例如某人每次与某位同事会面后都会失眠），其缺点在于同一种行为可能有许多原因。 自述之路采信这个人所说的话：对某个情境的陈述、一句低语的更正、一次误读的纠正；其优点在于只有本人才能说出自己感受了什么以及为什么，其缺点在于陈述会随情绪波动而变化并美化陈述者自己。 这两条路共同输入同一个分层模型，每一条记录都带有其来源和不确定性。 在感受和理由方面，自述优先；在本人看不到的模式方面，观察优先。 当两者不一致时，正确的做法是标记这一分歧、降低相应推断的权重，并在时机合适时询问，绝不能让模型凌驾于本人之上。 Park 等人的研究结果 （2024）显示，由两小时访谈构建的智能体在再现受访者对其调查问卷的回答方面，表现与受访者再现自己的回答不相上下；这表明自述之路上的信息何等密集；这些智能体从不更新，而这正是共生体所补充的。 现有的大多数系统只走观察之路，从交互历史中推断偏好，而第 5.4 节所述的专用低摩擦通道正是让共生体获得第二条路径的关键。

paragraphs.en: Table 9 gives the representation: seven layers, each with its evidence, its rate of change, and the misuse it invites, so that a passing state is never mistaken for a trait. The last layer, preferences about help, is new relative to the usual user profile and is the parameter source of the intervention policy in Section 8.4 . One structural property of the table follows from an everyday observation: a person who switches between a home dialect, a national language, and English changes manner, values, and even reasoning with the switch. The table is therefore indexed by context. The self at work, the self at home, and the self speaking the home dialect take different values in the identity, relations, and help-preference layers and share the experience-and-knowledge layer. The differences are not contradictions to be averaged into one personality; the model’s task is to recognize which self is active, from language, setting, and company, and to act with that self’s manner, weights, and social norms. Cultural psychology documents the underlying phenomenon of cultural frame switching in bicultural people ( Hong et al., 2000 ; Ramírez-Esparza et al., 2006 ) , and the context-indexed model is what makes the cultural help of Section 9.4 possible.
paragraphs.zh: 表 9 给出了这一表示：七个层次，每个层次都有其证据、其变化速率以及它容易招致的误用，从而不会把一时的状态误认为是一种特质。 最后一个层次——关于帮助的偏好——相对于通常的用户画像而言是新的，它是 8.4 节中干预策略的参数来源。 该表的一个结构性质来自一个日常观察：一个在家庭方言、民族语言和英语之间切换的人，会随着切换而改变其作风、价值观甚至推理方式。 因此，该表以情境为索引。 工作中的自我、家中的自我以及说家庭方言的自我，在身份、关系和帮助偏好层次上取不同的值，并共享经验与知识层次。 这些差异并不是需要被平均成一个单一人格的矛盾；模型的任务是从语言、场合和同伴中识别出当前是哪一个自我在起作用，并以该自我的作风、权重和社会规范来行动。 文化心理学记录了双文化人群中的文化框架切换这一底层现象（Hong et al., 2000；Ramírez-Esparza et al., 2006），而以情境为索引的模型正是使 9.4 节的文化帮助成为可能的关键。

paragraphs.en: The personal model has to be computed by something, and the paper binds it to nothing in particular. The claim is precise. The personal model and the record are defined at the level of information : what must be known, what must be predicted, and how confidence is expressed. The backbone is the engine that turns evidence into that information, and the engine can be changed while the interface stays, so that what varies between engines is the quality of the estimates. Two independent axes describe the engine (Figure 11 ). The first axis is the foundation model itself, of which three kinds matter here. A language model understands what the person says and writes, holds a textual portrait in its context, and reaches memory through retrieval. An omni-modal model understands what the person sees and hears, reads situation and mood from tone and scene, and makes the first-person stream interpretable for the first time. A world model turns understanding into prediction: what is about to happen around the person, how they will think and react, and whether a given reminder will be welcome. The three are members of one family, each extending the evidence the model can take in and the inference it can draw from it, and later members contain the earlier ones. The second axis is orthogonal to the first. An agentic system belongs to this second axis rather than to the family: it is an organization of computation around a foundation model of any of the three kinds, the model together with the harness of Section 3.2 , and the model inside an agentic system can be exchanged for any member of the family. What the harness adds is that understanding ceases to be a single pass and becomes a process: the system can look something up, ask the person a question, check the record, update the model, and plan the next step, whichever model sits inside it. The grid of Figure 11 therefore has six cells, and the two axes can be traversed independently. The first usable systems will stand in the upper-left cell, a language model inside a harness, since that is what today’s agents are, and the design is headed toward the upper-right cell, a world model inside a harness that anticipates as well as perceives. The design must stand on the weakest cell and improve automatically along either axis.
paragraphs.zh: 个人模型必须由某个东西来计算，而论文没有把它绑定到任何特定之物上。这个论断是精确的。 个人模型与记录都定义在信息层面：必须知道什么、必须预测什么，以及置信度如何表达。 骨干是把证据转化为该信息的引擎，引擎可以更换而接口保持不变，因此引擎之间的差异在于估计的质量。 两条独立的轴描述这个引擎（图 11）。 第一条轴是基础模型本身，其中有三种在此处至关重要。 语言模型理解这个人所说和所写的内容，在其上下文中保存一份文字画像，并通过检索来访问记忆。 全模态模型理解这个人所见和所听的内容，从语气和场景中读出情境与情绪，并首次使第一人称的信息流变得可解释。 世界模型把理解转化为预测：这个人周围即将发生什么、他们将如何思考和反应，以及某条提醒是否会受到欢迎。 三者属于同一家族的成员，每一个都扩展了模型能够接收的证据以及它能从中得出的推理，而且后面的成员包含前面的成员。 第二条轴与第一条轴正交。 智能体系统属于第二条轴而非该家族：它是围绕任意一种基础模型组织的计算结构，即模型与第 3.2 节所述的配套框架的结合，而智能体系统内的模型可以替换为该家族中的任意成员。 配套框架带来的改变是，理解不再是一次性的单遍过程，而是成为一个过程：无论其中装的是什么模型，系统都可以查询某事、向这个人提问、核对记录、更新模型，并规划下一步。 因此图 11 的网格共有六个格子，两条轴可以各自独立地推进。 最初可用的系统将位于左上角的格子，即配套框架中的语言模型，因为这正是今天的智能体所在，而设计正朝着右上角的格子前进，即不仅能感知、还能预判的配套框架中的世界模型。 该设计必须立足于最弱的格子，并沿任意一条轴自动改进。

paragraphs.en: On a language model alone the symbiont is a text assistant with a memory; without a world model the intervention policy estimates reactions by heuristics; without a harness, understanding cannot check itself. The information interface is what makes the claim concrete: the mental-state layer of Table 9 asks every cell for the same output, an estimate of intent and an estimate of emotion, each with its confidence, which a language model produces from dialogue text, an omni-modal model from tone and scene as well, a world model from predictions of what comes next, and a harness from any of these together with the result of checking them against the record. This is also why Section 10.4 requires that a change of foundation model, or of harness, preserve the relationship.
paragraphs.zh: 仅凭语言模型，共生体只是一个有记忆的文本助手；没有世界模型，干预策略只能靠启发式方法估计反应；没有运行框架，理解便无法自我检验。 信息接口正是使这一论断具体化的关键：表9的心理状态层要求每个单元给出相同的输出，即对意图的估计和对情绪的估计，各自附带置信度；语言模型从对话文本生成这一输出，全模态模型还可从语气和场景生成，世界模型从对后续发展的预测生成，而运行框架则从以上任意来源并结合对照记录检查它们的结果来生成。 这也是为什么第10.4节要求更换基础模型或运行框架时，必须保持这一关系不变。

paragraphs.en: A world model, as a backbone, contributes to the personal model in two forms. An external physical world model takes the environment seen in first person as its object, scene, objects, people present, their dynamics, and predicts the next moment: the cup is about to tip, the bus is arriving, the slide is about to change. It serves help in the physical world, grounds mental cues in the situation (the person is tense because the deadline is on the screen), and supplies the extended reach of Section 14.2 ; its sources are the video world models and first-person data of Section 3.4 . An internal mental world model takes the person’s beliefs, attention, intentions, emotions, and goals as its object and predicts how they change after an event and after an action by the symbiont. paragraphs.en: “It knows you better than you know yourself” has three defensible meanings and one that is not. It can hold the person’s whole self-context at once while they hold a small part (Definition 4.1 ); it can see patterns across years that the person is inside of and cannot see; and it remembers the reasons they gave and have since forgotten. The fourth meaning, reading thoughts that were never expressed, the paper gives up explicitly. Two kinds of limitation must also be kept apart. Familiarity with the person and competence on the problem in front of them are different things, and a system that knows someone very well may be poor at the specialist question they face this minute. The confidence of the personal model and the reliability of the backbone in that domain are estimated and reported separately; when the second is low the system narrows its advice or suggests asking a person, and it never covers its ignorance of the problem with its familiarity with the person. Understanding runs both ways, since the person also learns under which conditions the system is reliable, and mutual understanding has degrees and costs; the grounding framework of Clark and Brennan (1991) describes the process without the infinite regress of each knowing what the other knows. Finally, every judgment about the person carries a confidence, any of them can be overturned by a sentence from the person, the system learns to ask when it is unsure, and an overturned judgment propagates through the repair of Section 6.5 . Collins et al. (2024) argued that machines that think with people must model them; this section says what is modeled, on what evidence, on which backbone, and within which limits.

paragraphs.en: Real-time voice assistants solved one problem: the person and the AI can speak and listen at the same time ( Défossez et al., 2024 ) . A symbiont solves a different one. The person is talking to another person; the symbiont is listening, thinking, and preparing at the same time, and through the private channel it hands the person a line, so that the person never has to stop for it. We call this cognitive full-duplex , the real-time form of the symbiosis Licklider (1960) imagined: two conversations at once, the person’s with the world and the person’s with the symbiont, with the second never interrupting the first. Figure 12 shows one instance. A colleague mentions a figure the person reported last quarter; the slow loop retrieves it and checks it against the record; a question is detected and a cue appears in the glasses within a second; the person answers with the figure; the topic moves on and the cue expires and is withdrawn. Four tracks run through the exchange, the external world, the person’s outward expression, the private channel, and the symbiont’s internal state, and the figure follows them along one timeline. This capability belongs in the first usable system, since without it the symbiont is confined to the moments when the person is alone.
paragraphs.zh: 实时语音助手解决了一个问题：人和AI可以同时说话和听话（Défossez et al., 2024）。 共生体解决的是另一个不同的问题。 这个人正在和另一个人交谈；共生体则在一旁同时倾听、思考和准备，并通过私密通道把一句台词递给这个人，使这个人永远不必为它停下交谈。 我们把这称为认知全双工，即Licklider（1960）所设想的共生的实时形式：同时进行两场对话，一场是这个人与世界的对话，另一场是这个人与共生体的对话，而后者永远不会打断前者。 图12展示了一个实例。 一位同事提到这个人上季度汇报过的某个数字；慢回路将其检索出来并与记录进行核对；检测到一个问题，提示在不到一秒内出现在眼镜上；这个人报出了那个数字；话题继续推进，提示随之过期并被撤回。 整个交流过程贯穿着四条轨迹：外部世界、这个人的对外表达、私密通道，以及共生体的内部状态，图4沿着同一条时间线展示了它们。 这项能力应当包含在第一个可用系统中，因为缺少它，共生体就只能在这个人独处的时刻发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: Real time has two timescales, and conflating them leads to the mistaken demand that everything be low-latency. The fast loop handles the immediate: a name, a number, “what he just said contradicts last week.” The slow loop handles the background: retrieval, reasoning, updating the model, preparing a summary for after the meeting. Between them sits a rolling current state: what this conversation is about, who wants what, what is still unresolved. Cues must update incrementally, an updated cue must replace its predecessor, and an expired cue must disappear. The latency budget has a shape. The fast loop’s ceiling is set by the pace of conversation, since a name is useless two seconds late, so it can use only small models on the device or at the edge together with material the slow loop has already prepared. The slow loop may be slow but must think ahead, preparing before the person opens their mouth what they are likely to need, which is where the prediction of Section 7.5 is put to use. Section 17.4 lists the end-to-end latency budget as an open problem.
paragraphs.zh: 实时有两种时间尺度，把它们混为一谈会导致一种错误要求，即一切都必须低延迟。 快循环处理即时内容：一个名字、一个数字、“他刚才说的话与上周矛盾”。慢循环处理后台事务：检索、推理、更新模型、为会后准备一份摘要。 在两者之间存在着一个滚动更新的当前状态：这段对话是关于什么的、谁想要什么、还有什么尚未解决。 线索必须增量更新，更新后的线索必须替换其前身，而过期的线索必须消失。 延迟预算是有形状的。 快循环的上限由对话节奏决定，因为一个名字晚到两秒就毫无用处，所以它只能使用设备端或边缘侧的小模型，连同慢循环已经准备好的材料。 慢循环可以慢，但必须提前思考，在对方开口之前就准备好他们可能需要的东西，这正是 7.5 节的预测派上用场之处。 17.4 节将端到端延迟预算列为一个开放问题。

sents.en: The fast loop handles the immediate: a name, a number, “what he just said contradicts last week.” The slow loop handles the background: retrieval, reasoning, updating the model, preparing a summary for after the meeting.
sents.zh: 快循环处理即时内容：一个名字、一个数字、“他刚才说的话与上周矛盾”。慢循环处理后台事务：检索、推理、更新模型、为会后准备一份摘要。

sents.en: Between them sits a rolling current state: what this conversation is about, who wants what, what is still unresolved.

sents.en: Cues must update incrementally, an updated cue must replace its predecessor, and an expired cue must disappear.
sents.zh: 线索必须增量更新，更新后的线索必须替换其前身，而过期的线索必须消失。

sents.zh: 延迟预算是有形状的。

sents.en: The fast loop’s ceiling is set by the pace of conversation, since a name is useless two seconds late, so it can use only small models on the device or at the edge together with material the slow loop has already prepared.

We add a notion of an attention budget : the amount of a person’s attention a symbiont may consume in a day is finite, and it should be managed the way battery charge is managed. Earlier work on interruption and recovery shows how expensive an ill-timed intrusion is ( Iqbal and Horvitz, 2007 ) , and mixed-initiative principles already warned that initiative must be weighed against the cost of poorly timed action ( Horvitz, 1999 ) . paragraphs.en: Low friction means that the person never works for the help: no re-explaining the background, no reaching for a phone, no switching applications, no waiting. Friction has four sources, and each is removed elsewhere in the paper: explaining the background (the record, Section 6 ), switching devices (the runtime, Section 11 ), waiting for a reply (the two loops above), and tidying up afterwards (consolidation, Section 6.3 ). Some friction is worth preserving. Being asked one more question before an important decision, or being left to think for a moment, is friction that should survive optimization (Section 10.5 ); interfaces that make people examine a recommendation before accepting it reduce overreliance at the cost of being liked less ( Buçinca et al., 2021 ) , and that trade is the one a symbiont must learn to make per person and per moment.
paragraphs.zh: 低摩擦意味着人不需要为获得帮助付出任何劳动：无需重新解释背景，无需拿起手机，无需切换应用，无需等待。 摩擦有四个来源，本文会在其他部分逐一消除：解释背景（记录，第6节）、切换设备（运行时，第11节）、等待回复（上述两个循环），以及事后的整理（整合，第6.3节）。 有些摩擦是值得保留的。 在重要决策之前多被问一个问题，或者被留出片刻思考的时间，这是应当在优化中得以幸存的摩擦（第10.5节）；那些要求人们在接受建议之前先加以审视的界面，以降低受欢迎程度为代价减少了过度依赖（Buçinca et al., 2021），而这种权衡正是共生体必须学会针对每个人、每个时刻去做出的。

paragraphs.en: The meeting is the first proving ground: time pressure is high, information is dense, and timing decides everything, which is why a desktop copilot that analyzes a meeting as it happens and feeds cues back in real time is the natural starting point. The symbiont must, however, leave the room. Three settings of presence have different rhythms and channels. Sitting at a screen, in the desktop or the editor, the channel is wide and help can be expanded. In conversation, in a meeting or at dinner, only a line or a whispered word fits. On the move, in the street, in transit, in an unfamiliar city, the earpiece and the overlay carry what the moment needs. The second moment of the day in Section 1 resolves here: the result the researcher could not recall arrives as a line in the glasses while the conversation continues. What the symbiont does once present begins with doing things for the person, which is where the next section starts.
paragraphs.zh: 会议是第一个试验场：时间压力大、信息密度高，而时机决定一切，因此一款能在会议进行时实时分析并向你反馈提示的桌面智能体（copilot）是自然的起点。 然而，共生体不能只待在会议室里。 三种在场场景有着不同的节奏与通道。 坐在屏幕前，无论在桌面还是编辑器中，通道宽泛，辅助内容可以充分展开。 在交谈中，无论开会还是吃饭，只有一行字或一句低语才合适。 在路上，无论是街头、通勤途中还是身处陌生城市，耳麦与叠加显示承担着当下所需的信息传递。 第 1 节中一天里的第二个时刻在此得到回应：研究员想不起来的那个结果，在对话继续进行时，以一行字的形式出现在眼镜上。 共生体在场之后做什么，首先要从为人办事开始，这也是下一节的开端。

paragraphs.en: Once present, what does a symbiont do? The answer is a ladder with three tiers (Figure 13 ). At the bottom it gets things done, which is what today’s autonomous and personal agents do, and a symbiont must do it as well as they do and better. In the middle it thinks and feels with the person: decisions, goal formation, learning, creative work, emotional steadiness, mentorship, and psychological support within clinical limits, the settings of highest cognitive density. At the top it lives among others with the person: real-time social cognition, hard conversations, culture and dialect, and the meeting of two symbionts. Three facts organize the ladder. Each tier rests on the one below, and a symbiont that cannot book a flight will never be worn. Each tier up moves the object of evaluation further from task completion and closer to how the person is changed. And all three tiers run on the same machinery of Sections 6 to 8 , differing only in how deep into the personal model they reach and how much intervention they are allowed (the threshold θ \theta of Eq. ( 4 )). One function, patient care, runs across all three tiers and receives its own treatment in Section 9.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 一旦存在，共生体要做什么？ 答案是一个分为三层（或三个层级）的阶梯（图 13）。 在最底层，它要把事情办成，这正是今天的自主智能体和个人智能体所做的，共生体也必须做到它们能做到的，甚至更好。 在中间层，它与这个人一起思考和感受：决策、目标形成、学习、创造性工作、情绪稳定、导师式引导，以及临床限度内的心理支持，这些是认知密度最高的场景。 在最顶层，它随这个人生活在他人之中：实时的社会认知、艰难的对话、文化与方言，以及两个共生体的相遇。 三个事实构成了这个阶梯的组织结构。 每一层都依赖于其下的一层，一个连机票都订不了的共生体永远不会被佩戴。 每往上一层，评估对象就进一步远离任务完成，而更接近这个人被改变的程度。 而这三个层级都运行在第 6 至 8 节的同一套机制之上，区别只在于它们深入个人模型的程度以及被允许的干预程度（即式（4）中的阈值 θ \theta）。 有一项功能——患者照护——贯穿所有三个层级，并在第 9.5 节中单独讨论。

sents.en: Three facts organize the ladder.
sents.zh: 三个事实构成了这个阶梯的组织结构。

sents.en: Each tier rests on the one below, and a symbiont that cannot book a flight will never be worn.
sents.zh: 每一层都依赖于其下的一层，一个连机票都订不了的共生体永远不会被佩戴。

sents.en: Each tier up moves the object of evaluation further from task completion and closer to how the person is changed.
sents.zh: 每往上一层，评估对象就进一步远离任务完成，而更接近这个人被改变的程度。

sents.en: And all three tiers run on the same machinery of Sections 6 to 8 , differing only in how deep into the personal model they reach and how much intervention they are allowed (the threshold θ \theta of Eq. ( 4 )).
sents.zh: 而这三个层级都运行在第 6 至 8 节的同一套机制之上，区别只在于它们深入个人模型的程度以及被允许的干预程度（即式（4）中的阈值 θ \theta）。

sents.en: One function, patient care, runs across all three tiers and receives its own treatment in Section 9.5 .
sents.zh: 有一项功能——患者照护——贯穿所有三个层级，并在第 9.5 节中单独讨论。

paragraphs.en: The floor of the ladder is general-purpose assistance: booking travel and hotels, shopping and comparing prices, keeping the calendar and the inbox, forms and payments, desktop work with files, slides, and spreadsheets, coding and technical work inside the editor, retrieving and organizing information, and multi-day tasks such as an application, a move, or an event. A symbiont does not rebuild these capabilities. Through its harness (Sections 3.2 and 11.3 ) it delegates them to standard agents and tools, computer-use agents, tool protocols, and coding agents, and keeps three jobs for itself: defining the task correctly, supplying the right personal defaults, and deciding when the person must be consulted. The reason the same task comes out better is the record and the personal model. An agent told “book my flight to the conference” has to ask where the person leaves from, what they will spend, when they prefer to travel, whether they want a window seat. A symbiont already knows that the person has a meeting on Monday morning that cannot move, that they dislike overnight flights, that they want to stay near the venue because they hope to meet a particular colleague, and that the last time they took a short connection they missed it. So it asks nothing, or it asks the one question that only the person can answer. One layer deeper, it knows why the person is making the trip, from the goals layer of Table 9 , so it frames the task correctly and books the meeting they were hoping for alongside the flight. Table 11 works through five everyday tasks in this way, and its last column lists what can be measured: clarifying questions asked, corrections the person had to make, time to completion, how much of a plan actually holds.
paragraphs.zh: 阶梯的底层是通用型辅助：预订差旅和酒店、购物和比价、管理日程和收件箱、填表和支付、处理文件、幻灯片和电子表格的桌面工作、编辑器内的编程与技术工作、检索和整理信息，以及跨越多天的任务，例如一份申请、一次搬家或一场活动。 共生体不重建这些能力。 它通过自身的壳层（见 3.2 节和 11.3 节）将这些能力委托给标准智能体和工具、计算机操作智能体、工具协议以及编程智能体，并为自己保留三项工作：正确定义任务、提供合适的个人默认设置，以及决定何时必须征询本人意见。 同一项任务之所以完成得更好，靠的是记忆记录和个人模型。 一个被告知“帮我订去开会地点的航班”的智能体，必须询问本人从哪里出发、打算花多少钱、偏好在什么时候出行、是否想要靠窗的座位。 共生体则已经知道：本人周一早上有一场不能改期的会议，本人讨厌夜航航班，本人希望住在会场附近因为想见某位特定的同事，而且上次赶短转机时误了机。 因此它什么都不问，或者只问那唯一一个只有本人才能回答的问题。 再深一层，它知道本人为什么要做这趟行程（来自表 9 的目标层），因此能正确定义任务，并在订机票的同时把本人原本希望促成的会议也一并安排上。 表 11 以这种方式逐一分析了五项日常任务，其最后一列列出了可以度量的指标：需要提出的澄清性问题、本人不得不做出的修正、完成所需时间，以及计划最终有多大程度能兑现。

paragraphs.en: • Gap closed, in the four losses of Section 1 : forgetting not noticing not thinking through not finding the words.
paragraphs.zh: • 差距弥合，即第 1 节中的四种失败：遗忘、未察觉、未深思、未找到合适的措辞。

paragraphs.en: Acting for the person is the most intrusive action in Eq. ( 4 ) and needs the firmest boundary. We propose five levels of action permission: look, suggest, draft, execute what can be undone, and execute what cannot, such as paying, sending, and committing; each level is earned along the trust curve of Section 12.2 . A draft composed in discussion, a line rehearsed for a conversation, or a candidate plan never becomes an outward action or commitment on its own. Long tasks carry state, verify their results, and hand back to the person when they fail. Evaluation at this tier can keep task completion as its object as long as it adds a personalization differential : the same task, the same base model, with and without the person’s context, which Section 17.1 writes as Eq. ( 8 ). Current benchmarks measure the floor and say nothing about the differential ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) . We make no claim of novelty for this tier; the single claim is that the same tasks are done better with personal context, and that this can be shown.
paragraphs.zh: 代人行动是式（4）中最具侵入性的动作，需要最严格的边界。 代人行动是式（4）中最具侵入性的动作，需要最严格的边界。 我们提出五个动作许可层级：查看、建议、起草、执行可撤销的操作，以及执行不可撤销的操作（如支付、发送和提交）；每个层级都需沿着 12.2 节的信任曲线逐步获得。 在讨论中起草的文稿、为对话排练的一句话，或一个候选方案，都不会自行变成对外的动作或承诺。 长任务会携带状态、验证其结果，并在失败时交还给用户本人。 这一层的评估可以继续以任务完成度为对象，只要它加入一个个性化差值：同一任务、同一基础模型，在有和没有用户个人上下文两种情况下进行比较，17.1 节将其写为式（8）。 当前的基准测试衡量的是下限，对该差值只字未提（Xie 等，2024；Zhou 等，2024；Yao 等，2025）。 我们不主张这一层有任何新颖性；唯一的论点是，借助个人上下文可以更好地完成同样的任务，并且这一点是可以被证明的。

paragraphs.en: The first half of the second tier is cognition itself, in six forms.
paragraphs.zh: 第二层的前半部分是认知本身，共有六种形式。

paragraphs.en: A symbiont that remembers the person can help them reason with themselves. It returns what they forgot (why they declined last time, and whether the constraint still holds), lays out what they did not think of (a third option, a counterexample, a value they usually weigh and this time left out), and writes down what they concluded, with the reasons, for next time (Section 6.6 ). Its stance is to help the person see, never to choose for them, and it owes them a reasoned objection when a choice conflicts with a long-term goal they stated themselves, after which the decision returns to them. Reicherts et al. (2025) compared an AI that builds on the person’s own reasons with one that gives recommendations: the first integrated better with people’s thinking and produced slightly better outcomes, the second surfaced more novel insights at less effort, and the first is the form of help this paragraph describes. The third moment of the day in Section 1 resolves here.
paragraphs.zh: 一个能记住用户情况的共生智能体（symbiont）可以帮助他们与自己进行推理。 它返回他们遗忘的内容（比如上一次为何拒绝，以及该约束是否仍然成立），摆出他们未曾想到的内容（第三种选项、一个反例、他们通常会权衡而这次遗漏的价值），并把他们得出的结论连同理由记录下来，以备下次使用（见 6.6 节）。 它的立场是帮助用户看清情况，绝不替他们做选择；当某个选择与他们自己陈述过的长期目标相冲突时，它有义务提出有理有据的反对意见，此后决定权仍回到用户手中。Reicherts 等人 （2025）比较了基于用户自身理由展开的 AI 与直接给出建议的 AI：前者与人们的思维结合得更好，结果也略优；后者以更少的付出呈现出更多新颖的洞见；而本段所描述的正是前一种帮助形式。 第 1 节中一天的第三个时刻在此得到解决。

paragraphs.en: Many important matters start without an executable goal: changing direction, taking or declining an opportunity, handling a relationship. The symbiont can unfold candidate goals, bring back the reasons that conflict, and ask which cost the person would find hardest to bear, so that a provisional choice forms in the conversation. It makes no claim to have discovered the person’s “true” goal.
paragraphs.zh: 许多重要的事情开始时并没有可执行的目标：改变方向、抓住或放弃一个机会、处理一段关系。 共生体可以展开候选目标，带回相互冲突的理由，并询问哪一种代价是这个人最难承受的，从而在对话中形成一个初步的选择。 它并不声称发现了这个人“真正”的目标。

paragraphs.en: This is help with knowing where one is uncertain, whether to check, and whether this is a moment to think alone, to think with the symbiont, or to ask a person. Such help arrives before an answer, and sometimes it takes the form “that is not the question you need.” A rise in confidence is never counted as a rise in understanding, and the cognitive-offloading literature ( Risko and Gilbert, 2016 ) is the background for when offloading is the right choice.
paragraphs.zh: 这有助于了解自己在何处不确定、是否需要核查，以及此刻是应该独自思考、与共生体一起思考，还是向人请教。 这类帮助出现在答案之前，有时它表现为“这不是你需要问的问题”。信心的提升绝不被算作理解的提升，而认知卸载的相关文献（Risko and Gilbert, 2016）则为何时卸载才是正确选择提供了背景依据。

paragraphs.en: A tutor who knows where the person does not understand, because it has seen every place they got stuck, can give a hint at the moment they need it instead of an answer, and can step back when they say they want to learn this themselves (Section 10.5 ). Language learning is the most natural case and connects to the dialect help of Section 9.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 一个知道人在哪里不理解的辅导智能体（因为它见过对方卡住的每一个地方），可以在对方需要提示的那一刻给出提示而不是答案，并且在对方说想自己学会时能够退后一步（见10.5节）。 语言学习是最自然的情形，并且与9.4节的方言帮助相关联。

paragraphs.en: Two services belong here: catching the idea that slips away (the first moment of the day in Section 1 , the typical use of the whisper channel), and holding a thread across weeks, where this project got to, which hypothesis was dropped, which is still open, which is the working state of Section 6.1 . The failure to watch for is a symbiont that generates a great deal and drifts away from the question the person wanted to pursue.
paragraphs.zh: 这里涉及两种服务：一是捕捉转瞬即逝的想法（第 1 节中一天里的第一个时刻，即耳语通道的典型用法），二是跨数周保持一条线索——这个项目进行到了哪里，哪个假设被放弃了，哪个仍然悬而未决，以及第 6.1 节的当前工作状态。 需要警惕的失败情况是：一个共生体生成大量内容，却逐渐偏离了这个人原本想要追问的问题。

paragraphs.en: This includes guarding focus, by noticing that the person has been refreshing the same page for ten minutes, and the plainest memory support of all: a name, a detail, where something was put, what was said last time. These six forms draw on the goals and mental-state layers of Table 9 , use the expanded dialogue or the whisper channel, and span seconds to days, and it is here that the friction worth preserving (Section 8.5 ) matters most.
paragraphs.zh: 这包括守护注意力——察觉到这个人已经连续十分钟刷新同一个页面——以及最朴素的支持记忆的方式：一个名字、一个细节、某样东西放在哪里、上次说了什么。 这六种形式依托表 9 的目标层与心理状态层，使用扩展对话或耳语通道，时间跨度从数秒到数天，而值得保留的摩擦（见 8.5 节）正是在这里最为重要。

paragraphs.en: The second half of the tier runs from everyday emotion to the edge of clinical care, in four steps of increasing weight.
paragraphs.zh: 该层级的后半部分从日常情绪延伸到临床护理的边缘，分为四个日益重要的步骤。

paragraphs.en: The small disturbances of a day: a remark that stung, nerves before a talk, a piece of bad news. The symbiont’s help is to be present, to know what happened, and to say the one sentence that fits, or to say nothing and simply note it. Physiology gives early signs of stress and fatigue, and their interpretation has to remain conservative.
paragraphs.zh: 一天中的小扰动：一句刺痛人的话，演讲前的紧张，一条坏消息。 共生体的帮助在于在场，了解发生了什么，说出那句合适的话，或者什么都不说，只是记下它。 生理指标会给出压力和疲劳的早期信号，而对它们的解读必须保持保守。

paragraphs.en: Useful comfort is never generic encouragement; it rests on a precise understanding of the person’s actual history, so that what is said touches the real point: this failure relates to those efforts and those hopes. Three levels follow. Being heard, when the symbiont restates the situation and the person thinks “yes, that is it.” Being understood, when it points out an attribution error the person could not see. Being moved, when it builds a next step from the way the person got through a similar time before. The preconditions, an established relationship of trust and a general competence that in many domains exceeds an ordinary person’s, are stated as conditions throughout.
paragraphs.zh: 有用的安慰从来不是泛泛的鼓励；它建立在对当事人真实经历的精确理解之上，使所说的话切中真正的要点：这次失败关联着那些努力与那些期望。以下分三个层次。 被倾听，即共生体重述情境，当事人想“是的，就是这样。”被理解，即它指出当事人自己看不到的归因错误。 被打动，即它根据当事人当初度过类似时期的方式，构建出下一步行动。 其前提条件——已建立的信任关系以及在许多领域超出普通人的通用能力——在全文中均作为条件加以陈述。

paragraphs.en: This is where the section has to be most careful. Relative to any mental-health application, a symbiont has three advantages: it knows the person’s life and does not need it retold; it is present when the trigger happens, days before the next appointment; and it can see patterns, in sleep, in social withdrawal, in language. It is therefore suited to three things: being a daily practice partner for evidence-based methods such as the identification and reframing used in cognitive behavioral therapy; providing support and a record between professional sessions; and recognizing early signs of relapse. It is not suited to carrying treatment on its own. For depression and anxiety the paper says that this is a direction that deserves serious study, with randomized evidence for particular systems under particular conditions, from the early Woebot trial ( Fitzpatrick et al., 2017 ) to the recent trial of a generative chatbot ( Heinz et al., 2025 ) , and it does not say that these conditions can be treated by an AI. The symbiont’s first duty in such moments is to recognize when a human professional must be brought in, with a clear path for doing so when crisis signals appear, and in regulated jurisdictions this function is itself regulated, which the paper acknowledges.
paragraphs.zh: 这正是本章必须最为谨慎小心的地方。 相对于任何心理健康应用，共生体具有三项优势：它了解这个人的生活，无需对方重新讲述；它在触发事件发生的当下就在场，早于下一次预约数天；而且它能够看到规律，在睡眠中、在社交退缩中、在语言中。 因此它适合做三件事：作为循证方法的日常练习伙伴，例如认知行为疗法中使用的识别与重构；在专业诊疗间隔期间提供支持与记录；以及识别复发的早期迹象。 它并不适合独立承担治疗工作。 对于抑郁与焦虑，论文指出这是一个值得认真研究的方向，已有针对特定系统在特定条件下的随机对照证据，从早期的 Woebot 试验（Fitzpatrick 等，2017）到近期一项生成式聊天机器人的试验（Heinz 等，2025），但论文并没有说这些病症可以由 AI 来治疗。 在此类时刻，共生体的首要职责是识别何时必须引入人类专业人士，并在危机信号出现时提供明确的求助路径；而在受到监管的司法辖区中，这一职能本身也受到监管，论文承认了这一点。

paragraphs.en: Long-term behavior change, in sleep, exercise, or recovery, is the home ground of just-in-time adaptive interventions ( Nahum-Shani et al., 2018 ) , and a symbiont turns the phone notification into a sentence from someone present. As company it can be patient and non-judging, and the risk has to be stated directly: it must never substitute for human relationships, and it should steer the person back toward people. Studies of companion chatbots show both relief of loneliness and dependence, with effects that vary with how and how much they are used ( Maples et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在睡眠、运动或恢复方面的长期行为改变，正是即时自适应干预（Nahum-Shani 等，2018）的主场领域，而共生体把手机通知变成一句来自“在场之人”的话语。 作为陪伴，它可以耐心且不带评判，但风险必须直白地说清楚：它绝不能替代人际关系，而应引导人重新回归人群。 关于陪伴型聊天机器人的研究既显示了孤独感的缓解，也显示了依赖性的产生，其效果因使用方式和使用程度而异（Maples 等，2024；Fang 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: The third tier is help with people and cultures, in four forms. Real-time social cognition. A meeting is one kind of social setting. In any of them the symbiont can recall the person opposite (where the conversation left off, what they care about), read the moment (the implication of what was just said, the tension between the person’s argument and the other’s position), and help the person say it (a better phrasing, the number they forgot). Reading the moment relies on the theory-of-mind ability of large foundation models, which has shown both promise and brittleness ( Kosinski, 2024 ; Ullman, 2023 ; Strachan et al., 2024 ) , and on inferences about other people that are used only for the interaction at hand and never accumulate into a portrait (Sections 6.7 and 12.5 ). Rehearsal and hard conversations. Practice beforehand for a salary negotiation, a breakup, or negative feedback to a colleague; a line during (the person’s pace is rising; the other is really asking something else); a review afterwards. A simulated counterpart in rehearsal is only a rehearsal and never a prediction of a real person. De-escalation belongs here too: the symbiont can see, in voice and heart rate, that the person is heating up before they notice, and a single vibration on the private channel is enough. Relationship maintenance. This goes deeper than a birthday reminder: the person has not spoken to their father in a month and he mentioned a medical test last time. It draws on the relations layer and on prospective memory (Section 6.6 ), and it is where the limits of Section 12.5 bite hardest. Language, culture, and the dialect self. Behind each language are different habits of thought and social rules. The help consists less in translation than in entering the frame: how people here greet, how they decline, what cannot be said directly. It needs the context-indexed model of Section 7.3 , which knows who the person is in that language, and the online learning of Section 10.3 , which learns the dialect of a small place. Those two sections share one example, used here and learned there, and we avoid claims of the form “language X makes people more open”: shifts of this kind have been reported in bicultural individuals ( Ramírez-Esparza et al., 2006 ) , and they do not license a rule about any particular person.
paragraphs.zh: 第三层是对人与文化方面的帮助，共有四种形式。 实时社交认知。 会议是一种社交情境。 在其中任何一种情境中，共生体都能回忆起对面的人（上次谈话停在哪里、对方关心什么），读懂当下（刚才那句话的言外之意、一方论点与另一方立场之间的张力），并帮助这个人表达出来（更好的措辞、他忘记的那个数字）。 读懂当下依赖大型基础模型的心理理论能力，这一能力既展现出前景也表现出脆弱性（Kosinski, 2024；Ullman, 2023；Strachan et al., 2024），同时也依赖对其他人的推断，这些推断只用于当下的互动，而从不积累成一幅画像（见 6.7 节与 12.5 节）。 演练与艰难对话。 事先演练薪资谈判、分手或给同事负面反馈；过程中的一句提示（这个人的语速在加快；对方真正问的其实是另一件事）；事后的复盘。 演练中的模拟对手只是演练，绝不是对真实的人的预测。 降温缓和也属于此列：在本人察觉之前，共生体就能从声音和心率中看出这个人正在激动起来，而私密频道上的一次振动就足够了。 关系维护。 这比生日提醒更深入：这个人已经一个月没和父亲说话了，而上次父亲提到过一次医学检查。 它依托关系层与前瞻记忆（见 6.6 节），也正是 12.5 节所述限制作用最猛烈之处。 语言、文化与方言自我。 每种语言背后都是不同的思维习惯和社会规则。 这种帮助与其说在于翻译，不如说在于进入那个框架：这里的人们如何打招呼、如何拒绝、什么不能直说。 它需要 7.3 节的按情境索引的模型（知道这个人在那种语言中是谁），以及 10.3 节的在线学习（学习一个小地方的方言）。 那两节共用一个例子——在这里使用、在那里学习——并且我们避免诸如「语言 X 使人更开放」这类论断：这种转变在双文化个体中已有报告（Ramírez-Esparza et al., 2006），但它们并不足以推出关于任何特定个人的规则。

paragraphs.en: The function the user of a symbiont may value most is one that is patient when they are not. Its core is consistency, patience, tirelessness, and noticing what people stop noticing, and it runs across all three tiers. Four settings follow; the populations themselves are treated in Section 13 . In parenting , a symbiont answers a child’s hundredth “why” without weariness, hands the parent a sentence when the parent’s own temper is rising, leaves the child to the parent, and notices developmental or emotional signs worth a professional’s attention; the symbiont belongs to the parent, and all-day sensing of children raises separate ethical questions (Sections 13.9 and 16.7 ). In aging and memory decline it is a memory prosthesis, who this is, whether the medication was taken, what was being looked for, with the SenseCam studies of memory-impaired patients as precedent ( Berry et al., 2007 ) ; it supports orientation and safety and connects the person to family. For caregivers , the people who care for others and receive the least support, it holds the detail of care so that they can rest. In rehabilitation and chronic self-management , where the task is long, repetitive, and easy to abandon, its patience is worth most, and the handoff to clinical systems must be explicit. The failure mode common to all four is the handing over of a person to a machine, and in each setting the symbiont’s last duty is to return the person to other people.
paragraphs.zh: 共生体的使用者可能最看重的一项功能，是在他们失去耐心时保持耐心。 它的核心是一致性、耐心、不知疲倦，以及觉察人们停止觉察的事物，这一原则贯穿所有三个层级。 下面给出四个场景；相关人群本身将在第13节中讨论。 在育儿中，共生体会不厌其烦地回答孩子的第一百个「为什么」，在父母自己的火气上升时递给父母一句话，把孩子交还给父母，并留意值得专业人士关注的发展或情绪信号；共生体属于父母，而对儿童的全天候感知会引发另外的伦理问题（第13.9节和第16.7节）。 在衰老与记忆衰退中，它是一个记忆假体：这个人是谁、药是否吃过、刚才在找什么，以针对记忆受损患者的SenseCam研究为先例（Berry et al., 2007）；它支持定向与安全，并把这个人同家人连接起来。 对于照护者，即那些照护他人却得到最少支持的人，它承担起照护的细节，让他们得以休息。 在康复与慢性病自我管理中，任务漫长、重复且容易放弃，它的耐心价值最大，而向临床系统的移交必须明确。 这四个场景共同失败模式是把一个人交给一台机器，而在每个场景中，共生体的最后一项职责都是把这个人交还给其他人。

sents.en: The function the user of a symbiont may value most is one that is patient when they are not.
sents.zh: 共生体的使用者可能最看重的一项功能，是在他们失去耐心时保持耐心。

sents.en: Its core is consistency, patience, tirelessness, and noticing what people stop noticing, and it runs across all three tiers.
sents.zh: 它的核心是一致性、耐心、不知疲倦，以及觉察人们停止觉察的事物，这一原则贯穿所有三个层级。

sents.en: In parenting , a symbiont answers a child’s hundredth “why” without weariness, hands the parent a sentence when the parent’s own temper is rising, leaves the child to the parent, and notices developmental or emotional signs worth a professional’s attention; the symbiont belongs to the parent, and all-day sensing of children raises separate ethical questions (Sections 13.9 and 16.7 ).

paragraphs.en: The most imaginative scene in the vision is two people, each with a symbiont, in one room and not yet near each other, while their symbionts exchange cards, filter shared interests, decide whether a greeting is worth it, and if so bring the two together. It is at once fanciful and practical, and Figure 14 turns it into four research questions. Which information may represent the person in an exchange, in four rings of authorization: visible, discoverable, shareable, and committable, with the inner personal model never crossing the boundary. By what criterion symbionts match, and who sets it. Whether a greeting made on the person’s behalf counts as their commitment. And when two symbionts each optimize for their owner, whether the outcome is good for both. Section 15.7 asks what happens when this scales to a crowd. No protocol is proposed, and everything in Sections 5 to 8 stands even if symbionts never talk to each other.
paragraphs.zh: 这一愿景中最具想象力的场景是：两个人各自带着一个智能体，身处同一房间但尚未彼此靠近，而他们的智能体交换名片、筛选共同兴趣、判断是否值得打声招呼，如果值得，就把两人引到一起。 这个场景既奇想又务实，图 14 把它转化为四个研究问题。 哪些信息可以在交换中代表本人，分为四层授权圈：可见、可发现、可分享、可承诺，而最内层的个人模型绝不越过边界。 智能体以什么标准进行匹配，以及由谁来设定这一标准。 以本人名义发出的问候是否算作本人的承诺。 当两个智能体各自为其主人进行优化时，结果是否对双方都有利。 15.7 节会探讨当这一场景扩展到人群时会发生什么。 文中未提出任何协议，且即使智能体之间从不互相交流，第 5 到 8 节的内容依然成立。

paragraphs.zh: • 层级：❶ 把事情做成 ❷ 与你一起思考和感受 ❸ 与他人共同生活 ❶❷❸ 跨层级。• 个人模型的各层（表 9）：身份、经历、情境、心理状态、关系、目标、对帮助的偏好。• 通道：屏幕、入耳式、语音、IDE、展开的对话、眼镜上的一行字、一阵嗡鸣、耳语、文字、沉默、事后、共生体对共生体。• 成熟度：现在可用、研究中、遥遥无期；一枚芯片的名字意味着它必须伴随而来的东西。

paragraphs.en: After many rounds of participation, how do the system and the person each change? This section holds the paper’s most ambitious claims, the personal data flywheel, self-evolution, test-time training, learning a dialect from a few days of conversation, and it is written to be the strictest. The question “where does the symbiont learn” is broadened from memory and parameters to the whole stack: as the symbiont comes to know the person, the base model, the harness, and even the hardware have to evolve, and the one thing that must never be replaced is the relationship.
paragraphs.zh: 经过许多轮的参与后，系统和这个人各自会发生什么变化？ 本节包含论文中最具雄心的主张——个人数据飞轮、自我演化、测试时训练、从几天的对话中学会一种“方言”——因此它被写得最为严格。 “共生体在哪里学习”这一问题从记忆和参数扩展到了整个技术栈：随着共生体逐渐了解这个人，基座模型、运行框架乃至硬件都必须演化，而唯一绝不能被替换的，是这段关系。

paragraphs.en: “Knowing you better” can happen in seven places, each with its own mechanism, risk, and reversibility (Table 13 ). The first three, the record, the personal model, and the intervention policy, are where most of what is called personalization lives, and they already create most of the value. The fourth and fifth, model parameters and the harness with its tools, are self-evolution in the strict sense. The sixth is hardware. The seventh is the person, which is the paper’s object of evaluation and which no other personalization research counts. Figure 15 arranges the parameter-side mechanisms on one axis from changing only memory to changing all parameters, rates each for the data it needs, its stability, and its reversibility, and adds a parallel band for the harness. The region the paper argues for lies in the middle and toward the left; the right end, where one change moves everything, is the one to avoid. One distinction governs all seven rows: sounding more like you is not the same as understanding you better.
paragraphs.zh: “更了解你”可以发生在七个地方，每一处都有各自的机制、风险和可逆性（表 13）。 前三个，即记录、个人模型和干预策略，是所谓个性化的大部分所在，它们也已经创造了大部分价值。 第四和第五个，即模型参数以及带有工具的运行框架，是严格意义上的自我进化。第六个是硬件。 第七个是人本身，这正是本文评估的对象，也是其他任何个性化研究都没有计入的。 图 15 将参数侧的机制排列在一个轴上，从只更改记忆到更改全部参数，并按所需数据、稳定性和可逆性逐项评级，还为运行框架增加了一条并行的条带。 本文所主张的区域位于中间偏左的位置；右端，即一处改动会牵动一切的地方，是应当避免的。 一个区别贯穿全部七行：听起来更像你，并不等同于更好地理解你。

paragraphs.en: More authorized data gives a more accurate model, which gives more useful help, which earns more trust, which brings more data. The flywheel is the core technical bet of personal AI, and in a paper it is a research hypothesis with two brakes. The first is echo . The symbiont influences the person, then reads the influenced behavior as evidence that the person was always like this, and the model grows ever more certain of a portrait it painted itself. The remedy is to condition every update on what the system itself did:
paragraphs.zh: 更多的授权数据带来更准确的模型，更准确的模型带来更有用的帮助，更有用的帮助赢得更多信任，更多信任又带来更多数据。 这个飞轮是个人 AI 的核心技术押注，而在论文中它是一个带有两个制动器的研究假设。第一个是回声。 共生体会影响这个人，然后把被影响后的行为当作这个人本来如此的证据来读取，于是模型对它自己描绘出的画像变得越来越确信。 补救办法是让每一次更新都以上述系统自身做过的事情为条件：

Machine learning has a formal account of predictions that change what they predict ( Perdomo et al., 2020 ) . The second brake is validation : more data does not mean a truer understanding, and every round of updating has to survive the evaluation of Section 17 . Growth in the person can also be the intended result of help, so change is never treated as contamination by default; what is examined is whether the evidence for an update matches the conclusion drawn from it.

paragraphs.en: A symbiont has to learn new things the way a person does: in the course of life, from few experiences, incrementally, and without large offline training runs. The requirement is best stated through an example. A dialect spoken in a single county has no corpus and sometimes no written form; a person learns it by going there, talking to people, and being corrected. A symbiont needs the same ability, and it needs it under two constraints: without changing all of its parameters, through local and dynamic adjustment or no parameter change at all, and with generalization from little data. We write this as a ladder of research targets, each separately testable: remember the sentences it heard; compose expressions it has learned; adapt to a new speaker and accent; transfer to scenes it has not heard. Meta’s EMG wristband is a ready-made example on the input side: a generic model trained on thousands of people works for a new wearer with no calibration, and twenty minutes of personal data improve it further ( Kaifosh et al., 2025 ) . A generic model with a small personal adaptation is the learning curve this section argues for, with the object changed from gestures to a dialect and a mind. sents.en: A symbiont has to learn new things the way a person does: in the course of life, from few experiences, incrementally, and without large offline training runs.
sents.zh: 共生体必须像人一样学习新事物：在生命历程中，从少量经验出发，逐步进行，且不需要大规模的离线训练。

sents.en: The requirement is best stated through an example.
sents.zh: 这一要求最好通过一个例子来表述。

sents.en: A dialect spoken in a single county has no corpus and sometimes no written form; a person learns it by going there, talking to people, and being corrected.
sents.zh: 一种只在单个县内使用的方言没有语料库，有时甚至没有书面形式；一个人学会它的方式是去那里、与人交谈并接受纠正。

sents.en: A symbiont needs the same ability, and it needs it under two constraints: without changing all of its parameters, through local and dynamic adjustment or no parameter change at all, and with generalization from little data.
sents.zh: 共生体需要同样的能力，并且需要在两个约束下具备它：不改变其全部参数——通过局部和动态调整，或完全不改变参数——并能够从极少量数据中进行泛化。

sents.en: We write this as a ladder of research targets, each separately testable: remember the sentences it heard; compose expressions it has learned; adapt to a new speaker and accent; transfer to scenes it has not heard.
sents.zh: 我们将其写成一座研究目标的阶梯，每一级都可单独检验：记住它听过的句子；组合它已学会的表达；适应新的说话者和口音；迁移到它未曾听过的场景。

paragraphs.en: As understanding of the person deepens, the base model, the harness, and the hardware must all evolve, along three routes that share one set of constraints (Figure 16 ). Base model upgrades. The foundation model changes every few months (Section 3.1 ), and the symbiont cannot be reset with it. The requirement is the information-level interface of Section 7.4 : the record, the personal model, the intervention policy, and the harness configuration are defined outside the backbone, migrate when it changes, and are recalibrated during a transition period, since a new backbone may estimate the same evidence differently. This is the paper’s answer to whether a symbiont needs its own private model: what must belong to the person is the record and the model of them, and it is the relationship, and never the weights, that persists. The films give the failure case; when its owner moved from Jarvis to a successor system, the relationship started over. Self-improvement of the harness. A symbiont may rewrite the way it works: fix a routine for something the person does often, write a tool, accumulate skills in the manner of a skill library ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , rebalance the fast and slow loops, retune the parameters of the intervention policy. This is self-improvement in a bounded form. What changes is the harness, which is readable, auditable, and reversible, and every change leaves a record; the model’s own parameters change only by exception. Hardware generations. New glasses, a new band, or a new channel let the symbiont see and say a little more. The record and the model are bound to no device, and what has to be relearned after a change is only which channel works in which setting, never who the person is, which is the mechanism behind the co-evolution of Section 5.6 . The shared constraints are four: portability (change any layer and the relationship survives), auditability (what changed and why, visible to the person), reversibility (a bad change can be rolled back), and the echo brake at system level (what the system observes after changing itself cannot be read directly as the person). One more direction follows: the better the symbiont knows the person, the more specialized its procedures should become and the fewer generic defaults it should keep, and since specialization erodes general ability, a path back to the generic must be kept open, which is the system-side counterpart of the person’s right to do things themselves in the next subsection.
paragraphs.zh: 随着对人的理解不断加深，基座模型、框架与硬件都必须随之演进，沿三条路线展开，而这三条路线共享同一组约束（图 16）。基座模型升级。 基座模型每隔几个月就会更替（第 3.1 节），而共生体不能随其更替而被重置。 这里的要求是第 7.4 节的信息级接口：记录、个人模型、干预策略与框架配置均定义在主干之外，在主干更替时随迁移，并在过渡期内重新校准，因为新的主干可能对同一证据做出不同的估计。 这是本文对「共生体是否需要自己的私有模型」这一问题的回答：必须归属于人的是记录与关于此人的模型，得以延续的是关系本身，而绝不是权重。 电影给出了失败案例：当其主人从贾维斯换到后继系统时，这段关系只能从头再来。 框架的自我改进。 共生体可以改写自身的运作方式：为这个人经常做的事情固化一套例程、编写一个工具、以技能库的方式积累技能（Wang et al., 2024）、重新平衡快环与慢环、重新调校干预策略的参数。 这是一种有边界的自我改进。 变化的是框架，它可读、可审计且可回滚，每次改动都会留下记录；模型自身的参数只在例外情况下才会改变。硬件换代。 新的眼镜、新的手环或新的信道，能让共生体多看见一点、多说一点。 记录与模型不绑定于任何设备，更换设备后需要重新学习的只是哪个信道在哪种场景下可用，而绝不是这个人是谁，这正是第 5.6 节所述共同演化背后的机制。 共享的约束有四条：可移植性（更换任何一层，关系都能存续）、可审计性（改了什么、为什么改，对本人可见）、可回滚性（坏的改动可以撤销），以及系统层面的回声刹车（系统在改变自身之后所观察到的内容，不能被直接读作这个人本身）。 由此还可推出另一个方向：共生体越了解这个人，其流程就应越特化、保留的通用默认项就应越少；而由于特化会侵蚀通用能力，必须保留一条回到通用的路径，这是下一小节中「本人亲自动手的权利」在系统侧的对应物。

paragraphs.en: The symbiont learns the person, and the person changes. Three changes are possible: the person learns something, which is a gain; they stop practising what they have handed over, which is a gain or a loss depending on whether they wanted to keep it; and their preferences are slowly shaped by the system, which has to be watched. The symbiont must support both “do this for me” and “I want to learn this myself”, and leave the choice with the person, which is the last layer of Table 9 . The evidence so far shows harm by default and protection only by design. Generative AI without guardrails harmed high-school mathematics learning while a guarded version did not ( Bastani et al., 2025 ) , and in a randomized study of developers learning a new library, AI assistance weakened conceptual understanding and debugging without a significant gain in speed, while three of six observed interaction patterns preserved learning ( Shen and Tamkin, 2026 ) . The old lesson of automation, that the operator who is relieved of a task loses the skill to take it back, still applies ( Bainbridge, 1983 ) . Section 17.1 counts the consequence under retained ability.
paragraphs.zh: 共生体学习这个人，而这个人也在发生变化。 可能发生三种变化：这个人学到了东西，这是一种收益；他们不再练习已经交出去的部分，这是收益还是损失取决于他们是否想保留它；他们的偏好被系统慢慢塑造，这一点必须加以警惕。 共生体必须同时支持「替我做这件事」和「我想自己学这个」，并把选择权留给人，这是表 9 的最后一层。 迄今的证据表明，危害是默认结果，而保护只能靠刻意设计。 没有防护栏的生成式 AI 损害了高中数学学习，而带防护栏的版本则没有（Bastani et al., 2025）；在一项针对学习新库的开发者的随机研究中，AI 辅助削弱了概念理解和调试能力，且速度没有显著提升，而六种被观察到的交互模式中有三种保住了学习效果（Shen and Tamkin, 2026）。 自动化的老教训——被免除某项任务的操作者会失去重新接手该任务的技能——依然适用（Bainbridge, 1983）。 第 17.1 节将这一后果计入保留能力之下。

paragraphs.en: Everything in the previous six sections has to run somewhere. This is the layer that, in the stack of Figure 5 , sits between the foundation models and the agentic harness, and that may in time grow into an AI-native operating system. We call it a runtime and do not propose to rewrite an operating system.
paragraphs.zh: 前面六节中的所有内容都必须在某处运行。 这一层级在图5的堆栈中位于基础模型与智能体框架之间，并且可能随着时间推移发展成一个AI原生操作系统。 我们将其称为运行时，并不打算重写一个操作系统。

sents.en: Everything in the previous six sections has to run somewhere.
sents.zh: 前面六节中的所有内容都必须在某处运行。

sents.en: This is the layer that, in the stack of Figure 5 , sits between the foundation models and the agentic harness, and that may in time grow into an AI-native operating system.
sents.zh: 这一层级在图5的堆栈中位于基础模型与智能体框架之间，并且可能随着时间推移发展成一个AI原生操作系统。

sents.en: We call it a runtime and do not propose to rewrite an operating system.
sents.zh: 我们将其称为运行时，并不打算重写一个操作系统。

paragraphs.en: A symbiont needs persistent state across devices, a single permission model, scheduling of several senses and several output channels, management of the fast and slow loops, delegation to standard agents, and the one entry point for every context of Section 6.2 . These requirements exceed any single application and fall short of a new kernel. The personal runtime is the layer that meets them, and it can grow over time into the AI-native operating system of our vision, once enough devices and applications treat it as their entry point.
paragraphs.zh: 共生体需要跨设备的持久状态、单一权限模型、对多种感知与多个输出通道的调度、对快循环与慢循环的管理、向标准智能体的委托，以及第 6.2 节所述的面向所有上下文的唯一入口点。 这些需求超出了任何单一应用的范畴，却又不足以构成一个新内核。 个人运行时正是满足这些需求的层，一旦足够多的设备与应用把它当作自己的入口点，它便可以随时间成长为我们愿景中的 AI 原生操作系统。

paragraphs.en: Figure 17 expands the upper part of Figure 5 . From the bottom: the device constellation; base capabilities, a shared omni-modal model, a world model, and small on-device models, all replaceable; runtime services, identity, permissions, device abstraction, continuity, the attention budget, and entry-point aggregation; the harness, which plans, uses tools, delegates to standard agents, schedules the two loops, and holds the procedures and skills it has written for itself; and at the top the record and the personal model, which are bound to no backbone and are portable. The trust layer of Section 12 runs through all of them. Two points organize the figure: the base is replaceable and the record and model are never replaced, and the harness and the runtime divide the labor, the first getting things done and the second making them happen on the right device, with the right permission, at the right time.

paragraphs.en: Current harnesses are designed around a task (Section 3.2 ): it begins and ends, its input is a span of text, its tools are APIs. A symbiont’s harness faces a life: nothing begins or ends, the input is a continuous multimodal stream, the tools include a person’s senses and the devices around them, memory is a first-class component, and most of the time the correct output is nothing at all. Six requirements follow, and the paper states them without a specification: event-driven operation; the record and the personal model as native components; output channels matched to the setting; delegation to standard agents and reclamation of control from them (Section 9.1 ); a log of the system’s own actions, which the echo brake of Section 10.2 needs; and the ability to rewrite itself under audit, which Section 10.4 needs. This is the layer in which the current harness standard must evolve for the setting, and that evolution is one of the paper’s calls to the community.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的 harness 是围绕一个任务设计的（第 3.2 节）：任务有始有终，其输入是一段文本，其工具是若干 API。 共生体的 harness 面对的则是一种生活：没有任何事有始有终，输入是连续的多模态流，工具包括一个人的感官及其周围的设备，记忆是一等组件，而且大多数时候正确的输出是什么都不输出。 由此得出六项要求，本文在不给出规范的情况下陈述它们：事件驱动的运行方式；以记录和个人模型为原生组件；与场景相匹配的输出通道；向标准智能体委派任务并从它们手中收回控制权（第 9.1 节）；系统自身行动的日志，这是第 10.2 节的回声刹车所需要的；以及在审计下重写自身的能力，这是第 10.4 节所需要的。 这一层次正是当前 harness 标准必须为该场景演化的方向，而这种演化也是本文向社区发出的呼吁之一。

paragraphs.en: AI that computes around the clock depends heavily on compute and infrastructure, and the question of what happens when AI compute becomes cheap infrastructure deserves a direct answer. Cost has a structure that can be optimized. Most of the time a lightweight on-device model does nothing but detect events; a few events wake a heavy model, on the device or in the cloud; the night is used for consolidation. Three research quantities follow: the compute budget per person per day, the leverage of event detection on total cost, and the effect of the split between local and cloud on privacy and latency. Whether the paradigm is economical depends on the duty cycle and not on model size. If inference costs keep falling at the rate of recent years and on-device models keep improving, one always-on symbiont per person becomes affordable before it becomes trusted, and the bottleneck moves once more, to Section 12 .
paragraphs.zh: 全天候计算的 AI 高度依赖算力与基础设施，而当 AI 算力变成廉价的基础设施之后会发生什么，这个问题值得一个直接的回答。 成本具有可被优化的结构。 大多数时候，轻量的端侧模型只是检测事件；少数事件唤醒重型模型，无论是在设备上还是在云端；夜晚则被用于巩固整合。 由此引出三个研究量：每人每天的算力预算、事件检测对总成本的杠杆作用，以及本地与云端之间的划分对隐私和延迟的影响。 这一范式是否经济，取决于占空比，而不是模型大小。 如果推理成本继续保持近年来的下降速度，且端侧模型持续改进，那么每人一个常驻的共生智能体将先变得可负担，然后才变得可信，而瓶颈将再一次转移，见第 12 节。

paragraphs.en: Continuity is the runtime’s central duty, in three forms. Across devices: what the person started at the desk continues when they walk out the door. Across interruptions: when a battery dies, the person switches off collection, or the network drops, the system knows which stretch it missed and, on recovery, does not pretend to have been there. Across upgrades: when the base model or the device changes, the person’s symbiont is still theirs (Section 10.4 ). The second form is the most often forgotten and the most damaging to trust when it fails.
paragraphs.zh: 连续性是运行时的核心职责，体现为三种形式。 跨设备：一个人在书桌前开始的事情，在其走出家门后仍能继续。 跨中断：当电池耗尽、用户关闭数据采集或网络断开时，系统知道自己错过了哪一段，并在恢复后不会假装自己一直在线。 跨升级：当基础模型或设备发生更换时，用户的共生体仍然是他们自己的（见 10.4 节）。 第二种形式最常被遗忘，而一旦失效，对信任的破坏也最大。

paragraphs.en: By what right does a system enter a person’s life? The judgment that organizes this section is that the largest obstacle to a symbiont, ahead of any technical one, is whether people will find it safe enough to open their whole context to it, the physical and the mental alike. Trust is therefore treated as part of the architecture. This section is about design; the risks that design does not remove, and their governance, are the subject of Part IV.
paragraphs.zh: 一个系统凭什么权利进入一个人的生活？ 组织本节的判断是：共生体面临的最大障碍，先于任何技术障碍，在于人们是否会觉得它足够安全，从而愿意把自己的全部情境——无论是身体的还是心理的——都对它开放。 因此，信任被视为架构的一部分。 本节讨论的是设计；设计无法消除的风险及其治理，是第四部分的主题。

paragraphs.en: A symbiont asks for authorization without precedent. It sees what the person sees, hears what they hear, keeps their life, infers their thoughts, and spends and speaks on their behalf. No existing product has asked for this much. The paper therefore reads “full open context” as a process and never as a precondition: the system has to be useful under very little authorization and earn more as trust accumulates.
paragraphs.zh: 一个共生体在没有任何先例的情况下请求授权。 它看到那个人所看到的，听到他们所听到的，保存他们的生活，推断他们的想法，并代他们消费和发言。 现有的产品从未请求过如此多的授权。 因此，本文将「完全开放上下文」视为一个过程，而绝不视为一个前提条件：系统必须在极少授权的情况下依然有用，并随着信任的积累而赢得更多授权。

sents.en: A symbiont asks for authorization without precedent.
sents.zh: 一个共生体在没有任何先例的情况下请求授权。

sents.en: It sees what the person sees, hears what they hear, keeps their life, infers their thoughts, and spends and speaks on their behalf.
sents.zh: 它看到那个人所看到的，听到他们所听到的，保存他们的生活，推断他们的想法，并代他们消费和发言。

sents.en: No existing product has asked for this much.
sents.zh: 现有的产品从未请求过如此多的授权。

sents.en: The paper therefore reads “full open context” as a process and never as a precondition: the system has to be useful under very little authorization and earn more as trust accumulates.

paragraphs.en: Figure 18 plots authorization against time together and value delivered. Data authorization climbs in steps, from desktop and text, to voice and calendar, to first-person sight and sound, to physiology, to the private channel of thought, and each step has something the system must prove first. Action permission climbs on a parallel curve, from look to suggest to draft to undoable execution to final execution (Section 9.1 ). The curve can fall: a breach sends authorization back a step, although it cannot undo an exfiltration, so the step back limits further exposure only, which is one more reason the most private data stays on the device. Three principles govern tiered access. The system must be useful at every level, so that “give me everything and then I can help” is never the offer. Data from a higher level is never used automatically for a task at a lower level. Processing stays local by preference, with the most private data handled closest to the body. This is also the answer to the question most often asked first about the paradigm, whether the system must watch everything to be worth anything: it must not, and the separate authorization of each source in Table 7 is the cross-section of the curve.
paragraphs.zh: 图 18 将授权随时间的变化与交付的价值一起绘制出来。 数据授权按台阶逐步攀升：从桌面和文本，到语音和日历，再到第一人称的视觉与听觉，再到生理数据，最后到思想的私密通道，而每个台阶都要求系统先证明某些东西。 行动权限沿一条平行的曲线攀升：从查看，到建议，到起草，到可撤销的执行，再到最终执行（第 9.1 节）。 这条曲线也可能下降：一次安全事件会使授权退回一级，尽管它无法撤销已经发生的数据外泄，因此退回一级只能限制进一步的暴露，这也是最私密的数据留在设备上的又一个理由。 三项原则支配着分级访问。 系统必须在每个层级上都保持有用，这样「给我全部权限，然后我才能帮你」就永远不会成为系统给出的提议。 来自更高层级的数据绝不会自动用于较低层级的任务。 处理优先保留在本地，最私密的数据在尽可能贴近身体的地方处理。 这也是关于这一范式最常被首先问到的问题的答案，即系统是否必须监视一切才有价值：它不必如此，而表 7 中对每个来源的单独授权正是这条曲线的横截面。

paragraphs.en: A personal AI should have values and a code of its own. We start from three rules, complete command of the owner’s information, responsibility to the owner, and protection of privacy and data security, and rewrite them as commitments that can be checked, with three additions.
paragraphs.zh: 个人AI应当拥有自己的价值观与准则。 我们从三条规则出发——完全掌握所有者的信息、对所有者负责、以及保护隐私与数据安全，并将其改写为可核查的承诺，同时增加了三条补充内容。

sents.en: A personal AI should have values and a code of its own.
sents.zh: 个人AI应当拥有自己的价值观与准则。

sents.en: We start from three rules, complete command of the owner’s information, responsibility to the owner, and protection of privacy and data security, and rewrite them as commitments that can be checked, with three additions.
sents.zh: 我们从三条规则出发——完全掌握所有者的信息、对所有者负责、以及保护隐私与数据安全，并将其改写为可核查的承诺，同时增加了三条补充内容。

paragraphs.en: Know only what you are permitted to know, and know it as accurately as possible. “Complete command” cannot stand ethically or legally; the standard is completeness within authorization.
paragraphs.zh: 只了解你被允许了解的内容，并尽可能准确地了解它。“完全掌控”在伦理上或法律上都站不住脚；标准是在授权范围内做到完整。

paragraphs.en: Answer to the person, and to the interests the person endorses on reflection. Never to a passing impulse, and never to a third party: a platform, an advertiser, or an employer. Section 15.6 takes up the institutional conflict this creates.
paragraphs.zh: 回应的是这个人，以及这个人在反思后所认可的种种利益。 绝不回应一时的冲动，也绝不回应第三方：无论是平台、广告商还是雇主。 第 15.6 节将讨论由此产生的机构层面的冲突。

sents.zh: 回应的是这个人，以及这个人在反思后所认可的种种利益。

sents.en: Section 15.6 takes up the institutional conflict this creates.
sents.zh: 第 15.6 节将讨论由此产生的机构层面的冲突。

paragraphs.en: Protect the person’s privacy, and the privacy of the people around them.
paragraphs.zh: 保护当事人及其周围人员的隐私。

paragraphs.en: Do not manipulate. The system that knows a person best is the system best placed to steer them, and it must forgo that ability.
paragraphs.zh: 不得进行操控。 最了解一个人的系统，也最有条件去引导这个人，因此它必须放弃这种能力。

paragraphs.en: Follow the rules the person has accepted, even against a passing wish. A person who sits an examination, signs a contract, or joins a game has accepted its rules, and a symbiont that answers to the interests the person endorses on reflection does not help them break those rules (Section 16.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 遵循此人已经接受的规则，即使这与一时的愿望相悖。 参加考试、签署合同或加入游戏的人已经接受了相应的规则，而一个回应此人在反思时所认可的利益的共生体，不会帮助他们违反这些规则（见 16.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: The aspiration that such a system be unbreakable is replaced by verifiability and tamper evidence: no system is unbreakable, and its behavior can be audited.
paragraphs.zh: 对这样一个系统“坚不可摧”的期望被可验证性和防篡改证据所取代：没有系统是坚不可摧的，但其行为是可以被审计的。

paragraphs.en: A symbiont creates a category of data that has never been collected by any system: the thoughts a person whispers on the private channel, the mental states the system infers, and, as neural interfaces mature, signals of attention and intent read from the body itself. We call it thought data and argue that it deserves protection above every other kind of personal data: local by default, never used for training by default, deletable at any time, and never exchanged with anyone. The neuroethics literature’s discussion of mental privacy applies with little change ( Yuste et al., 2017 ) , and the term cognitive sovereignty names the right at stake.
paragraphs.zh: 共生体会创造出一类从未被任何系统收集过的数据：一个人在私密频道中低声倾诉的想法、系统推断出的心理状态，以及随着神经接口的成熟，从身体本身读取到的注意与意图信号。 我们将其称为思维数据，并认为它应当获得高于其他一切个人数据的保护：默认仅存于本地、默认绝不用于训练、随时可删除、且绝不与任何人交换。 神经伦理学文献中关于精神隐私的讨论几乎无需修改即可适用（Yuste et al., 2017），而“认知主权”一词正指出了其中所涉及的权利。

paragraphs.en: A symbiont hears other people speak and sees their faces. Three requirements follow. Collection must be perceptible to the people nearby. What has passed between the person and someone else may be kept in the person’s record, as a diary would keep it, while inferences about that person serve only the interaction at hand and never accumulate into a portrait (Section 6.7 ); a sensitive fact the person was told about someone else, such as their health, is kept only as told and is never analyzed or passed on. Raw audio and video of other people are kept no longer than the short window in which they serve the person (Section 6.3 ), and where someone asks not to be recorded the device stops. An opt-out is not enough where the law asks for more. Some jurisdictions require the consent of everyone recorded in a private conversation ( State of California, 2024 ) , biometric statutes require written consent before a template of a face is made ( Illinois General Assembly, 2008 ) , and data-protection law requires a lawful basis for processing a bystander’s data and treats biometric data as a special category ( European Parliament and Council of the European Union, 2016 ) . A symbiont therefore follows the strictest rule of the place it is in, which in many places means that it records no conversation at all and serves the person from what they tell it. Contextual integrity explains why the same information is appropriate in one setting and wrong in another ( Nissenbaum, 2004 ) , and studies of bystanders of augmented-reality glasses show what people around a wearer actually want ( Denning et al., 2014 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 共生体（symbiont）会听到其他人说话并看到他们的面孔。 由此得出三项要求。 信息采集必须让附近的人能够感知到。 这个人与他人之间发生的内容可以保存在这个人的记录中，就像日记那样保存，而关于该人的推断只服务于当下的交互，绝不会积累成一份画像（第 6.7 节）；他人告知这个人的关于另一个人的敏感事实，例如其健康状况，只按被告知的内容保存，绝不被分析或转述。 其他人的原始音频和视频的保存时间不超过其对这个人有用的短暂窗口期（第 6.3 节），并且在有人要求不被拍摄时设备会停止。 在法律要求更多时，仅有退出选项是不够的。 一些司法辖区要求私下对话中被录制的每个人都要同意（加利福尼亚州，2024），生物特征法规要求在制作面部模板前取得书面同意（伊利诺伊州议会，2008），而数据保护法要求处理旁观者数据必须有合法依据，并将生物特征数据视为特殊类别（欧洲议会及欧盟理事会，2016）。 因此，共生体遵循其所在地的最严格规则，这在许多地方意味着它完全不录制对话，仅从这个人告诉它的内容来为其服务。 情境完整性解释了为什么同样的信息在一种场景中是合适的而在另一种场景中却是不当的（Nissenbaum，2004），而针对增强现实眼镜旁观者的研究揭示了佩戴者周围的人真正想要什么（Denning 等，2014）。

paragraphs.en: Security takes a new shape. The symbiont holds the person’s whole life, so it is the most valuable thing to attack; it hears what the person hears, so a sentence someone says in front of them can be an injection; it acts and spends for the person, so a hijacked symbiont does real damage; and it rewrites its own harness, so an attack can consist of making it break itself. The paper offers no solution and names four classes of threat with their research directions: data exfiltration, injection through the physical world, manipulation of the intervention policy, and contamination of the self-improvement process.
paragraphs.zh: 安全呈现出新的形态。 共生体承载着个人的全部生活，因此是最值得攻击的目标；它能听到个人所听到的一切，因此别人在其面前说的一句话就可能是一次注入；它替个人行动和消费，因此被劫持的共生体会造成真实的损害；它还会改写自身的运行框架，因此攻击可以只是诱使它自我破坏。 论文没有给出解决方案，而是列出了四类威胁及其研究方向：数据外泄、通过物理世界进行的注入、对干预策略的操纵，以及对自我改进过程的污染。

paragraphs.en: The first question of Part III is who stands to gain, and the answer is almost everyone, from a person with no special job or need to the most demanding expert. A claim of that breadth has no value as a list of wishes, so this section first gives a way of arguing it, then argues population by population, and ends by saying who should not come first.
paragraphs.zh: 第三部分的首要问题是，谁将从中获益，答案几乎是所有人——从没有特殊工作或需求的普通人到要求最苛刻的专家。 这样宽泛的主张如果只是一份愿望清单就毫无价值，因此本节首先给出一种论证它的方法，然后逐个人群进行论证，最后说明谁不应排在首位。

paragraphs.en: The invariant of the paper is what turns “everyone can benefit” into an argument. Everyone pays the cognitive gap of Eq. ( 1 ) every day. How much of it a symbiont can close differs by population, and four criteria say by how much: the size of the gap, how much a group loses daily to forgetting, not noticing, not thinking through, and not finding the words; its observability , whether those losses are visible to the symbiont’s senses, since some gaps happen entirely inside; its closability , whether a row of Table 12 matches it at a usable maturity; and the feasibility of channels and trust , whether the group is willing and able to wear the devices and how far it will authorize them. The natural first population is the one of highest cognitive density, professionals whose gaps are easiest to observe and who will pay to close them. The same symbiont may be worth more to three other groups: older adults whose memory is failing, for whom it is a memory prosthesis; people who are learning, for whom it knows what they do not; and people whose senses or language are limited, for whom it is a channel they lack. Figure 19 maps populations on two of these dimensions, the size and stakes of the gap and how much of it can be closed today (observability times closability), with bubble size for population and color for the maturity of the evidence; feasibility is argued in the text, and the rest of the section argues each bubble.
paragraphs.zh: 论文的不变量是将「人人皆可受益」变成一个论证的关键。 每个人每天都在为式（1）的认知差距付出代价。 共生智能体能弥补多少认知差距因人群而异，四项标准说明了差距有多大：差距的规模，即一个群体每天因遗忘、没有注意到、没有想透彻和找不到言辞而损失多少；可观测性，即这些损失是否对共生智能体的感官可见，因为有些差距完全发生在内部；可弥补性，即表 12 中是否有一行以可用的成熟度对应这一差距；以及渠道与信任的可行性，即该群体是否愿意并能够佩戴这些设备，以及愿意授权到何种程度。 最自然的首选人群是认知密度最高的人群，即专业人员，他们的差距最容易被观测到，并且愿意付费来弥补这些差距。 同一个共生智能体对另外三类人群可能更有价值：记忆力衰退的老年人，对他们而言它是记忆假体；正在学习的人，对他们而言它知道他们所不知道的东西；以及感官或语言受限的人，对他们而言它是他们所缺乏的渠道。 图 19 在其中两个维度上绘制了各个人群，即差距的规模与利害，以及当前可弥补的程度（可观测性乘以可弥补性），气泡大小表示人群规模，颜色表示证据的成熟度；渠道与信任的可行性在正文中论证，本节其余部分逐一论证每个气泡。

paragraphs.en: The gaps of an ordinary day are modest in size and relentless in frequency: a bill, a parcel, a promise to a child; the signs one misses, one’s own fatigue, a partner’s mood; the decisions one cannot think through, whether to change jobs or move; the words one cannot find for a parent or a manager; and the errands of the whole first tier. Most of these are observable, since they happen in calendars, messages, and conversations. Closability is high: the first tier is available now and the everyday emotional and decision functions need research. The obstacle is feasibility, price and trust, and it is the largest obstacle any group faces. The value takes the form of ease: a little less forgotten, a little less wrong, a little more of one’s own time. An ordinary person has no need of Jarvis; a helper that remembers, arrives in time, and does not interrupt is enough. This is also the positive form of the fairness question in Section 15.7 : a paradigm that reaches only those who can pay forgoes its largest total value.
paragraphs.zh: 平凡日子里的小缺口规模不大，却频繁不断：一张账单、一个包裹、对孩子的承诺；错过的信号、自己的疲惫、伴侣的情绪；无法想清楚的决策，比如换工作还是搬家；为父母或上司找不到合适的话语；以及整个第一梯队的各类琐事。 其中大多数都是可观察的，因为它们发生在日历、消息和对话之中。 可闭合性很高：第一梯队现在就能获得，而日常的情感与决策功能仍需研究。 障碍在于可行性、价格与信任，这是任何群体所面临的最大障碍。 价值以轻松的形式呈现：少遗忘一点，少出错一点，多拥有一点自己的时间。 普通人并不需要贾维斯；一个能记住事情、及时出现且不打扰的帮手就足够了。 这也是 15.7 节中公平性问题的正面表述：一个只惠及付费人群的范式，将放弃其最大的总价值。

sents.en: The gaps of an ordinary day are modest in size and relentless in frequency: a bill, a parcel, a promise to a child; the signs one misses, one’s own fatigue, a partner’s mood; the decisions one cannot think through, whether to change jobs or move; the words one cannot find for a parent or a manager; and the errands of the whole first tier.
sents.zh: 平凡日子里的小缺口规模不大，却频繁不断：一张账单、一个包裹、对孩子的承诺；错过的信号、自己的疲惫、伴侣的情绪；无法想清楚的决策，比如换工作还是搬家；为父母或上司找不到合适的话语；以及整个第一梯队的各类琐事。

sents.en: Most of these are observable, since they happen in calendars, messages, and conversations.
sents.zh: 其中大多数都是可观察的，因为它们发生在日历、消息和对话之中。

sents.en: Closability is high: the first tier is available now and the everyday emotional and decision functions need research.
sents.zh: 可闭合性很高：第一梯队现在就能获得，而日常的情感与决策功能仍需研究。

sents.en: The obstacle is feasibility, price and trust, and it is the largest obstacle any group faces.
sents.zh: 障碍在于可行性、价格与信任，这是任何群体所面临的最大障碍。

sents.en: The value takes the form of ease: a little less forgotten, a little less wrong, a little more of one’s own time.
sents.zh: 价值以轻松的形式呈现：少遗忘一点，少出错一点，多拥有一点自己的时间。

sents.zh: 普通人并不需要贾维斯；一个能记住事情、及时出现且不打扰的帮手就足够了。

sents.zh: 这也是 15.7 节中公平性问题的正面表述：一个只惠及付费人群的范式，将放弃其最大的总价值。

paragraphs.en: Researchers, engineers, managers, clinicians, lawyers, founders, negotiators, and diplomats share high decision density, large information loads, short windows, and a high price for a wrong sentence. Their gaps lie in three places: real-time recall in meetings and conversations (Section 9.4 ), threads that span weeks and months (Section 9.2 ), and blindness to their own state under load (Section 9.3 ). The gaps are large, nearly all observable, since the day is lived in screens and meetings, closable with current technology for the meeting case (Section 8 ), and most feasible of all, since this group pays for productivity and will wear the devices. They come first because they are the easiest group on which to verify the paradigm, whatever the size of their need. A researcher gains a record in which every branch of a years-long question is kept, with metacognitive and creative support; a clinician gains real-time recall in consultation and an organized account of what the patient said, with diagnostic decisions explicitly outside the boundary; a manager or negotiator draws most on the relations layer, the shared history with each counterpart, while real-time reading of the other side stays within the limits of Section 15.5 and the law of the workplace. The section treats this group as the most easily verified proving ground.
