paragraphs.en: Learning is where the value of a symbiont is clearest and where restraint matters most. A student gains a tutor that has seen every place they got stuck and can give a hint at the right moment instead of an answer; a language learner gains a hand in real conversation; an adult learner changing fields gains a bridge from what they know to what is new. A teacher gains real-time social cognition in the classroom, which student has fallen behind, and afterwards notes on each student’s progress, kept within the rules the school sets for student data. The gap is large and long; the process is largely observable; closability is moderate, with the effect of one-to-one tutoring as the backdrop ( Bloom, 1984 ) and the evidence of Section 10.5 as the warning; feasibility for minors is a separate question (Section 13.9 ). The default in learning has to be the hint, with “I want to learn this myself” as a first-class option.
paragraphs.zh: 学习是共生体的价值最清晰、也是克制最重要的地方。 学生获得一位见过他们每一处卡壳之处的导师，能在恰当时机给予提示而非答案；语言学习者获得真实对话中的援手；转行学习的成年人获得一座从已知通向新领域的桥梁。 教师获得课堂中的实时社会认知——哪个学生掉队了——以及课后关于每个学生进度的记录，这些记录始终遵守学校为学生数据制定的规则。 差距大而持久；过程在很大程度上可观察；可收尾性中等，有一对一辅导的效果作为背景（Bloom, 1984），并有 10.5 节的证据作为警示；涉及未成年人的可行性是另一个问题（13.9 节）。 学习场景中的默认选项必须是提示，而“我想自己学会”应当是一等选项。

paragraphs.en: Three generations have three gaps. Parents are short of sleep, overloaded, and carried along by their children’s emotions; the symbiont serves the parent, helping them stay steady, remember, and notice, and any sensing of a child passes through the parent’s authorization and is limited to safety and development. Children do not, in this paper, have all-day symbionts of their own; their gaps are served indirectly through parents and teachers, for reasons given in Sections 13.9 and 16.7 . Older adults sit in the upper right of Figure 19 . The gap of memory decline is the most literal instance of Definition 4.1 ; it is highly observable, since the forgotten thing is right there; it has precedent, in the SenseCam studies of memory-impaired patients ( Berry et al., 2007 ) ; and its obstacles are wearing and learning cost, so the symbiont of an older adult must be the simplest of all. The value is independence for a few more years and a few more degrees of connection to family, and the caregivers of Section 9.5 belong to the same picture. The ethical weight here is second only to Section 13.7 : for people whose capacity to consent is declining, authorization itself is the question, and the paper requires proxy authorization with exit available at all times.
paragraphs.zh: 三代人对应三个缺口。 父母睡眠不足、负担过重、被孩子的情绪裹挟；共生体服务于父母，帮助他们保持稳定、记忆和觉察，而任何对孩子的感知都必须经过父母的授权，且仅限于安全与发展方面。 在本文中，儿童并没有自己全天候的共生体；其需求通过父母和教师间接得到满足，理由见第 13.9 节和第 16.7 节。 老年人位于图 19 的右上角。 记忆衰退的缺口是定义 4.1 最直白的实例；它高度可观察，因为被遗忘的东西就在眼前；它有先例，即针对记忆受损患者的 SenseCam 研究（Berry et al., 2007）；其障碍在于佩戴与学习成本，因此老年人的共生体必须是所有共生体中最简单的。 其价值在于多维持几年的独立生活，以及与家人多几分联结，而第 9.5 节的照护者也属于同一幅图景。 这里的伦理分量仅次于第 13.7 节：对于同意能力正在衰退的人，授权本身就是问题所在，因此本文要求采用代理授权，且必须始终可以随时退出。

sents.zh: 三代人对应三个缺口。

paragraphs.en: For people whose abilities are limited, a symbiont is a channel before it is an augmentation, and the evidence here is the most mature in the paper. For blind and low-vision users, first-person description and navigation already exist ( Be My Eyes, 2023 ; Microsoft, 2017 ) , and what the symbiont adds is that it knows the person’s surroundings and their people. For deaf and hard-of-hearing users, live captions and speaker identification are what a line in the glasses was made for. For users with motor impairments, EMG and silent-speech input, neural interfaces as they mature, and the errands of the first tier have the highest value of any group. For people with cognitive differences, there is executive-function support for starting and switching tasks, and real-time support for social cues, where the design must support and never correct, with the person defining what help they want. For migrants, second-language speakers, and dialect communities, the cultural frame switching of Section 9.4 is daily survival. All four criteria score high, and this group already wears assistive devices. The accessibility tradition of “nothing about us without us” applies: these users should define their own symbionts.
paragraphs.zh: 对于能力受限的人群，共生体在成为增强手段之前，首先是一条通道，论文中这方面的证据最为成熟。 对于盲人和低视力用户，第一人称描述与导航已经存在（Be My Eyes, 2023；Microsoft, 2017），共生体的新增价值在于它了解这个人所处的环境以及其身边的人。 对于聋人和听障用户，实时字幕与说话人识别正是眼镜产品线为此而生的功能。 对于运动障碍用户，肌电（EMG）与无声语音输入，以及随着神经接口成熟而带来的能力，使得第一层级的日常事务在该群体中具有所有群体中最高的价值。 对于有认知差异的人群，存在针对任务启动与切换的执行功能支持，以及针对社交线索的实时支持；设计必须提供支持而绝不纠正，由本人定义自己想要的帮助。 对于移民、第二语言使用者和方言社群，第 9.4 节所述的文化框架切换是日常生存所需。 全部四项标准都得高分，而且这一群体已经在使用辅助设备。 “没有我们的参与，就不要做关于我们的决定”这一无障碍传统在此适用：这些用户应当定义自己的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Three groups belong here: people under long-term pressure approaching burnout, people with mild to moderate anxiety or depressive symptoms, and people in professional treatment. The gap is the largest in the paper, since emotional distress consumes cognitive bandwidth directly and shrinks the c t c_{t} of Definition 4.1 . Observability is moderate and rising, since sleep, social withdrawal, and changes in language are all perceptible, and the interpretation of each is fragile. Closability is split: a first randomized trial of a generative chatbot for treatment reported reductions in symptoms ( Heinz et al., 2025 ) , while evidence on unsupervised use over long periods remains thin. Feasibility is paradoxical: this group needs the private channel most and fears for its data most. The position of the paper is to enter through support and early recognition and never through treatment, to make the handoff to professionals part of the function, and to place people in serious distress in the upper left of Figure 19 : a large gap that cannot be closed first.

paragraphs.en: These are people whose work is real-time interaction with others under a high cost of error: frontline service and customer-facing staff (recalling this person, reading this moment), teachers (Section 13.4 ), emergency and safety personnel (an external working memory and checklist under pressure), interpreters and diplomats (all of Section 9.4 ). Their gap is concentrated in real-time social cognition, highly observable, closable to the degree the fast loop’s latency and accuracy allow (Section 8.2 ), and feasible since the workplace already permits worn devices. The ethical question is the employer: whom the symbiont answers to (the commitment of Section 12.3 to answer to the person) is sharpest inside an employment relation, and compelled wearing is one of the cases of the next subsection.
paragraphs.zh: 这些人从事的工作是与他人进行实时互动、且出错代价高昂：一线服务与面向客户的员工（回忆起这个人、读懂当下情境）、教师（见13.4节）、应急与安全人员（压力之下的外部工作记忆与检查清单）、口译员与外交官（整第9.4节）。 他们的缺口集中在实时社会认知上，高度可观察，其可弥补程度取决于快循环的延迟与精度所允许的范围（见8.2节），并且可行，因为工作场所本就允许佩戴设备。 伦理问题在于雇主：共生体向谁负责（即12.3节中向本人负责的承诺）在雇佣关系中最为尖锐，而强制佩戴则是下一小节所讨论的情形之一。

paragraphs.en: Three groups should not be first, and saying so is part of the argument. Children with all-day sensing of their own: consent, development, and the permanence of a lifelong record are unresolved, and children are served through the symbionts of the adults around them. People in acute psychological crisis with a symbiont as their only support: not until handoff paths are mature. Anyone in a compelled setting, an employer’s requirement, an institution’s rule, a correctional facility: the premise of a symbiont is the person’s own authorization, and a compelled system is a monitor, which is one of the futures of Section 15.7 . The resulting order follows. The first adopters are knowledge workers, because they are the easiest to verify. The largest gain per person is for older adults and for people with barriers, because their gaps are the most direct. The largest total gain is in everyday life, because the population is the largest. The research agenda of Section 17 has to design evidence for all three lines separately, and Table 15 closes the section with the dominant gap, functions, channels, risks, and evidence for every population.
paragraphs.zh: 有三个群体不应成为首批用户，而把这一点说出来本身就是论证的一部分。 对于全天候被感知的儿童自身而言：同意、发展以及终身记录的持久性都尚未解决，儿童是依附于其身边成年人的共生体而被服务的。 处于急性心理危机中、且以智能体（ symbiont ）为唯一支持的人：除非交接路径成熟，否则不行。 任何处于被迫环境中的人——雇主的要求、机构的规定、矫正机构：智能体（ symbiont ）的前提是本人的自主授权，而被迫的系统就是监控，这正是 15.7 节所讨论的未来之一。 由此形成的顺序如下。 首批采用者是知识工作者，因为他们最容易被验证。 人均收益最大的是老年人和有障碍的人群，因为他们的缺口最直接。 总收益最大的是日常生活，因为那里的人口规模最大。 第 17 节的研究议程必须分别针对这三条线路设计证据，而表 15 以每个群体的主要缺口、功能、渠道、风险和证据来结束本章。

paragraphs.en: Picture a street, some years from now, on which every individual is augmented. One of them is the researcher of Section 1 . In the morning an idea surfaces while she is alone and she whispers it to the pendant; by the time she sits down it has been filed under the project it belongs to. In a team meeting a colleague asks about a figure she reported last quarter, a line in her glasses reminds her of it, and she answers. At lunch she meets someone whose symbiont and hers established, before either looked up, that they are working on the same problem. In the afternoon her symbiont books the trip to a conference and the meeting she was hoping for, without a question. Walking through a city she does not know, the earpiece tells her how people decline an invitation here. In the evening a project she cares about fails; the symbiont says the one sentence that fits, because it knows what this one cost her, and then it is quiet. Beside her on the street are embodied robots running their own errands and, now and then, shaking hands with a human. What separates this street from today’s is less the devices on it than the fact that the gap of Eq. ( 1 ) is being closed continuously, for everyone, in the moments in which it opens.
paragraphs.zh: 想象一条几年后的街道，街上每个人都得到了增强。 其中一位就是第 1 节中的那位研究者。 清晨，当她独处时一个想法浮现出来，她低声告诉了吊坠；等她坐下时，这个想法已经被归入它所属的项目之下。 在团队会议上，一位同事问她上个季度报告的某个数字，眼镜上的一行字提醒了她，她便做出了回答。 午餐时，她遇到一个人，还没等双方抬头，此人的共生体与她的共生体就已确认：他们正在研究同一个问题。 下午，她的共生体不问一声就订好了去参加一个会议的行程，以及她一直期待的那次会面。 走在一座她不熟悉的城市里，耳机告诉她这里的人们是如何拒绝邀请的。 傍晚，她所关心的一个项目失败了；共生体说出了那句恰如其分的话，因为它知道这个项目让她付出了什么，然后便安静下来。 在她身旁的街道上，有正在办理各自事务的具身机器人，还不时与人握手。 这条街道与今天的街道的差别，与其说在于上面的设备，不如说在于这样一个事实：式 (1) 中的差距 正在被持续地弥合，对每个人而言，在差距出现的每一个瞬间。

paragraphs.en: The scene presupposes everything in Part II and nothing beyond it. Each sentence corresponds to a row of Table 12 , each row carries a maturity, and the scene is therefore a forecast whose date depends on the open problems of Section 17.4 rather than on any single breakthrough. The scene also has a cost that the picture conceals. Every moment of help in it is also a moment of sensing, the street is a place where many records overlap, and the people on it who have no symbiont are present in the records of those who do; these are the concerns of Section 15.7 .

paragraphs.en: Section 2.2 set the augmented human beside the embodied robot as the two forms of intelligent individual in the era of Physical AI, and here the paper states the general claim. The two forms share the cognitive core developed in Sections 6 to 10 , memory, models of situation and mind, timely intervention, and learning from experience, and they differ in whose goals, whose body, and whose responsibility. The implication for embodied intelligence is that the next step for robots is a cognitive core of this kind as much as a better body, and that the two forms will cooperate and compete in the same rooms, with the handshake of Section 9.6 as the first protocol between them. The fiction supplies a clean illustration: Jarvis’s core eventually enters a body and becomes the Vision, a former symbiont that has acquired goals and a body of its own, which is exactly the step from the left column of Figure 4 to the middle one. The paper develops no robotics agenda; it makes this one claim and this one comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 第2.2节将增强人类与具身机器人并列为物理智能时代的两种智能个体形态，本文在此提出总体论断。 这两种形态共享第6至10节所发展的认知核心——记忆、情境与心智模型、及时干预以及从经验中学习，它们的差异在于目标属于谁、身体属于谁、责任属于谁。 这对具身智能的启示是：机器人的下一步不仅在于更好的身体，同样在于这种认知核心，而且这两种形态将在相同的房间中合作与竞争，第9.6节的握手将成为它们之间的首个协议。 小说提供了一个清晰的例证：贾维斯的认知核心最终进入一个身体并成为幻视——一个获得了自身目标和身体的昔日共生体，这正是从图4左栏到中栏的那一步。 本文并未提出机器人学的研究议程；它只提出这一个论断和这一个比较。

sents.en: The paper develops no robotics agenda; it makes this one claim and this one comparison.
sents.zh: 本文并未提出机器人学的研究议程；它只提出这一个论断和这一个比较。

paragraphs.en: A symbiont has no body, and it can borrow the environment. The person walks into a laboratory and it drives the instruments; the person comes home and it runs the house; the external physical world model of Section 7.5 turns from prediction into a basis for action, through the devices of the environment that Section 5.2 placed at the far end of the constellation. The augmented individual is therefore extended in reach as well as in cognition, and the same permission levels that govern acting on the person’s behalf (Section 9.1 ) govern acting in the person’s surroundings. This is the interface between the paper and the line of work in which AI drives the physical world through infrastructure and devices, the right-hand column of Figure 4 , and the paper only marks that the interface exists.
paragraphs.zh: 共生体没有身体，但它可以借用环境。 人走进实验室，它便操控仪器；人回到家中，它便运转房屋；7.5 节的外部物理世界模型从预测转变为行动的基础，通过 5.2 节置于星座远端的那些环境设备来实现。 因此，被增强的个体在认知上得到延伸，在作用范围上也是如此，而代表本人行事的那些权限级别（9.1 节）同样支配着在本人的周遭环境中行事。 这就是本文与「AI 通过基础设施和设备驱动物理世界」这一工作路线——即图 4 右列——之间的接口，本文只是标明该接口的存在。

paragraphs.en: Part II treated risk where it arises inside the system: in what the symbiont collects, what it infers, and what it may do (Section 12 ). This section turns to the risks that arise between the augmented person and everyone else, which design alone does not remove.
paragraphs.zh: 第二部分讨论了系统内部产生的风险：即共生体收集什么、推断什么，以及它可以做什么（第 12 节）。 本节转向增强人与其他人之间产生的风险，这类风险仅靠设计无法消除。

sents.en: Part II treated risk where it arises inside the system: in what the symbiont collects, what it infers, and what it may do (Section 12 ).
sents.zh: 第二部分讨论了系统内部产生的风险：即共生体收集什么、推断什么，以及它可以做什么（第 12 节）。

sents.en: This section turns to the risks that arise between the augmented person and everyone else, which design alone does not remove.
sents.zh: 本节转向增强人与其他人之间产生的风险，这类风险仅靠设计无法消除。

paragraphs.en: Four features of the paradigm, each a design choice made earlier in the paper, change the shape of its risks. The first is attribution. A symbiont changes what a person can do, so its effect appears as the person’s own performance: an answer in an examination, a sentence in a negotiation, a kind word after a loss. Whether such a performance belongs to the person is a question that a system which only completes tasks never raised. The second is invisibility. Discreet delivery (Section 5.4 ) lets a person receive help without interrupting anyone, and the same property hides the help from an examiner, an interviewer, or a friend, which sets the privacy of the person against the accountability that others may expect; this is why the paradigm keeps the content of an exchange private and makes the presence of assistance declarable (Section 16.1 ). The third is reach. The record that holds a person’s life also holds parts of other people’s lives, and the symbiont reads the people its owner meets, so its effects extend to people who never chose it. The fourth is position. Part of what a symbiont provides is valuable only relative to others, in admission, hiring, negotiation, and competition, and where gains are relative, one person’s augmentation is another’s loss and everyone comes under pressure to adopt it; six in ten respondents in a large survey of US adults already expected such pressure should cognitive implants become widespread ( Pew Research Center, 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 该范式的四个特征——每个都是本文前文所作的设计选择——改变了其风险的形态。 第一个是归因。 共生体改变了一个人能做什么，因此其效果表现为这个人自身的表现：考试中的一个答案、谈判中的一句话、失意后的一句暖心话。 这样的表现是否属于这个人，是一个只完成任务式系统从未提出过的问题。 第二个是不可见性。 谨慎交付（第5.4节）让人可以在不打扰任何人的情况下获得帮助，而同一特性也会把这种帮助对考官、面试官或朋友隐藏起来，这就使个人的隐私与他人可能期望的问责形成了对立；正因如此，该范式保持交流内容的私密性，并要求协助的存在可以被声明（第16.1节）。第三个是影响范围。 记录一个人生活的记录也包含着其他人生活的片段，而共生体会读取其主人所接触的人，因此其影响会波及那些从未选择它的人。第四个是位置。 共生体所提供的一部分价值只有在与他人相对时才有意义，例如录取、招聘、谈判和竞争中；在收益是相对的情况下，一个人的增强就是另一个人的损失，而且所有人都会被迫采用它；在美国成年人的一项大规模调查中，已有六成受访者表示，如果认知植入体普及，他们预期会出现这种压力（Pew Research Center, 2022）。

paragraphs.en: Harm runs in three directions around an augmented person, and at the scale of a society the three add up to a collective harm (Figure 20 ). Harm to the person comes from the system, its provider, or an attacker: manipulation and sycophancy, dependence and the loss of skills, errors and false memories, exposure of thought data, and lock-in to one provider. These are treated where they arise, in Sections 10.5 and 12 , and the evidence on dependence keeps accumulating. People who expect information to remain available remember where to find it better than the information itself ( Sparrow et al., 2011 ) , although a large replication project could not reproduce another experiment of the same study ( Camerer et al., 2018 ) ; habitual reliance on satellite navigation goes with weaker spatial memory ( Dahmani and Bohbot, 2020 ) , knowledge workers who trust generative AI more report engaging less in critical thinking ( Lee et al., 2025 ) , and a first neurophysiological study of essay writing with a language model, a small preprint, points the same way ( Kosmyna et al., 2025 ) . Most of this evidence points one way, so the loss of skills is treated here as a primary risk, and retention (Section 17.1 ) has to be reported alongside every gain. Manipulation has a measured basis as well: a language model given a few facts about its opponent was more persuasive than a human in controlled debates ( Salvi et al., 2025 ) , and a symbiont holds far more than a few facts. A system that answers to one person is also exposed to sycophancy, the tendency of models trained on human preferences to tell people what they want to hear ( Sharma et al., 2023 ) , which in a symbiont would wear away the honesty that makes its help worth having. Error is a harm of its own kind, because a wrong cue delivered in real time is often spoken aloud as the person’s own before anyone can check it, and a system that holds a person’s memories can also distort them: in a study of witness interviews, a chatbot built on a language model induced more than three times as many false memories as a control condition ( Chan et al., 2024 ) . Harm through the person runs outward, when the owner’s augmented capability is used on others: covert assistance in assessment, covert scripting in conversation, covert inference about the people the owner meets, an advantage in negotiation that the other side cannot see, and fraud carried out with real-time cues.
paragraphs.zh: 伤害围绕一个被增强的人沿三个方向延伸，而在整个社会的尺度上，这三者叠加为集体伤害（图 20）。 对个人的伤害来自系统、其提供者或攻击者：操纵与谄媚、依赖与技能丧失、错误与虚假记忆、思维数据的暴露，以及对单一提供者的锁定。 这些问题在出现之处已有讨论，见第 10.5 节和第 12 节，而关于依赖的证据仍在不断积累。 期望信息保持可获取的人，记住到哪里找到信息胜过记住信息本身（Sparrow 等，2011），不过一项大型重复验证项目未能重现同一研究的另一个实验（Camerer 等，2018）；习惯性依赖卫星导航伴随较弱的空间记忆（Dahmani 和 Bohbot，2020），更信任生成式 AI 的知识工作者自述较少进行批判性思考（Lee 等，2025），而一项关于使用语言模型写作文章的初步神经生理学研究（一份小型预印本）也指向同一方向（Kosmyna 等，2025）。 这方面证据大多指向同一方向，因此技能丧失在此被视为一种主要风险，且每一次能力增益都必须连同技能保留情况（第 17.1 节）一并报告。 操纵也有实测依据：在受控辩论中，一个被给予关于对手少量事实的语言模型比人类更有说服力（Salvi 等，2025），而共生体掌握的事实远不止少量。 只对一个人负责的系统也面临谄媚问题，即在人类偏好上训练的模型倾向于说人们想听的话（Sharma 等，2023），这在共生体中会侵蚀使其帮助值得拥有的诚实性。 错误是另一类伤害，因为实时提供的错误提示往往在任何人来得及核实之前就被当事人当作自己的话脱口而出，而掌握一个人记忆的系统也能扭曲这些记忆：在一项证人访谈研究中，一个基于语言模型构建的聊天机器人诱导的虚假记忆是对照条件的三倍多（Chan 等，2024）。 通过个人向外延伸的伤害出现在所有者的增强能力被用于他人之时：评估中的隐蔽辅助、对话中的隐蔽脚本、对所会面者的隐蔽推断、对方无法察觉的谈判优势，以及借助实时提示实施的欺诈。

paragraphs.en: Whether people will accept a machine that makes others more capable is an empirical question, and the evidence so far is cautious. In a survey of more than ten thousand US adults, a majority judged brain implants that improve cognition a bad idea for society ( Pew Research Center, 2022 ) . Studies of attitudes toward pharmacological enhancement find that lay judgments against it are driven above all by perceived unfairness, more than by the sense that an enhanced achievement is hollow or undeserved ( Faber et al., 2016 ) . The philosophical debate runs between the view that the enhancement of healthy people should be assessed on evidence and regulated responsibly ( Greely et al., 2008 ; Bostrom and Sandberg, 2009 ) and the view that the drive to enhance erodes the appreciation of what is given ( Sandel, 2007 ) . Three conclusions follow for the paradigm. Acceptance depends on purpose: restoring a lost ability is accepted, everyday support is largely accepted, and enhancement in competition and in emotional life is contested, and the order in which Section 13 proposes to serve populations follows this gradient. What a symbiont raises is performance in a situation, the gain of Eq. ( 2 ), together with whatever ability remains after it is removed, the retention defined in Section 17.1 ; the paper claims no increase in a trait such as intelligence or emotional skill. And since fairness is the main objection, the design question becomes how to keep augmentation fair where fairness matters, which Section 16 answers.
paragraphs.zh: 人们是否会接受一种能提升他人能力的机器，这是一个经验性问题，而目前给出的证据是审慎的。 在一项针对一万多名美国成年人的调查中，多数人认为能够提升认知的脑植入物对社会而言是个坏主意（ Pew Research Center, 2022 ）。 关于药物增强的态度研究发现，外行对其持反对判断，首要驱动因素是感知到的不公平，而非认为增强后取得的成就空洞或不配得（ Faber et al., 2016 ）。 哲学上的争论介于两种观点之间：一种观点认为对健康人的增强应基于证据加以评估并负责任地监管（ Greely et al., 2008 ; Bostrom and Sandberg, 2009 ），另一种观点认为增强的冲动会侵蚀对既有禀赋的珍视（ Sandel, 2007 ）。 由此可为本范式得出三点结论。 接受度取决于用途：恢复丧失的能力被接受，日常辅助大体被接受，而竞争领域和情感生活中的增强则存在争议，第 13 节提出的服务人群顺序正是遵循这一梯度。 共生体带来的是在特定情境中的表现提升，即式 ( 2 ) 的增益，连同移除后所保留的能力，即第 17.1 节定义的保留度；本文不声称智能体在智力或情感技能等特质上有所增加。 而既然公平是主要的反对理由，设计问题就变成了如何在公平至关重要的地方保持增强的公平性，第 16 节对此作出了回答。

sents.en: Whether people will accept a machine that makes others more capable is an empirical question, and the evidence so far is cautious.
sents.zh: 人们是否会接受一种能提升他人能力的机器，这是一个经验性问题，而目前给出的证据是审慎的。

sents.en: In a survey of more than ten thousand US adults, a majority judged brain implants that improve cognition a bad idea for society ( Pew Research Center, 2022 ) .
sents.zh: 在一项针对一万多名美国成年人的调查中，多数人认为能够提升认知的脑植入物对社会而言是个坏主意（ Pew Research Center, 2022 ）。

sents.en: Studies of attitudes toward pharmacological enhancement find that lay judgments against it are driven above all by perceived unfairness, more than by the sense that an enhanced achievement is hollow or undeserved ( Faber et al., 2016 ) .
sents.zh: 关于药物增强的态度研究发现，外行对其持反对判断，首要驱动因素是感知到的不公平，而非认为增强后取得的成就空洞或不配得（ Faber et al., 2016 ）。

sents.en: The philosophical debate runs between the view that the enhancement of healthy people should be assessed on evidence and regulated responsibly ( Greely et al., 2008 ; Bostrom and Sandberg, 2009 ) and the view that the drive to enhance erodes the appreciation of what is given ( Sandel, 2007 ) .
sents.zh: 哲学上的争论介于两种观点之间：一种观点认为对健康人的增强应基于证据加以评估并负责任地监管（ Greely et al., 2008 ; Bostrom and Sandberg, 2009 ），另一种观点认为增强的冲动会侵蚀对既有禀赋的珍视（ Sandel, 2007 ）。

sents.en: Three conclusions follow for the paradigm.
sents.zh: 由此可为本范式得出三点结论。

sents.en: Acceptance depends on purpose: restoring a lost ability is accepted, everyday support is largely accepted, and enhancement in competition and in emotional life is contested, and the order in which Section 13 proposes to serve populations follows this gradient.
sents.zh: 接受度取决于用途：恢复丧失的能力被接受，日常辅助大体被接受，而竞争领域和情感生活中的增强则存在争议，第 13 节提出的服务人群顺序正是遵循这一梯度。

sents.en: And since fairness is the main objection, the design question becomes how to keep augmentation fair where fairness matters, which Section 16 answers.
sents.zh: 而既然公平是主要的反对理由，设计问题就变成了如何在公平至关重要的地方保持增强的公平性，第 16 节对此作出了回答。

paragraphs.en: Assessment is where the conflict is sharpest, because an examination exists to measure what a person can do. Three kinds of assessment have to be kept apart. Some certify unaided ability, because the person will later have to act alone, as in the licensing of a profession whose emergencies leave no time to consult anything. Some measure performance with the tools of the work, as open-book examinations and most jobs already do. Some give a learner feedback, and there what matters is that learning takes place. A symbiont that is legitimate in the second kind defeats the first and can empty the third, so a single rule for all assessment cannot work. Learning raises a problem that examinations only make visible. A student who hands homework to a symbiont gains a grade and loses the practice, which is the loss of retention in its most familiar form, and it is the reason the symbiont of Sections 9.2 and 13.4 gives hints by default. A symbiont worn all day turns what is now an occasional temptation, a phone smuggled into an examination hall, into a standing condition of every assessment, and Section 16.2 gives the response.
paragraphs.zh: 评估是冲突最尖锐的地方，因为考试的存在就是为了衡量一个人能做什么。 有三种评估必须区分开来。 有些评估认证的是无辅助的能力，因为此人日后必须独立行动，例如对某个职业的执业许可——该职业面对紧急情况时没有时间查阅任何资料。 有些评估是借助工作的工具来衡量表现的，就像开卷考试以及大多数工作已经在做的那样。 有些评估是给学习者提供反馈的，在那里重要的是学习是否发生。 在第二种评估中正当的共生体在第一种评估中属于作弊，并可能使第三种评估落空，因此用单一规则适用于所有评估是行不通的。 学习提出了一个问题，而考试只是让这个问题显形而已。 把作业交给共生体的学生得到了分数，却失去了练习，这是记忆留存流失最常见的形态，这也正是 9.2 节和 13.4 节的共生体默认给出提示的原因。 全天佩戴的共生体把如今偶发的诱惑——被偷带进考场的手机——变成了每一次评估的常态条件，16.2 节给出了应对之策。

paragraphs.en: In a conversation the other party is affected directly, and assistance comes in four kinds whose rules tighten in order. Reminding a person of their own facts, a figure they reported or where a discussion left off, is the equivalent of a glance at notes and is accepted in most settings. Rehearsal before a conversation and review after it affect no one else. Persuasive or emotional lines supplied in real time, in a negotiation, a quarrel, or a courtship, are different, because the other party believes they are hearing the person, and the sincerity of an apology or a kind word is part of what it means. Inference about the other party, their mood, their hesitation, or their identity, is the most sensitive, because that person has consented to nothing. Identifying strangers from their faces has already been demonstrated with consumer glasses (I-XRAY) ( 404 Media, 2024 ) , and inferring the emotions of people in workplaces and educational institutions is prohibited in the European Union ( European Parliament and Council of the European Union, 2024 ) . The paradigm takes a position on each kind. A person’s own facts may be supplied freely. Real-time persuasive or emotional scripting is disclosed when it is used and switched off where a setting forbids it. Inferences about another person serve only the interaction at hand and never accumulate (Section 6.7 ); a symbiont never identifies a stranger, never infers emotions where the law forbids it, and answers truthfully when the other party asks whether the person is being assisted, whether or not that party has a symbiont, showing the status on the device itself where a setting requires it; between two symbionts, the visible ring of the handshake protocol can carry it (Section 9.6 ). Not identifying strangers has a technical cost that should be stated: faces are matched on the device only against the contacts the owner has enrolled, and a face without a match is discarded at once, but the matching still has to examine every face in view, and where biometric law requires consent before a template of a face is made ( Illinois General Assembly, 2008 ) , recognition stays off. The underlying capability is the same as that of a tool sold for cheating in interviews and sales calls, and what separates a symbiont from such a tool is the rules it keeps and the person it answers to.
paragraphs.zh: 在对话中，对方是直接受影响的一方，协助分为四类，其规则依次趋严。 提醒一个人其自身的事实、其报告过的某个数字或某次讨论进行到哪里，相当于看一眼笔记，在大多数场合是被接受的。 对话前的演练和对话后的复盘不影响任何其他人。 在谈判、争吵或求爱中实时提供的说服性或情感性语句则不同，因为对方以为自己听到的是这个人本人，而道歉或善意言辞的真诚性是其含义的一部分。 对对方的推断，包括其情绪、其犹豫或其身份，是最敏感的，因为那个人未曾同意任何事。 通过消费级眼镜识别陌生人已被演示过（I-XRAY）（404 Media, 2024），而在欧盟，推断工作场所和教育机构中人员的情绪是被禁止的（European Parliament and Council of the European Union, 2024）。 该范式对每一类都表明了立场。 一个人自身的事实可以被自由提供。 实时的说服性或情感性话术脚本在使用时予以披露，并在规则禁止的场合被关闭。 关于另一个人的推断仅服务于当前的交互，且从不累积（第 6.7 节）；智能体绝不识别陌生人，绝不在法律禁止之处推断情绪，并在对方询问这个人是否正被协助时如实回答，无论对方是否拥有智能体，在规则要求的场合还应在设备本身上显示该状态；在两个智能体之间，握手协议的可见光环可以承载这一信息（第 9.6 节）。 不识别陌生人有一个应当说明的技术代价：人脸只在设备上与机主已录入的联系人进行比对，未匹配到的人脸会被立即丢弃，但比对仍须检视视野中的每一张脸，而在生物特征法律要求在制作人脸模板之前须获得同意的地方（Illinois General Assembly, 2008），识别功能保持关闭。 其底层能力与那些用于面试和销售通话作弊的工具相同，而智能体与这类工具的区别在于它遵守的规则以及它所服务的人。

paragraphs.en: Institutions can turn a symbiont against the person who wears it. An employer or a school that requires one obtains a monitor with a better view than any camera, and the commitment of Section 12.3 to answer to the person does not survive a compelled setting (Section 13.9 ). A lifelong record is also evidence: it can be demanded in a dispute or at a border, or used by an insurer or an employer to price or screen a person, and the inferred mental states it contains make it more revealing than any record kept before. Where a provider earns its revenue from advertising or from the institution that pays for the device, loyalty to the person becomes a matter of business model, which the market layer of Section 16.6 has to carry. A state can mandate the device outright. Law has begun to respond to the most intimate part of such a record. Chile amended its constitution in 2021 to protect brain activity and the information derived from it ( Republic of Chile, 2021 ) , Colorado classified neural data as sensitive personal data in 2024 ( Colorado General Assembly, 2024 ) , UNESCO adopted a recommendation on the ethics of neurotechnology in 2025 ( UNESCO, 2025 ) , and the proposed rights to cognitive liberty and mental privacy ( Ienca and Andorno, 2017 ) anticipate the thought data of Section 12.4 . These instruments address neural signals, and a record that joins a whole life to inferences about a mind falls between them; local storage by default, encryption under the person’s control, and short retention of raw streams (Section 6.3 ) are the technical half of the answer.
paragraphs.zh: 机构可以让共生体转而对抗佩戴它的人。 要求佩戴设备的雇主或学校所获得的监控视角胜过任何摄像头，而第12.3节中向本人负责的承诺在强制环境下无法维持（第13.9节）。 终身记录也是证据：它可能在纠纷中或边境被要求出示，或被保险公司或雇主用来为一个人定价或筛选，而其中所包含的推断出的心理状态使它比以往任何记录都更能暴露内情。 当服务商的收入来自广告或来自为设备付费的机构时，对本人的忠诚就成为一个商业模式问题，这必须由第16.6节的市场层来承担。 国家可以直接强制佩戴该设备。 法律已开始回应这类记录中最私密的部分。 智利于2021年修订宪法以保护大脑活动及其派生信息（智利共和国，2021），科罗拉多州于2024年将神经数据列为敏感个人数据（科罗拉多州议会，2024），联合国教科文组织于2025年通过了关于神经技术伦理的建议书（UNESCO，2025），而关于认知自由与心理隐私的拟议权利（Ienca and Andorno, 2017）则预示了第12.4节的思想数据。 这些文件针对的是神经信号，而一份将整个人生与对心智的推断结合起来的记录落在它们的间隙之中；默认本地存储、由本人控制的加密以及对原始数据流的短期保留（第6.3节）是答案的技术部分。

sents.zh: 这些文件针对的是神经信号，而一份将整个人生与对心智的推断结合起来的记录落在它们的间隙之中；默认本地存储、由本人控制的加密以及对原始数据流的短期保留（第6.3节）是答案的技术部分。

paragraphs.en: At the scale of a society, the harms of this section add up to effects that no single pair of people can show.
paragraphs.zh: 在社会层面上，本节所述的危害累积成任何单对人都无法证明的影响。

paragraphs.en: When the handshake of Section 9.6 scales to a crowd, the gain is lower social friction, fewer missed encounters, and fewer cross-cultural misunderstandings. The harm, when every symbiont optimizes for its owner, is homogeneity, since one only ever meets people like oneself; manipulation, since symbionts can game one another; and exclusion, since people without a symbiont are systematically overlooked. Whether the four rings of authorization hold under optimization by both sides, and what the equilibrium of a crowd of such systems looks like, are research questions at the level of the group (Section 17.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 当第 9.6 节描述的握手扩展到人群规模时，其收益是更少的社会摩擦、更少的错失相遇和更少的跨文化误解。 当每个共生体都为其主人进行优化时，其危害是同质化——因为人们只会遇到与自己相似的人；操纵——因为共生体可以相互博弈；以及排斥——因为没有共生体的人会被系统性地忽视。 四环授权在双方都被优化的情况下是否依然成立，以及由大量此类系统构成的人群的均衡是什么样，这是属于群体层面（第 17.4 节）的研究问题。

paragraphs.en: If the most effective cognitive augmentation belongs to those who can pay, the gap between groups widens, and Section 13 showed that the people who need it most may be the least able to pay and that the largest total value lies with the people least willing to. Where gains are positional the problem compounds, because each adoption raises the cost of not adopting, and an equilibrium in which everyone wears a symbiont and no one is better off is a possible outcome. Section 16.5 takes up provision.
paragraphs.zh: 如果最有效的认知增强只属于那些付得起钱的人，群体之间的差距就会扩大，而第13节已经表明，最需要它的人可能最没有能力付费，而最大的总价值恰恰存在于最不愿意付费的人身上。 当收益是位置性的（positional）时，问题会更加复杂，因为每一次采用都会抬高不采用的代价，而“每个人都佩戴共生体、却没有一个人过得更好”的均衡是一种可能的结果。 第16.5节将讨论供给问题。

paragraphs.en: If anyone might be assisted, every conversation carries a doubt about whom one is talking to, and the trust people place in an unassisted exchange may wear thin. Norms will have to settle which settings presume assistance and which presume its absence, as norms once settled when a phone may lie on a dinner table.
paragraphs.zh: 如果有人可能借助智能体，那么每场对话都会带着对交谈对象究竟是谁的疑虑，人们对无智能体协助的交流所寄予的信任也可能逐渐消磨。 哪些场合默认有智能体协助、哪些场合默认没有，需要由规范来厘定，正如规范曾经厘定了电话可以放在餐桌上一样。

paragraphs.en: Ideas from a language model made individual stories more creative and the collection of stories more alike ( Doshi and Hauser, 2024 ) . When billions of people take suggestions from a few models, the same trade-off acts on opinions and decisions, and the diversity of thought in a population becomes a quantity to be measured.
paragraphs.zh: 来自语言模型的想法使个体故事更具创造性，而故事合集则更加相似（Doshi and Hauser, 2024）。 当数十亿人接受少数几个模型的建议时，同样的权衡便作用于观点和决策，群体的思想多样性也随之成为一项需要度量的指标。

paragraphs.en: A society that relies on symbionts loses capacity when they fail, since an outage at a widely used provider would leave many people without their memory aids, routes, and errands at once, and a few providers holding the records of billions would concentrate a power that no company has held. The ability to work without the symbiont is therefore a public good as well as a personal one, and portability across providers (Section 10.4 ) is a defense against concentration.
paragraphs.zh: 一个依赖共生体的社会在共生体失效时会丧失能力，因为被广泛使用的服务商一旦宕机，会让许多人同时失去他们的记忆辅助、路线和待办事务，而少数掌握数十亿人记录的服务商将集中起前所未有的权力。 因此，在没有共生体的情况下运作的能力既是个人利益，也是公共利益，而跨服务商的可移植性（第 10.4 节）是防止这种集中的防御手段。

paragraphs.en: A symbiont for everyone has a material cost: electricity demand from data centres is projected to roughly double by 2030 ( International Energy Agency, 2025 ) , and an always-available companion for each person adds to it, which is why compute per person per day (Section 11.4 ) belongs in every report of a system’s value. Its effects on work run in both directions, since the help that makes a person more capable can also make that person easier to replace, and which effect dominates is an empirical question the paper cannot settle. The language and dialect support of Section 9.4 could also flatten what it serves, if a few models teach millions of people the same way to greet, decline, and apologize in a culture.
paragraphs.zh: 为每个人配备一个共生智能体有实际的物质成本：据预测，到2030年数据中心的电力需求将大约翻一番（国际能源署，2025），而每个人随时可用的伙伴会进一步推高这一需求，这也是为什么人均每日算力（第11.4节）应当出现在每份关于系统价值的报告中。 它对工作的影响是双向的，因为使人更有能力的帮助也可能使人更容易被替代，而哪种效应占主导是一个本文无法解决的实证问题。 第9.4节的语言和方言支持也可能反过来拉平它所服务的内容，如果少数几个模型以同样的方式教会数百万人如何在一个文化中问候、拒绝和道歉。

paragraphs.en: The paradigm is designed against five futures. The first is a world in which everything is recorded and no one can leave; the second, a world in which people have outsourced their thinking entirely; the third, a world in which a symbiont is more loyal to someone else than to its owner; the fourth, a world in which symbionts are used to deceive the people their owners deal with; and the fifth, a system that improves itself with no one able to audit what it changed, which in the fiction is Ultron, a separate project whose goals parted from its maker’s and whose growth no one could see. The design principles of Table 14 and the governance of Section 16 are written against these five, and the conditions of Section 17.6 include the costs that would make the first two unavoidable.
paragraphs.zh: 该范式是针对五种未来而设计的。 第一种是万物皆被记录、无人能够离开的世界；第二种是人们完全将思考外包出去的世界；第三种是共生体对他人比对其主人更忠诚的世界；第四种是共生体被用来欺骗其主人所打交道之人的世界；第五种是一个自我改进却无人能审计其改动内容的系统，在小说中它就是奥创——一个独立项目，其目标与其缔造者分道扬镳，其成长也无人能够看见。 表14的设计原则与第16节的治理正是针对这五种未来而写，第17.6节的条件也包含了会使前两种未来不可避免地发生的代价。

paragraphs.en: Earlier cognitive enhancements were hard to govern because they could not be seen or switched off; a stimulant taken before an examination leaves no trace in the room. A symbiont differs in the respect that matters. It is external, removable, and inspectable, so it can follow the rules of the settings a person enters and show that it did. This section turns that property into mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的认知增强之所以难以治理，是因为它们无法被看见，也无法被关闭；考试前服用的一粒兴奋剂不会在房间里留下任何痕迹。 共生体在关键之处有所不同。 它是外置的、可移除的、可检查的，因此可以遵循人所进入场景的规则，并证明自己确实遵循了。 本节将把这一特性转化为具体机制。

paragraphs.en: The governing principle separates what is said from whether help is being given. What a person and their symbiont say to each other belongs to the person, and no setting has a claim on it (Section 12.4 ). Whether the person is being assisted, and at what level, is a different kind of fact, and a setting such as an examination, a court, a game, or a negotiation may ask for it. In such settings the default is to declare it, without waiting to be asked. Keeping the two apart resolves the conflict named in Section 15.1 : the private channel stays private, and the presence of assistance becomes legible where it matters.
paragraphs.zh: 主导原则将「说了什么」与「是否在提供帮助」区分开来。 一个人与其共生体之间互相说出的内容属于这个人本人，任何场合都无权索取它（见第 12.4 节）。 这个人是否正在获得协助、以及协助到什么程度，则是另一类事实，考试、法庭、游戏或谈判等场合可能会要求知晓它。 在这类场合中，默认做法是主动申报，而不必等到被问起。 将两者分开便化解了第 15.1 节所指出的冲突：私密渠道保持私密，而协助的存在在重要的地方变得清晰可辨。

paragraphs.en: A setting can declare an assistance policy, and the symbiont follows it by design. The policies form a short scale: unassisted; accessibility only; the person’s own record only; and full assistance. A venue announces its policy at the door or in the invitation, the symbiont recognizes it, changes mode, and records that it did, and the sixth commitment of the symbiont’s code (Section 12.3 ) makes the policy binding against a passing wish of the owner, since a person who entered the setting accepted its rules. Precedents exist for each part. Examination boards publish lists of approved calculators, so that a permitted aid has a known capability; open-book examinations define a level of allowed help; competitive chess combines device bans, delayed broadcasts, and statistical detection of engine assistance, and its online platforms publish the findings of their fair-play investigations ( Chess.com, 2022 ) ; and chatbot providers have already restricted their services for the duration of a national examination (Section 1.3 ). Detection on its own is an arms race that the detector tends to lose, which is why the policy has to be honored by the device itself, with detection kept as a check.
paragraphs.zh: 设置可以声明一项协助政策，而共生体在设计上遵循它。 这些政策构成一个短量表：无协助；仅无障碍功能；仅本人自己的记录；以及完全协助。 场所在门口或邀请函中公布其政策，共生体识别它、切换模式并记录自己这样做，而共生体准则的第六项承诺（第12.3节）使该政策对业主的一时之愿具有约束力，因为进入该设置的人已经接受了其规则。 每个部分都有先例。 考试委员会公布获准计算器的清单，使被允许的辅助工具具有已知的能力；开卷考试定义了允许帮助的程度；竞技象棋结合了设备禁令、延迟转播以及对引擎协助的统计检测，其在线平台公布公平竞赛调查的结果（Chess.com，2022）；聊天机器人提供商已经在一次全国性考试期间限制其服务（第1.3节）。 单靠检测是一场检测者往往注定失败的军备竞赛，这正是为什么政策必须由设备本身来遵守，而检测只作为一种核查手段保留。

sents.en: A setting can declare an assistance policy, and the symbiont follows it by design.
sents.zh: 设置可以声明一项协助政策，而共生体在设计上遵循它。

sents.en: The policies form a short scale: unassisted; accessibility only; the person’s own record only; and full assistance.
sents.zh: 这些政策构成一个短量表：无协助；仅无障碍功能；仅本人自己的记录；以及完全协助。

sents.en: A venue announces its policy at the door or in the invitation, the symbiont recognizes it, changes mode, and records that it did, and the sixth commitment of the symbiont’s code (Section 12.3 ) makes the policy binding against a passing wish of the owner, since a person who entered the setting accepted its rules.
sents.zh: 场所在门口或邀请函中公布其政策，共生体识别它、切换模式并记录自己这样做，而共生体准则的第六项承诺（第12.3节）使该政策对业主的一时之愿具有约束力，因为进入该设置的人已经接受了其规则。

sents.en: Precedents exist for each part.
sents.zh: 每个部分都有先例。

sents.en: Examination boards publish lists of approved calculators, so that a permitted aid has a known capability; open-book examinations define a level of allowed help; competitive chess combines device bans, delayed broadcasts, and statistical detection of engine assistance, and its online platforms publish the findings of their fair-play investigations ( Chess.com, 2022 ) ; and chatbot providers have already restricted their services for the duration of a national examination (Section 1.3 ).
sents.zh: 考试委员会公布获准计算器的清单，使被允许的辅助工具具有已知的能力；开卷考试定义了允许帮助的程度；竞技象棋结合了设备禁令、延迟转播以及对引擎协助的统计检测，其在线平台公布公平竞赛调查的结果（Chess.com，2022）；聊天机器人提供商已经在一次全国性考试期间限制其服务（第1.3节）。

sents.en: Detection on its own is an arms race that the detector tends to lose, which is why the policy has to be honored by the device itself, with detection kept as a check.
sents.zh: 单靠检测是一场检测者往往注定失败的军备竞赛，这正是为什么政策必须由设备本身来遵守，而检测只作为一种核查手段保留。

paragraphs.en: A policy is useful only if keeping it can be shown. A person should be able to prove that their symbiont was in a given mode for a given period without revealing anything it holds. The ingredients exist in other fields: tamper-evident logs, hardware attestation of the software running on a device, and cryptographic proofs that establish one statement and reveal nothing else. Combining them into a proof that a symbiont kept a policy, that a modified device cannot forge, and that leaks nothing about the record is an open problem (Table 18 ). The design also has a limit that should be stated plainly. Such a proof shows that the declared device abstained, and it cannot show that the person carried no second device, ran an open model on modified hardware, or was coached by someone outside the room. Against an owner set on cheating, architecture helps little, and the weight falls where it falls today: on the design of assessment, on observation and detection, and on the sanctions of norms and law. What a symbiont can do is make compliance cheap and checkable for the many people who intend to comply, which narrows the problem to the few who do not. The same machinery yields a record of when assistance was given, which a person may choose to disclose, much as authors now disclose the use of AI in their writing.
paragraphs.zh: 一项策略只有在能够证明其被保持时才有用。 一个人应当能够证明其共生体在给定时段内处于给定模式，而不泄露它所持有的任何内容。 所需的要素在其他领域已经存在：防篡改日志、对设备上运行软件的硬件证明，以及确立某一陈述且不泄露其他任何信息的密码学证明。 将它们组合成一个证明——证明共生体保持了策略、修改过的设备无法伪造、且不泄露关于记录的任何信息——仍是一个开放问题（表 18）。 这一设计还有一个应当坦率指出的局限。 这样的证明只能表明所声明的设备 abstained 了 abstention，却无法表明该人没有携带第二台设备、没有在改装硬件上运行开放模型，或没有受到房间外某人的指点。 面对执意作弊的使用者，架构帮助不大，其重心仍落在今天所在之处：落在评估的设计上，落在观察与检测上，落在规范与法律的制裁上。 共生体所能做的，是让那些本意遵守的人能够以低成本实现合规并加以核验，从而把问题收窄到少数不打算遵守的人身上。 同样的机制还能生成一份何时获得协助的记录，个人可以选择披露它，正如如今作者披露其写作中使用人工智能一样。

paragraphs.en: Credentials should measure what the role requires. Where a role requires unaided ability, the credential measures the person with the symbiont in the unassisted mode; where the role is carried out with tools, it measures the person with the tools; and in learning, what is measured over time is retention (Section 17.1 ), the ability that remains when the symbiont is removed. Assessment will also change form, toward oral examination held under the unassisted policy, observed process, and tasks whose value lies in reasoning that cannot be handed over in a line. The vignette Exam Day below shows the parts working together.
paragraphs.zh: 凭证应衡量该角色所要求的能力。 当角色要求无辅助能力时，凭证衡量的是智能体处于无辅助模式下的人；当角色借助工具完成时，衡量的是使用工具的人；而在学习中，随时间衡量的是保留度（见 17.1 节），即智能体被移除后仍然保留下来的能力。 评估形式也将发生变化，转向在无辅助政策下进行的口试、被观察的过程，以及那些价值在于无法用一行话交出去的推理的任务。 下面的短文「考试日」展示了这些部分如何协同工作。

paragraphs.en: Two questions of access arise once policies exist. The first is accommodation. For a person with a sensory, motor, or cognitive impairment a symbiont is a channel before it is an augmentation (Section 13.6 ), and a policy that ignores this excludes them; the exemptions that sport grants for the therapeutic use of otherwise banned substances show the form an accommodation framework can take. The second is equal provision. Where a setting allows assistance, the fairness objection of Section 15.3 is met by giving everyone the same level, as an examination supplies or approves a standard calculator, and outside such settings by forms of provision that reach people who cannot pay (Section 15.7 ). Equal provision can equalize the assistance a setting permits, while the years of personal record behind it stay unequal, so a setting that needs strict fairness uses the unassisted mode or a standard symbiont without personal context.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦政策存在，就会出现两个关于获取途径的问题。 第一个是无障碍适配。 对于有感觉、运动或认知障碍的人来说，共生体首先是一种渠道，其次才是增强手段（第13.6节）；忽视这一点的政策就把他们排除在外了。体育界对原本禁用的物质出于治疗目的使用的豁免，展示了无障碍适配框架可以采取的形式。 第二个是平等供给。 在允许辅助的场景中，通过给每个人相同的水平来回应第15.3节的公平性异议，就像考试提供或批准标准计算器一样；在此类场景之外，则通过能够惠及无力付费人群的供给形式来实现（第15.7节）。 平等供给可以拉平一个场景所允许的辅助水平，但其背后多年的个人记录仍然不平等，因此需要严格公平的场景应使用无辅助模式，或使用不含个人背景的标准智能体（symbiont）。

paragraphs.en: Governance runs on five layers, and the paper proposes law for none of them. Design is the layer this paper controls: the code, the policies a symbiont honors, and the proofs it can give. Norms belong to settings and professions, which decide what assistance they allow, as journals have decided how authors disclose the use of AI. Law sets the floor, through data protection ( European Parliament and Council of the European Union, 2016 ) , the prohibitions of the European AI Act, and the emerging law of neural data (Section 15.6 ). Markets matter because the business model of a provider decides whom its symbionts serve, and independent audit of providers is a condition of trust. Research supplies the evidence that each of the other layers needs, and Section 17 organizes it. Design, norms, law, and markets are the four modalities of regulation that Lessig (1999) described, and of the four, norms and law will carry most of the weight, because design binds only the devices that comply.
paragraphs.zh: 治理运行在五个层面上，而本文不打算为其中任何一层立法。 设计是本文所能掌控的层面：包括代码、共生体所遵循的策略，以及它能给出的证明。 规范属于具体环境和职业领域，由它们决定允许何种协助，正如期刊已决定作者应如何披露人工智能的使用。 法律设定了底线，通过数据保护（欧洲议会和欧盟理事会，2016）、《欧洲人工智能法案》的禁令，以及正在形成的神经数据法律（见 15.6 节）。 市场之所以重要，是因为提供商的商业模式决定其共生体为谁服务，而对提供商的独立审计是信任的前提条件。 研究为其余各层所需的证据提供支持，第 17 章对此进行了组织梳理。 设计、规范、法律和市场是 Lessig（1999）所描述的四种规制方式，在这四种方式中，规范和法律将承担大部分责任，因为设计只能约束那些遵守规则的设备。

paragraphs.en: Augmentation asks how much better the person does with the symbiont than without. Synergy ( 6 ) asks whether the pair beats the better of the two alone, which need not be the case: a meta-analysis found that human–AI combinations are often worse than the best of the two ( Vaccaro et al., 2024 ) . Retention ( 7 ) asks whether, after a period of use and with the symbiont removed, the person is stronger than before; both terms measure the person unaided on comparable situations x x , and τ \tau is the time since the symbiont was removed. The personalization differential ( 8 ) asks how much of the gain comes from the person’s context, with s − s^{-} the same base model and the same agent without personal context. Augmentation, synergy, and retention can all be positive, or one positive and two negative, and reporting only one is insufficient. For tasks whose value lies in the person’s own experience, emotional and social ones, U ⁡ ( x t , s ) U(x_{t};\,s) has no meaning and ( 6 ) is not computed. For the first tier, the differential ( 8 ) is the comparison to report, and its control is never “no AI”, or the capability of the model will be credited to the coupling. This is the technical form of the sentence that AGI asks how intelligent the machine can be and AHI asks how much intelligence it can enable in a person.
paragraphs.zh: 增强问的是：人伴随共生体时的表现比没有共生体时好多少。 协同（6）问的是：这一组合能否胜过两者中单独表现更好的一方，而这未必成立：一项元分析发现，人与人工智能的组合往往不如两者中更好的一方（Vaccaro et al., 2024）。 保持（7）问的是：在使用一段时间并移除共生体之后，人是否比之前更强；这两个术语都在可比的情境 x 上测量人无辅助时的表现，τ 是共生体被移除后经过的时间。 个性化差值（8）问的是：增益中有多少来自人的个人情境，其中 s⁻ 是同一个基础模型、同一个智能体，但不带个人情境。 增强、协同和保持可以同时为正，也可以一正两负，因此只报告其中一个是不够的。 对于那些价值在于个人自身经验的任务，即情感性和社会性任务，U(x_t; s) 没有意义，（6）不予计算。 对于第一层，应当报告的对比是差值（8），其对照组绝不是“没有人工智能”，否则模型的能力就会被误记到这种耦合的功劳上。 这是下面这句话的技术形式：AGI 问的是机器本身能有多智能，而 AHI 问的是它能在一个人身上激发出多少智能。

paragraphs.en: The unit of evaluation is one person, so the methods have to be designed for one person. Four layers of method follow. Component benchmarks for memory, personalization, first-person understanding, and task execution ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Salemi et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) test parts. Simulation with generative agents ( Park et al., 2023 ) pre-screens intervention policies and tests mechanisms. N-of-1 designs, the crossover trials medicine developed for a single patient ( Lillie et al., 2011 ) , fit the comparison “the same person, with it and without it” naturally. Longitudinal studies in daily life over weeks and months record gains, costs, exits, and changes in behavior. The paper’s position is that N-of-1 and longitudinal designs are the primary methods of the direction, with at least three baselines: no assistance, a generic assistant, and a personalized task agent on the same base model. Learning effects cannot be washed out of a crossover, so conditions should be introduced in phases, with few switches, and studies of long-term use must report the people who left and the cases that went badly.
paragraphs.zh: 评估的单位是一个人，因此方法必须为单个人设计。 接下来是四个层次的方法。 针对记忆、个性化、第一人称理解和任务执行的组件基准测试（Maharana et al., 2024；Wu et al., 2025；Salemi et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2025；Xie et al., 2024）只测试局部部分。 使用生成式智能体（Park et al., 2023）进行的模拟可以预筛干预策略并检验机制。 单受试者（N-of-1）设计，即医学上为单个患者开发的交叉试验（Lillie et al., 2011），天然契合“同一个人，有它与没有它”的比较方式。 在日常生活中持续数周和数月的纵向研究记录收益、代价、退出情况以及行为变化。 本文的立场是，单受试者（N-of-1）设计与纵向设计是该方向的主要方法，且至少需要三个基线：无辅助、通用助手，以及在同一基础模型上的个性化任务智能体。 学习效应无法从交叉设计中消除，因此各条件应分阶段引入、尽量减少切换，并且长期使用的研究必须报告退出的人员以及进展不佳的案例。

paragraphs.en: Table 18 collects twenty-three open problems in six groups: modeling a person and their record, participating in real time, learning across a life, systems and hardware, society and ethics, and governance. Each problem names what has to be worked out and the sections it depends on, and four are starred because the first usable systems depend on them most: the modeling of a life’s record at scale, an end-to-end latency budget from sensor to ear, the cost of always-on cognition, and the iteration of wearable hardware, neural interfaces included, together with the cognitive core. The groups are ordered from the inside of the loop outward, from the model of the person to the society around them and the rules it sets, and the roadmap of Section 17.5 places each problem at the stage of capability at which it becomes unavoidable.
paragraphs.zh: 表 18 收集了六组共二十三个开放问题：对个人及其记录建模、实时参与、跨生命周期的学习、系统与硬件、社会与伦理，以及治理。 每个问题都指明需要解决的内容及其所依赖的章节，其中四个问题被标上星号，因为首批可用的系统最为依赖它们：大规模生命记录的建模、从传感器到耳朵的端到端延迟预算、始终在线认知的成本，以及包括神经接口在内的可穿戴硬件与认知核心的迭代。 这些分组按从循环内部到外部的顺序排列，从个人模型到其周围的社会以及社会制定的规则，第 17.5 节的路线图将每个问题置于其变得不可避免的能力阶段。

paragraphs.en: Figure 21 orders capabilities in six stages, from a streaming cognitive copilot on the desktop with Tier 1 by delegation, to a persistent record and model, to the device constellation, to private input, to lifelong co-adaptation, and to networks of symbionts, with the evidence needed to move from each stage to the next and the open problems mapped onto them. The stages accumulate capability and are not a product schedule; full-duplex, private cues, and Tier 1 are requirements from the first stage onward.

paragraphs.en: The claims of the paper should be narrowed if any of the following holds: more personal context brings no measurable gain on most tasks, including a zero personalization differential on the first tier; timely intervention is no better than simple on-demand answering; long-term use generally erodes abilities people want to keep; value is obtained only at an unacceptable cost in surveillance or compute; people will not authorize anything above the desktop; or every change of backbone loses the relationship and cannot be prevented. Two further conditions concern governance: assistance policies and proofs of abstention cannot be made reliable, so that a symbiont cannot be told apart from a tool for cheating; or the gains of augmentation in the main competitive settings prove to be mostly positional, so that adoption brings an arms race and no net gain. The first six conditions correspond to dimensions of Table 17 , and the last two to the governance problems of Table 18 .
paragraphs.zh: 若以下任一情况成立，论文的主张就应加以收窄：更多个人情境在大多数任务上没有可衡量的收益，包括在第一层级上个性化差异为零；及时干预并不优于简单的按需问答；长期使用普遍侵蚀了人们想要保留的能力；价值只有在监督或算力成本高得令人无法接受时才能获得；人们不会授权任何超出桌面层面的东西；或者每一次更换底层模型都会丢失关系且无法阻止。 另有两个条件与治理有关：辅助策略和弃权证明无法做到可靠，以致于无法把共生体与作弊工具区分开来；或者在主要竞争环境中，增强带来的收益被证明主要是位次性的，以致于采纳只会引发军备竞赛而没有净收益。 前六个条件对应于表 17 的各个维度，后两个条件对应于表 18 的治理问题。

paragraphs.en: The past decade was spent making machines more intelligent; the next is worth spending on making each particular person stronger. As AI enters the physical world it will take two forms of intelligent individual, robots with bodies of their own and people augmented by AI, and this paper has argued for the second, giving it a name, AI-augmented human intelligence, a form, the cognitive symbiont, and a map. A symbiont is lifelong, embedded, real-time, private, low-friction, and proactive; it stands on foundation models, agents and their harnesses, memory and context engineering, world models, and wearable hardware; and it climbs a ladder from doing the person’s errands with their context in hand, to thinking a problem through with them, to holding them steady among other people. The object of evaluation changes with it, from what the AI completes to what the person can now do, measured as augmentation, synergy, and retention. The map has blank regions, and the three largest are the evidence on which a mind can be modeled, the timing of participation, and the stability of learning and evolution in the course of a life; the heaviest region is the governance of augmentation in the settings where people compete with and trust one another. The paradigm will have succeeded when the sign of it is a person who has become more like who they wanted to be, and when no one mistakes that for the AI having become more like a person.
paragraphs.zh: 过去十年被用于让机器更智能；下一个十年值得用来让每一个具体的人变得更强。 当人工智能进入物理世界时，它将以两种智能个体的形式出现：拥有自己身体的机器人，以及被人工智能增强的人；本文主张的是后者，并为其命名——人工智能增强的人类智能，给出其形态——认知共生体，以及一幅地图。 共生体是终身的、嵌入式的、实时的、私密的、低摩擦的、主动的；它立足于基础模型、智能体及其执行框架、记忆与上下文工程、世界模型和可穿戴硬件；它沿着一架阶梯攀升：从凭借对方的上下文替其跑腿办事，到与其一同把问题想透彻，再到在人群之中稳稳地扶持住这个人。 评估对象也随之改变：从人工智能完成了什么，变为这个人现在能做什么，并以增强度、协同度和留存度来衡量。 这幅地图上还有空白区域，其中最大的三块是：可以据以建模某个心智的证据、参与介入的时机，以及学习与演化在一生进程中的稳定性；而最沉重的区域，是在人们彼此竞争又彼此信任的场景中对增强的治理。 当它的标志是一个人变得更像自己想成为的那个人，且没有人会误以为这是人工智能变得更像人时，这一范式才算成功。
